bold.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → slash menu and Ctrl+Space snippet list: item that wraps text in bold markers.

italic.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → slash menu and Ctrl+Space snippet list: item that wraps text in italic markers.

inline_code.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → slash menu and Ctrl+Space snippet list: item that inserts inline code between backticks.

link.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → slash menu and Ctrl+Space snippet list: item that inserts a link with text and an address.

image.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → slash menu and Ctrl+Space snippet list: item that inserts a picture taken from one of the notebook's attachment cells.

inline_detail.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → slash menu and Ctrl+Space snippet list: detail next to the items that format text inside a line (bold, italic, code, link, picture).

placeholder_text.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inserted snippet: placeholder word selected inside an inserted bold, italic or link snippet, typed over by the user.

placeholder_code.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inserted snippet: placeholder word selected inside inserted inline code, typed over by the user.

placeholder_caption.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inserted snippet: placeholder word selected as the caption of an inserted picture, typed over by the user.

table_column.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inserted table snippet: placeholder column heading written in each header cell of an inserted table.

cell_value.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → {{ completion list: detail next to a formula cell, showing its kind label ({kind}) and its current value ({value}).

cell_value_note.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → {{ completion list: detail next to a formula cell whose value may not be current: kind label ({kind}), value ({value}) and why it may be out of date ({note}, e.g. Stale).

cell_note.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → {{ completion list: detail next to a formula cell that has no value yet: kind label ({kind}) and its state ({note}).

param_value.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → {{param. completion list: detail next to a parameter, showing its type ({type}) and current value ({value}).

param_hidden.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → {{param. completion list: detail next to a sensitive parameter, showing its type ({type}) and that its value is hidden.

param_unset.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → {{param. completion list: detail next to a parameter that has no value, showing its type ({type}).

partial.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → completion list and hover card: note that a formula's value was computed from partial (truncated or sampled) results.

fence_language.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → code fence completion list: detail next to each language a fenced code block opened with three backticks can be marked with.

attachment_picture.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → picture destination completion list: detail next to a picture attachment cell, showing the picture's file name ({file_name}).

hover_value.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → hover card over a {{…}} reference: line showing the referenced formula's or parameter's current value ({value}).

hover_no_value.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → hover card and completion list for a formula reference: shown when the formula has not produced a value yet.

hover_hidden.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → hover card over a {{param.…}} reference to a sensitive parameter: line explaining that its value is never shown.

hover_unset.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → hover card over a {{param.…}} reference: line shown when the parameter has no value.

hover_not_shown.value: Markdown solo muestra valores de fórmulas y parámetros, así que esto se queda tal cual
hover_not_shown.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → hover card over a {{…}} reference to a cell that is not a formula: explains that Markdown leaves such a reference as written.

unknown_reference.value: No hay ninguna celda ni parámetro llamado {name}
unknown_reference.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inline diagnostics: warning under a {{…}} reference whose name ({name}) matches no cell or parameter in the notebook.

unknown_parameter.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inline diagnostics: warning under a {{param.…}} reference whose parameter name ({name}) the notebook does not have.

unknown_field.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inline diagnostics: warning under a {{param.name.field}} reference naming a part ({field}, e.g. start) that the parameter ({name}) does not have.

not_shown.value: {name} no es una fórmula, así que Markdown lo muestra tal cual
not_shown.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inline diagnostics: gentle note under a {{…}} reference to a cell ({name}) that is not a formula, so Markdown leaves the reference as written.

unknown_attachment.value: No hay ninguna celda de adjunto llamada {name}
unknown_attachment.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inline diagnostics: warning under a picture destination that names an attachment cell ({name}) the notebook does not have.

not_a_picture.value: {name} no es un adjunto de imagen, así que se muestra un marcador de posición
not_a_picture.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell editor → inline diagnostics: gentle note under a picture destination that names an attachment cell ({name}) whose file is not a PNG or JPEG picture.

kept_previews.value: Algunos valores superan los 8 KiB y no se pudieron leer completos, así que las celdas que leen esta solo ven sus primeros 8 KiB.
kept_previews.location: SQL notebook → activity panel: line logged for a SQL cell whose result has values longer than 8 KiB that couldn't be read again in full (the cell isn't a read-only query, the values are too large to hold, or the second read returned different rows), so cells reading its result see only the first 8 KiB of those values.

coverage_mixed.value: Las estadísticas de columna cubren las {total} filas de la tabla local (DuckDB). Los histogramas, los valores más frecuentes y los significados cubren las primeras {count} filas.
coverage_mixed.location: SQL notebook → Profile cell: line above the summary grid when the input is a local table larger than the rows read. Counts, missing values, ranges and averages cover the whole table (computed by the local database, DuckDB); histograms, top values and meanings cover only the first rows. {total} is the table's row count, {count} the rows read.

whole_table.location: SQL notebook → Profile cell → column card: small heading over the figures (missing values, distinct values, range, average, quartiles) computed over the whole local table by the local database, DuckDB.

first_rows.location: SQL notebook → Profile cell → column card: small heading over the figures (percentiles, outliers, histogram, top values) computed only from the rows the profile read, when the column's other figures cover the whole local table. {count} is the number of rows read.

quartiles.location: SQL notebook → Profile cell → column card, whole-table section: the numeric column's lower quartile, median and upper quartile over the whole local table, as estimated by DuckDB. {q1}, {median} and {q3} are numbers.

switch.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Local data tab: label of the switch that encrypts this notebook's local data (its private analysis database on this computer) with a key kept in the system keychain.

switch_accessibility.value: Cifrar los datos locales de este cuaderno con una clave del llavero del sistema
switch_accessibility.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Local data tab: screen reader label of the switch that turns encryption of this notebook's local data on or off; it can only change while the notebook has no local tables.

switching.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Local data tab: status under the encryption switch while the notebook's empty local database is being recreated with or without encryption.

clear_first.value: El cifrado solo se puede cambiar mientras este cuaderno no tenga tablas locales. Borre primero los datos locales; las tablas vuelven cuando sus celdas se ejecutan de nuevo.
clear_first.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Local data tab: shown under the encryption switch (with a Clear All button) when the user tries to turn encryption on or off while the notebook still has local tables; the database can only be recreated empty, and tables come back when their cells run again.

turned_on.value: Los datos locales de este cuaderno ahora están cifrados. Su clave está en el llavero del sistema.
turned_on.location: SQL notebook → status bar: shown after the user turns on encryption of the notebook's local data and the empty local database was recreated encrypted, with its key in the system keychain.

turned_off.value: Los datos locales de este cuaderno ya no están cifrados.
turned_off.location: SQL notebook → status bar: shown after the user turns off encryption of the notebook's local data; the empty local database was recreated without encryption and its key removed from the system keychain.

keychain_unavailable.value: El llavero del sistema no puede guardar la clave de este cuaderno: {detail}
keychain_unavailable.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Local data tab: error shown when turning on encryption of local data fails because the system keychain could not store the key. {detail} is the keychain's own error text.

not_encrypted.value: Los datos locales de este cuaderno no están cifrados, pero se indicó una clave para ellos.
not_encrypted.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Local data tab: error shown when the notebook's local database is opened with a key but the database file is not encrypted.

clear_button.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Local data tab: button under the message explaining that encryption only switches without local tables; it opens the confirmation that clears all of this notebook's local tables.

untrusted.value: Confíe en este cuaderno antes de cifrar sus datos locales.
untrusted.location: SQL notebook → status bar: shown when the user flips the local data encryption switch in a notebook that is not trusted on this computer; untrusted notebooks have no local data.

close.location: SQL notebook → under an embedded or view-locked result grid, beside the rows behind a drill: button that closes those rows.

title.location: SQL notebook → under an embedded or view-locked result grid after a double-click on a pivot value or a click on a chart mark: caption of the rows behind it. {selection} names the values drilled into, {row_count} is how many rows match.

run.location: SQL notebook → floating control over an embedded cell (shown on hover or when selected): Run button tooltip and spoken name; runs the cell like its header's Run button. {cell_name} is the cell's name.

hide_config.location: SQL notebook → floating control over an embedded pivot or chart cell: button tooltip and spoken name that hides its configuration sidebar.

show_config.location: SQL notebook → floating control over an embedded pivot or chart cell: button tooltip and spoken name that shows its configuration sidebar.

show_full.location: SQL notebook → floating control over an embedded cell (shown on hover or when selected): button tooltip and spoken name; shows the cell with its header and editor again. {cell_name} is the cell's name.

embed.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: shows this cell (or the selection) with only its output, flush with the cells around it.

embed_all.location: SQL notebook → top bar → More menu: checkable item that shows every cell with only its output, so the notebook reads like a report.

hide_config.location: SQL notebook → cell menu of an embedded pivot or chart cell: hides its configuration sidebar.

lock_chart.location: SQL notebook → cell menu of a SQL or table cell: checkable item; locks the results grid to the chart view so readers cannot switch away from it.

lock_off.location: SQL notebook → cell menu of a SQL or table cell: checkable item; the results grid can switch freely between rows, pivot and chart.

lock_pivot.location: SQL notebook → cell menu of a SQL or table cell: checkable item; locks the results grid to the pivot view so readers cannot switch away from it.

lock_rows.location: SQL notebook → cell menu of a SQL or table cell: checkable item; locks the results grid to the rows view so readers cannot switch to pivot or chart.

show_config.location: SQL notebook → cell menu of an embedded pivot or chart cell: shows its configuration sidebar.

show_full.location: SQL notebook → cell menu of an embedded cell: shows this cell (or the selection) with its header and editor again.

embed_all.location: Command palette → Query commands: turns "Embed all outputs" on or off for the active notebook, so every cell shows only its output.

toggle.value: Notebook: Incrustar o mostrar completas las celdas seleccionadas
toggle.location: Command palette → Query commands: shows the selected notebook cells with only their output (embedded), or shows them in full again.

toggle_config.value: Notebook: Mostrar u ocultar la configuración incrustada
toggle_config.location: Command palette → Query commands: shows or hides the configuration sidebar of the selected embedded pivot or chart cell.

back.location: SQL notebook → embedded pivot cell after a double-click drilled to the rows behind a value: button that goes back to the pivot.

no_rows.location: SQL notebook → an embedded SQL cell after its run: shown where the grid would be when the run returned no result grid (for example a statement that only changed rows).

not_run.location: SQL notebook → an embedded SQL cell that has not run yet: quiet one-line placeholder where its result grid will be; a Run button follows it.

run.location: SQL notebook → an embedded SQL cell that has not run yet: button that runs the cell.

config.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that showed or hid an embedded pivot's or chart's configuration.

embed_all.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that turned "Embed all outputs" on or off.

lock.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that locked a results grid to one view or unlocked it.

resize.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that changed the height of an embedded cell's output.

toggle.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that embedded cells or showed them in full.

offer.value: Cambios sin guardar de tu última sesión
offer.location: SQL notebook → top bar: notice shown on a saved notebook reopened at launch when it had unsaved changes the last time the app quit; the Restore and Discard buttons follow it.

restore.location: SQL notebook → top bar unsaved-changes notice: button that puts the unsaved changes from the last session back into the notebook (they stay unsaved until the user saves).

discard.location: SQL notebook → top bar unsaved-changes notice: button that throws away the unsaved changes from the last session and keeps the notebook as saved in its file.

undo_step.location: SQL notebook → Edit menu and undo status message: name of the undo step created when the user restores the unsaved changes from the last session.

busy.value: Detén la ejecución antes de restaurar los cambios sin guardar
busy.location: SQL notebook → status bar: shown when the user clicks Restore on the unsaved-changes notice while cells are still running.

file_missing.value: No se encontró el archivo de notebook {path}, así que su pestaña no se volvió a abrir
file_missing.location: App window → Status bar at launch: shown when a notebook tab from the last session cannot be reopened because its file was moved or deleted and there were no unsaved changes to bring back; {path} is the file path.

file_missing_recovered.value: No se encontró el archivo de notebook {path}; tus cambios sin guardar se abrieron como un notebook sin guardar
file_missing_recovered.location: App window → Status bar at launch: shown when a notebook's file was moved or deleted but its unsaved changes from the last session were reopened as a new, unsaved notebook; {path} is the missing file's path.

changed_on_disk.value: {path} cambió en el disco. Elige Recargar o Conservar la mía antes de guardar.
changed_on_disk.location: SQL notebook → Status bar: shown when the user saves a notebook whose file was changed by another program since it was opened; the top bar shows Reload and Keep mine to choose first. {path} is the file path.

open_in_another_tab.value: {path} está abierto en otra pestaña. Ciérrala o elige otro archivo.
open_in_another_tab.location: SQL notebook → Status bar: shown when the user picks, in Save As, a notebook file that is already open in another tab; nothing is written. {path} is the chosen file path.

pinned_cells_keep_default.value: Algunas celdas usan otra conexión, así que el cuaderno conserva su conexión guardada. Primero cambia esas celdas a la conexión del cuaderno.
pinned_cells_keep_default.location: SQL notebook → status bar: shown when the user picks "Use the tab's connection" in the top-bar connection menu while some cells are pinned to another connection, so the notebook keeps its saved default connection.

own_identity.value: Este archivo es una copia de otro cuaderno, así que ahora tiene su propia identidad: su confianza, su historial de ejecuciones y sus datos locales se guardan aparte de los del original.
own_identity.location: SQL notebook → status bar and activity panel: shown once, the first time the user saves a notebook file that is a copy of another notebook this computer knows at a different path (a copied file, or the original left behind by Save As); the copy gets its own identity so it no longer shares the other file's trust, run history and local data.

changed_in_another_tab.value: {path} se cambió en otra pestaña del navegador. Elige Recargar o Conservar la mía antes de guardar.
changed_in_another_tab.location: Browser build → status bar: shown when the user presses Save on a notebook kept in this browser that was changed in another browser tab since this tab last read or saved it; nothing is written until the user picks Reload or Keep mine on the conflict indicator. {path} is the notebook's name in the browser.

cell.location: SQL notebook → cell list: spoken name of a cell for screen readers; {kind} is the cell kind, {cell_name} its name, {position} and {count} its place in the notebook.

selected.location: SQL notebook → cell list: word added to a cell's spoken name when it is part of the multi-cell selection.

bookmarked.location: SQL notebook → cell header: badge shown on a cell the user bookmarked.

pinned.location: SQL notebook → cell header: badge shown on a cell whose output is pinned to the strip at the top.

empty.value: Aún no hay marcadores. Marca una celda desde su menú o con Cmd+F2.
empty.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Bookmarks tab: note shown when no cell is bookmarked yet.

tab.location: SQL notebook → left rail: tab that lists the bookmarked cells.

bookmark.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: bookmarks the selected cells, or removes their bookmarks.

clear.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: clears the selection and hides the bar.

collapse.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: collapses the selected cells, or expands them when all are collapsed.

copy.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar and cell menu: copies the cells to the clipboard.

cut.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar and cell menu: copies the cells to the clipboard and removes them.

delete.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: deletes the selected cells (it can be undone).

duplicate.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar and cell menu: inserts a copy of the cells below them.

merge.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: merges the selected SQL or Markdown cells into one cell.

move_down.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: moves the selected cells down by one place.

move_up.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: moves the selected cells up by one place.

run.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: button that runs every selected cell.

selected.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: count of selected cells at the start of the bar; {count} is the number selected.

to_markdown.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: turns the selected SQL cells into Markdown cells.

to_sql.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: turns the selected Markdown cells into SQL cells.

toolbar.location: SQL notebook → bulk bar: spoken name of the toolbar that acts on all selected cells.

cells.location: SQL notebook → drag preview: label that follows the pointer while several cells are dragged; {count} is how many.

handle.location: SQL notebook → cell header: spoken name of the handle that drags the cell to a new place; {cell_name} is the cell's name.

keyboard_hint.value: O pulsa Opción+Arriba u Opción+Abajo en el modo de comandos
keyboard_hint.location: SQL notebook → cell header drag handle: spoken hint that names the keyboard alternative to dragging.

bar.location: SQL notebook → find bar: spoken name of the find and replace bar above the cells.

close.location: SQL notebook → find bar: button that closes the find bar.

counter.location: SQL notebook → find bar: position of the current match; {current} is its number and {total} the number of matches.

in_cell.location: SQL notebook → find bar result list: where a match is, when it is in a cell's text; {cell_name} is the cell.

in_data.location: SQL notebook → find bar result list: where a match is, when it is a value in a cell's result; {cell_name} is the cell.

in_name.location: SQL notebook → find bar result list: where a match is, when it is in a cell's name; {cell_name} is the cell.

in_settings.location: SQL notebook → find bar result list: where a match is, when it is in a cell's settings such as a chart title; {cell_name} is the cell.

in_title.location: SQL notebook → find bar result list: where a match is, when it is in the notebook title.

include_data.location: SQL notebook → find bar: toggle that also searches the values in cell results.

include_data_tooltip.value: Busca también en los valores de los resultados de este cuaderno (nunca se reemplazan)
include_data_tooltip.location: SQL notebook → find bar: tooltip of the Search results toggle explaining what it covers.

match_case.location: SQL notebook → find bar: toggle that makes the search case-sensitive.

names_refused.value: Nombres sin cambiar porque el nuevo no está permitido: {count}
names_refused.location: SQL notebook → status bar: added after Replace all when some cell names could not take the new text; {count} is how many.

next.location: SQL notebook → find bar: button that goes to the next match.

no_matches.location: SQL notebook → find bar: counter text when the search finds nothing.

not_replaced.value: No se reemplazó nada: la coincidencia cambió o el nuevo nombre no está permitido.
not_replaced.location: SQL notebook → status bar: message when Replace could not change the current match (it moved, or the new name is not allowed).

placeholder.value: Buscar en celdas, nombres, títulos y notas
placeholder.location: SQL notebook → find bar: placeholder in the search field.

previous.location: SQL notebook → find bar: button that goes to the previous match.

read_only.value: Esta coincidencia no se puede reemplazar: los resultados, las celdas de IA y las celdas que esta versión no puede editar no cambian.
read_only.location: SQL notebook → status bar: message when the current match is in something replace does not change (results, AI cells, unknown cells).

replace_all.location: SQL notebook → find bar: button that replaces every match in one step that can be undone.

replace_one.location: SQL notebook → find bar: button that replaces the current match.

replace_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → find bar: placeholder in the replacement field.

replaced.location: SQL notebook → status bar: message after Replace all; {count} is the number of replacements.

whole_word.location: SQL notebook → find bar: toggle that matches whole words only.

fold.location: SQL notebook → Markdown heading cell header: button that folds the cells under the heading.

tooltip.value: Oculta o muestra las celdas hasta el siguiente encabezado del mismo nivel o superior
tooltip.location: SQL notebook → Markdown heading cell header: tooltip of the fold button explaining what it hides.

unfold_count.location: SQL notebook → Markdown heading cell header: button on a folded heading that shows its cells again; {count} is how many are hidden.

button.location: SQL notebook → between cells: button that inserts a new cell here and opens the list of cell kinds.

hint.value: J/K o flechas para elegir, Intro para insertar, Esc para cerrar
hint.location: SQL notebook → insert menu: keyboard hint at the top of the menu.

menu.location: SQL notebook → insert menu: spoken name of the keyboard menu that lists every cell kind to insert.

columns_from_output.location: SQL notebook → SQL cell editor hover card: note that the listed columns come from the referenced cell's last result.

columns_from_query.value: Columnas de su consulta (aún no se ejecutó)
columns_from_query.location: SQL notebook → SQL cell editor hover card: note that the listed columns are read from the referenced cell's query because it has not run.

parameter.location: SQL notebook → SQL cell editor: kind label of a notebook parameter in completions and hover cards.

bookmark.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: bookmarks this cell.

copy.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: copies this cell (or the selection) to the clipboard.

cut.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: copies this cell (or the selection) and removes it.

duplicate.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: inserts a copy of this cell (or the selection) below it.

fold.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: folds or unfolds the heading section this cell belongs to.

label.location: SQL notebook → cell header: spoken name and tooltip of the cell's menu button.

merge_above.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: merges this cell with the cell above it.

merge_below.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: merges this cell with the cell below it.

paste_below.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: pastes cells or text from the clipboard below this cell.

pin.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: pins this cell's output to the strip at the top of the notebook.

remove_bookmark.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: removes this cell's bookmark.

run_selected.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: runs every selected cell.

split.location: SQL notebook → cell menu: splits this cell in two at the text cursor.

unpin.location: SQL notebook → cell menu and pinned strip: removes this cell's output from the pinned strip.

clear_selection.location: Command palette → Query commands: clears the cell selection (and closes the insert menu or find bar first).

copy.location: Command palette → Query commands: copies the selected cells to the clipboard.

cut.location: Command palette → Query commands: copies the selected cells and removes them.

duplicate.location: Command palette → Query commands: inserts a copy of the selected cells below them.

extend_down.location: Command palette → Query commands: extends the cell selection to the next cell.

extend_up.location: Command palette → Query commands: extends the cell selection to the previous cell.

find.location: Command palette → Query commands: opens the find bar of the active notebook.

insert_menu.location: Command palette → Query commands: opens the menu that inserts a cell of any kind below the active cell.

merge_above.value: Cuaderno: Combinar celda con la anterior
merge_above.location: Command palette → Query commands: merges the active cell with the one above.

merge_below.value: Cuaderno: Combinar celda con la siguiente
merge_below.location: Command palette → Query commands: merges the selected cells, or the active cell with the one below.

move_down.location: Command palette → Query commands: moves the selected cells down by one place.

move_up.location: Command palette → Query commands: moves the selected cells up by one place.

next_bookmark.location: Command palette → Query commands: moves to the next bookmarked cell.

paste_above.location: Command palette → Query commands: pastes cells or text from the clipboard above the active cell.

paste_below.location: Command palette → Query commands: pastes cells or text from the clipboard below the active cell.

previous_bookmark.location: Command palette → Query commands: moves to the previous bookmarked cell.

redo.location: Command palette → Query commands: redoes the last undone change to the notebook's cells.

replace.location: Command palette → Query commands: opens the find bar with the replace field.

run_selected.location: Command palette → Query commands: runs every selected cell through the notebook's planner.

select_all.location: Command palette → Query commands: selects every cell of the active notebook.

show_bookmarks.location: Command palette → Query commands: opens the Bookmarks tab of the notebook's left rail.

split.value: Cuaderno: Dividir celda en el cursor
split.location: Command palette → Query commands: splits the cell being edited in two at the text cursor.

toggle_bookmark.location: Command palette → Query commands: bookmarks the selected cells, or removes their bookmarks.

toggle_collapse.location: Command palette → Query commands: collapses the selected cells, or expands them when all are collapsed.

toggle_fold.location: Command palette → Query commands: folds or unfolds the heading section of the active cell.

toggle_pin.location: Command palette → Query commands: pins the selected cells' outputs to the strip at the top, or unpins them.

undo.location: Command palette → Query commands: undoes the last change to the notebook's cells (not typing inside a cell).

unfold_all.location: Command palette → Query commands: unfolds every folded heading section.

card.location: SQL notebook → pinned strip: spoken name of one pinned output card; {cell_name} is the cell it comes from.

no_output.value: Aún no hay resultado. Ejecuta la celda para verlo aquí.
no_output.location: SQL notebook → pinned strip: text on a pinned card whose cell has no output yet.

rows.location: SQL notebook → pinned strip: row count under a pinned output's preview; {count} is the number of rows.

strip.location: SQL notebook → pinned strip: spoken name of the strip of pinned outputs above the cells.

bulleted_list.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that starts a bulleted list.

callout.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that inserts a callout note block.

callout_word.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: bold word written at the start of an inserted callout block.

checklist.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that starts a checklist.

code.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that inserts a fenced SQL code block.

divider.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that inserts a horizontal divider.

heading_1.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that starts a level 1 heading.

heading_2.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that starts a level 2 heading.

heading_3.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that starts a level 3 heading.

new_cell.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that adds a new cell of the named kind below this one; {kind} is the kind label.

new_cell_detail.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: detail next to the new-cell items explaining they add a cell.

numbered_list.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that starts a numbered list.

parameter.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that inserts a parameter's current value.

quote.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that starts a quote.

reference.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that starts a reference to another cell's result.

table.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: item that inserts a two-column table.

format_detail.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: detail next to the items that insert Markdown formatting (headings, lists, table, quote, divider, code block).

reference_detail.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell slash menu: detail next to the items that insert a cell reference or a parameter value.

no_heading.value: No hay ningún encabezado sobre esta celda que plegar.

nothing_to_paste.value: El portapapeles no tiene nada que pegar como celdas.

pasted.location: SQL notebook → status bar: message after cells were pasted; {count} is how many.

ai.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of the step that applied accepted AI proposals.

convert.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that changed cells between SQL and Markdown.

cut.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that cut cells.

delete.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that deleted cells.

duplicate.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that duplicated cells.

edit.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a cell change with no more specific name.

insert.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that inserted a cell.

merge.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that merged cells.

move.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that moved cells.

paste.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that pasted cells.

rename.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that renamed a cell.

replace.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a find and replace step.

split.location: SQL notebook → status bar after undo or redo: name of a step that split a cell.

discard.location: SQL notebook → Apply bar above the cells: button that drops pending parameter changes and forgets the queued re-runs.

goes_stale.value: Al aplicar, estas celdas quedarán desactualizadas:
goes_stale.location: SQL notebook → Apply bar above the cells (manual run mode): label above the cells that applying the changes makes out of date.

local_cell.location: SQL notebook → Apply bar above the cells: stands in for the connection name in a chip for a cell that runs inside the notebook rather than on a database connection.

remote_waiting.value: Celdas de base de datos pendientes de aplicar: {count}
remote_waiting.location: SQL notebook → Apply bar above the cells (reactive mode): headline when parameter changes made database cells out of date that only re-run after Apply; {count} is how many cells.

reruns.value: Estas celdas se vuelven a ejecutar al aplicar:
reruns.location: SQL notebook → Apply bar above the cells (reactive mode): label above the cells Apply re-runs.

applied_one.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry written when pending parameter changes are applied; {count} is how many parameters changed. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

choose.value: Esta celda muestra un parámetro del cuaderno. Elige uno o crea uno nuevo.

kind_label.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and add-cell menu: kind label of a parameter cell.

missing.value: El parámetro @{parameter_name} ya no existe. Elige otro o crea uno nuevo.

new.location: SQL notebook → Parameter cell: button that opens the parameter editor for a new parameter this cell will show.

allowed_list.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label above the field listing the fixed values a dropdown or multiple-choice parameter offers.

allowed_list_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: placeholder in the allowed values field showing comma-separated values and value=label pairs.

allowlist.value: Nombres de tabla o columna permitidos

allowlist_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: placeholder in the allowed names field (technical names, keep as is).

apply.value: Esperar a Aplicar antes de que las celdas usen un valor nuevo
apply.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → Behavior: checkbox making changes to this parameter wait for the Apply button before cells see them.

behavior.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label above the checkboxes for sensitivity, sharing, scope and Apply.

cancel.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: button that closes the editor without saving.

date_presets.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → date types: label above the checkboxes choosing which date presets the parameter's Presets menu offers (none checked offers all).

default.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label above the default value field.

default_preset.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → date types: label of the dropdown choosing a relative date preset (such as Last 7 days) as the default, recalculated each day.

default_preset_none.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: first entry of the rolling default dropdown, meaning no preset is used.

delete.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: button that deletes the parameter being edited.

error_allowed_list.value: Añade al menos un valor permitido.

error_default.value: El valor predeterminado no encaja con el tipo de este parámetro.
error_default.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: error under the default value field when the default does not fit the parameter's type.

error_limit.value: El límite de filas debe ser un número entero mayor que cero.
error_limit.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: error under the options query row limit when it is not a positive whole number.

error_name.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: error under the name field when it is empty.

error_named_presets.value: Escribe cada valor predefinido como Etiqueta = valor, separados por punto y coma.
error_named_presets.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: error under the named presets field when an entry is not written as Label = value.

error_query.value: Escribe la consulta que devuelve las opciones.
error_query.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: error under the options query field when it is empty.

error_slider.value: El control deslizante necesita un mínimo menor que el máximo y un paso mayor que cero.
error_slider.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → slider type: error when the minimum, maximum or step are not usable.

label.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label above the field for the text shown above the input.

limit_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → options query: placeholder in the row limit field; 1000 is the default.

min_length_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → Validation: placeholder in the shortest allowed length field (characters, or number of choices).

min_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: placeholder in a minimum field (slider minimum, or the smallest allowed value).

name.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label above the name field (the name SQL uses as :name, @name or {{param.name}}).

name_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: placeholder in the name field, an example SQL identifier (keep it a plain identifier).

named_presets.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label above the field listing named presets such as tenants or regions.

named_presets_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: placeholder in the named presets field showing Label = value pairs separated by semicolons.

personal.value: Personal: cada persona guarda su propio valor fuera del archivo del cuaderno

query.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label above the SQL that fills a parameter's choices.

query_columns.value: Columna de valor, columna de etiqueta y límite de filas
query_columns.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → options query: label above the value column, label column and row limit fields.

query_connection.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → options query: label of the dropdown choosing the connection the query runs on.

query_connection_default.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → options query connection dropdown: entry meaning the notebook's default connection.

query_hint.value: Se ejecuta en modo de solo lectura y no lee más filas que el límite. Usa {{param.region}} para seguir a otro parámetro y {{search}} en una búsqueda para filtrar por el texto escrito.

query_placeholder.value: SELECT code, name FROM regions ORDER BY name
query_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → options query: placeholder in the SQL field.

required.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → Validation: checkbox that makes an empty value an error.

save.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: button that saves the parameter definition.

sensitive.value: Confidencial: se oculta en pantalla y queda fuera del historial, las exportaciones y los enlaces
sensitive.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → Behavior: checkbox marking the parameter sensitive.

sensitive_default_note.value: Los parámetros confidenciales y secretos nunca guardan un valor en el archivo del cuaderno.
sensitive_default_note.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: note shown instead of the default field for sensitive and secret parameters.

shareable.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → Behavior: checkbox allowing the value in shareable links.

slider_range.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → slider type: label above the minimum, maximum and step fields.

source.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label of the dropdown choosing where a dropdown parameter's choices come from.

source_list.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → Choices come from: entry for a fixed list typed into the definition.

source_none.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → Choices come from: entry for no list (any value can be typed).

step_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → slider type: placeholder in the step field.

time_zone.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → date and time type: label above the time zone field.

time_zone_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → date and time type: placeholder in the time zone field (technical values, keep as is).

title_new.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: title when adding a parameter.

type.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label above the type dropdown.

validation.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog: label above the required checkbox and the bound and length fields.

validation_hint.value: Valor mínimo y máximo, y longitud mínima y máxima. Todos opcionales.
validation_hint.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → Validation: hint under the minimum, maximum, shortest and longest fields.

value_column_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Parameter editor dialog → options query: placeholder in the field naming the column that holds each option's value.

not_enough_runs.location: SQL notebook → Plan cell → parameter sweep: verdict when there are too few runs to judge variation.

no_values.value: Introduzca al menos un valor para el barrido.
no_values.location: SQL notebook → Plan cell → parameter sweep: error when no values are given.

too_many.value: Ese barrido ejecutaría demasiadas consultas. Use menos valores o ejecuciones.
too_many.location: SQL notebook → Plan cell → parameter sweep: error when values × runs is over the limit.

writes.value: Los barridos solo ejecutan consultas de solo lectura.
writes.location: SQL notebook → Plan cell → parameter sweep: error when the swept query changes data.

production_needs_authorization.value: Este barrido se ejecuta en una conexión de producción y necesita su autorización.
production_needs_authorization.location: SQL notebook → Plan cell → parameter sweep: cell message when a production sweep is waiting for authorization.

authorize_production.value: Este barrido repite la consulta en una conexión de producción. ¿Autorizar esta ejecución?
authorize_production.location: SQL notebook → Plan cell → parameter sweep: prompt asking to authorize a sweep on production.

authorize_button.location: SQL notebook → Plan cell → parameter sweep: button that authorizes one production sweep and runs it.

source_label.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: label before the picker of the result or parameter that identifies the row.

source_parameter.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: source picker option that takes the key from a parameter.

table_label.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: label of the input naming the table the row comes from.

table_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: placeholder of the table input.

previous.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: button that moves to the previous row of the source result.

next.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: button that moves to the next row of the source result.

row.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: number of the selected row of the source result.

run.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: button that runs the related-row lookups.

read_only_note.value: Las búsquedas son de solo lectura y muestran como máximo {count} filas cada una.
read_only_note.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: note about the safety of the related-row queries.

relationships.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: heading above the relationships the user can tick.

no_known_relationships.value: No se conocen claves externas para esta tabla. Conéctese y actualice el esquema, o compruebe el nombre de la tabla.
no_known_relationships.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: empty state when no relationships are found.

outgoing.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: label of a relationship to the parent row this table references.

incoming.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: label of a relationship from rows of another table that reference this row.

selected_row.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: heading above the grid with the selected row.

rows.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: number of related rows found.

rows_truncated.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: number of related rows shown when the limit cut the list.

none.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: note when a relationship has no matching rows.

drill.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: button that opens a new detail cell for the related rows.

no_table.value: Indique la tabla de la que procede la fila seleccionada.
no_table.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: error when no table is set.

no_relationships.value: Marque al menos una relación que seguir.
no_relationships.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: error when no relationship is approved.

row_out_of_range.value: El resultado de origen no tiene ninguna fila en esa posición.
row_out_of_range.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: error when the selected row number is past the end.

parameter_missing.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: error when the source parameter is empty.

missing_column.value: La fila seleccionada no tiene la columna {column}.
missing_column.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: error for a relationship whose key column is not in the row.

null_key.value: {column} está vacía en la fila seleccionada, así que no hay nada que buscar.
null_key.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: note for a relationship whose key value is NULL.

unsupported_value.value: {column} contiene un valor que no se puede usar como clave.
unsupported_value.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: error for a key value of an unsupported type.

rows_one.location: SQL notebook → Entity detail cell: number of related rows found. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

tab.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History tab: label of the left rail tab with the notebook's runs.

disabled.value: Las ejecuciones se registran cuando este cuaderno se ejecuta en la aplicación.
disabled.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: note when run history is not available.

empty.value: Aún no hay ejecuciones. Aquí aparece cada ejecución de este cuaderno.
empty.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: empty state before the first run.

pin.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: button that keeps the active cell's result under the typed name.

pin_tooltip.value: Guarda el resultado actual de la celda seleccionada, cifrado en este equipo, para compararlo más adelante.
pin_tooltip.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: tooltip of the Pin snapshot button.

snapshot_name_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: placeholder of the snapshot name input.

pinned.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: status message after a snapshot is pinned.

pin_no_output.value: La celda seleccionada no tiene ningún resultado que fijar.
pin_no_output.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: error when the active cell has nothing to pin.

compare.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: button that compares the two selected runs.

open.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: button that shows the selected run's saved results.

outputs_error.value: No se pueden guardar los resultados de las ejecuciones: {error}
outputs_error.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: warning when the encrypted result store is not available.

outputs_unavailable.value: Los resultados guardados no están disponibles en esta compilación.
outputs_unavailable.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: reason given when results cannot be stored.

run_summary.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: counts of cells that ran and failed.

run_heading.location: SQL notebook → History panel → run row: first line of a past run, joining when it started ({time}, a local date and time) with what was run ({mode}, for example "This cell").

hidden_value.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row and Compare runs panel: shown instead of a sensitive parameter value.

request_cell.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: what the run covered ('This cell').

request_cell_with_inputs.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: what the run covered ('Cell and its inputs').

request_all.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: what the run covered ('Run all').

request_stale.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: what the run covered ('Out-of-date cells').

request_downstream.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: what the run covered ('Dependents').

request_above.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: what the run covered ('Cells above').

request_below.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: what the run covered ('Cells below').

request_selected.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: what the run covered ('Selected cells').

request_other.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: what the run covered ('Command line').

snapshots.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: heading above the list of pinned snapshots.

snapshot_row.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: one pinned snapshot with its cell and row count.

opened_title.location: SQL notebook → past run panel: title of the panel showing a past run's results.

opened_cell.location: SQL notebook → past run panel: heading above one cell's saved result.

output_missing.value: Este resultado no se guardó (es demasiado antiguo o no se pudieron almacenar los resultados).
output_missing.location: SQL notebook → past run panel: note when a cell's saved result is gone.

close.location: SQL notebook → past run and Compare runs panels: button that closes the panel.

snapshot_row_one.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History: one pinned snapshot with its cell and row count. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

opened_cell_one.location: SQL notebook → past run panel: heading above one cell's saved result. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

title.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: title naming the two runs' start times.

notebook_changed.value: El propio cuaderno se editó entre estas ejecuciones.
notebook_changed.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: note when the document differs between the runs.

param_row.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: one changed parameter value.

unset.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: shown for a parameter value that did not exist in one run.

rows_delta.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: row count change of one cell.

rows_same.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: row count of a cell that did not change size.

ok.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: status of a cell that ran successfully in a run.

failed.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: status of a cell that failed in a run.

not_run.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: status of a cell that was not part of a run.

only_after.value: Solo en la ejecución más reciente.
only_after.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation for a cell that ran only in the later run.

only_before.value: Solo en la ejecución más antigua.
only_before.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation for a cell that ran only in the earlier run.

unchanged.value: No se detectaron cambios (no se pudo comprobar el resultado por completo).
unchanged.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation when nothing changed but the result was not checksummed in full.

unchanged_proven.value: Sin cambios: mismas entradas y resultado idéntico.
unchanged_proven.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation when inputs and complete results match.

cause_sql.value: El SQL de la celda cambió.
cause_sql.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation that the cell's query text changed.

cause_spec.value: La configuración de la celda cambió.
cause_spec.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation that a non-SQL cell's configuration changed.

cause_parameters.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation naming the parameters whose values changed.

cause_connection.value: Se ejecutó en otra conexión, base de datos o inicio de sesión.
cause_connection.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation that the connection identity changed.

cause_policy.value: Cambió su configuración de seguridad (solo lectura, límites, caché).
cause_policy.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation that the execution policy changed.

cause_upstream.value: Cambiaron celdas de las que lee: {cells}.
cause_upstream.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation naming upstream cells that changed.

cause_upstream_any.value: Cambió una celda de la que lee.
cause_upstream_any.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation when an upstream cell changed but cannot be named.

cause_data.value: Mismo SQL, parámetros y conexión, pero los datos cambiaron.
cause_data.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation that only the underlying data changed.

cause_unknown.value: Algo cambió, pero la ejecución anterior no registra qué.
cause_unknown.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: explanation when the records lack the details to tell.

same_result.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: added when inputs changed but the complete result is identical.

test_row.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: one check whose result changed between the runs.

rows_same_one.location: SQL notebook → Compare runs panel: row count of a cell that did not change size. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

failing.location: SQL notebook → top bar: chip with the number of failing tests; click to jump to the first.

attention.location: SQL notebook → top bar: chip when no test fails but some warn or are inconclusive.

passing.location: SQL notebook → top bar: chip when every test passes.

run_failing.location: SQL notebook → status bar and activity panel: message after a run with failing tests.

run_passing.value: Ejecución finalizada: las {count} pruebas se superaron o no requieren ninguna acción.
run_passing.location: SQL notebook → status bar and activity panel: message after a run whose tests did not fail.

summary.value: {failing} de {total} pruebas con fallos
summary.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: test results of a run.

failing_one.location: SQL notebook → top bar: chip with the number of failing tests; click to jump to the first. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

attention_one.location: SQL notebook → top bar: chip when no test fails but some warn or are inconclusive. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

passing_one.location: SQL notebook → top bar: chip when every test passes. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

run_failing_one.location: SQL notebook → status bar and activity panel: message after a run with failing tests. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

run_passing_one.value: Ejecución finalizada: {count} prueba se superó o no requiere ninguna acción.
run_passing_one.location: SQL notebook → status bar and activity panel: message after a run whose tests did not fail. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

summary_one.location: SQL notebook → left rail → History → run row: test results of a run. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

created_here.value: Creaste este notebook en este equipo.
created_here.location: Notebook → Trust banner: explains that the notebook is trusted because it was created on this computer.

granted.value: Marcaste este notebook como de confianza en este equipo.
granted.location: Notebook → Trust banner: explains that the notebook is trusted because the user trusted it on this computer.

not_trusted_here.value: Este notebook viene de otro lugar. No se ejecuta nada hasta que confíes en él y elijas las conexiones que puede usar.
not_trusted_here.location: Notebook → Trust banner: shown when an opened notebook was not created or trusted on this computer, so nothing runs yet.

changed_outside_app.value: Las consultas o conexiones de este notebook cambiaron fuera de SQLLY desde que confiaste en él. Revísalo y vuelve a confiar en él para ejecutarlo.
changed_outside_app.location: Notebook → Trust banner: shown when a trusted notebook's queries or connections were changed outside the app, so it is untrusted again.

not_a_grant.value: Elige Confiar o Confiar solo lectura para permitir ejecuciones.
not_a_grant.location: Notebook → Trust dialog: error shown when the user confirms the dialog without choosing a trust level.

unknown_connection.value: El notebook no tiene ninguna conexión llamada "{slot}".
unknown_connection.location: Notebook → Trust dialog: error shown when a chosen connection is not declared in the notebook; {slot} is the notebook's connection name.

missing_notebook_id.value: Este notebook no tiene id, así que no se puede recordar la confianza. Guárdalo primero como archivo .sqllynb.
missing_notebook_id.location: Notebook → Trust dialog: error shown when the notebook has no id to remember trust by.

io.value: No se pudo leer ni guardar la configuración de confianza de notebooks: {detail}
io.location: Notebook → Trust settings: error shown when the trust settings file cannot be read or written; {detail} is the system error.

corrupt.value: La configuración de confianza de notebooks está dañada, así que todos los notebooks se tratan como no confiables hasta que vuelvas a confiar en ellos.
corrupt.location: Notebook → Trust settings: warning shown when the trust settings file is damaged, so every notebook opens untrusted.

newer.value: La configuración de confianza de notebooks se guardó con una versión más reciente de SQLLY, así que aquí todos los notebooks se tratan como no confiables.
newer.location: Notebook → Trust settings: warning shown when the trust settings were written by a newer app version, so every notebook opens untrusted.

production.location: Notebook → Cell header badge: short badge on a cell or run that touches a production connection.

sensitive_data.location: Notebook → Cell header badge: short badge on an export or AI share that includes sensitive data with the user's consent.

untrusted_content.location: Notebook → Cell header badge: short badge on AI context taken from a notebook that is not trusted on this computer.

trust_required.value: Confía en este notebook y elige sus conexiones antes de ejecutarlo.
trust_required.location: Notebook → Run cell: message shown when a cell can't run because the notebook is not trusted yet.

unknown_cell.value: No hay ninguna celda "{cell_id}" en este notebook.
unknown_cell.location: Notebook → Run cell: error shown when the requested cell no longer exists; {cell_id} is the cell's id.

unsupported_kind.value: Las celdas "{kind}" no se pueden ejecutar en esta versión de SQLLY.
unsupported_kind.location: Notebook → Run cell: error shown for a cell kind this version cannot run; {kind} is the cell kind name.

connection_unmapped.value: Elige cuál de tus conexiones debe usar "{slot}".
connection_unmapped.location: Notebook → Run cell: message shown when a notebook connection is not mapped to one of the user's connections; {slot} is the notebook's connection name.

connection_not_authorized.value: Este notebook aún no puede usar "{slot}". Permite la conexión para ejecutar la celda.
connection_not_authorized.location: Notebook → Run cell: message shown when the notebook's trust does not cover this connection (or it was remapped since); {slot} is the notebook's connection name.

read_only_changes_data.value: Esta celda es de solo lectura, pero su SQL modifica datos. Permite cambios en la celda o edita el SQL.
read_only_changes_data.location: Notebook → Run cell: error shown when a read-only cell's SQL would change data.

writes_not_allowed.value: Este notebook es de confianza solo para lectura, así que las celdas que modifican datos no se pueden ejecutar.
writes_not_allowed.location: Notebook → Run cell: error shown when a data-changing cell can't run because the notebook is trusted for read-only runs only.

write_needs_elevation.value: Esta celda modifica datos. Permite cambios en esta celda y revisa el SQL antes de ejecutarla.
write_needs_elevation.location: Notebook → Run cell: message shown before a data-changing cell runs, asking the user to allow changes for that cell.

production_writes_locked.value: Las escrituras en esta conexión de producción están bloqueadas. Desbloquea las escrituras para ejecutar la celda.
production_writes_locked.location: Notebook → Run cell: message shown when a data-changing cell targets a production connection whose writes are locked.

export_disabled.value: La exportación de datos de notebooks está desactivada en tu configuración.
export_disabled.location: Notebook → Export dialog: error shown when exporting notebook data is turned off in settings.

sensitive_data.value: Esto incluye parámetros, columnas o valores sensibles que parecen secretos. Confirma para continuar con ellos eliminados u ocultos.
sensitive_data.location: Notebook → Export dialog: confirmation shown when an export or AI share would include sensitive parameters, columns or secret-looking values.

external_destination_disabled.value: El envío de datos de notebooks a webhooks, correo u otros servicios está desactivado en tu configuración.
external_destination_disabled.location: Notebook → Export dialog: error shown when sending notebook data to webhooks, email or other integrations is turned off in settings.

external_destination.value: Esto envía datos del notebook fuera de SQLLY. Confirma el destino para continuar.
external_destination.location: Notebook → Export dialog: confirmation shown before notebook data is sent to a webhook, email or other integration.

materialize_not_enabled.value: La conexión que usa "{slot}" no permite guardar copias de sus resultados en este equipo. Actívalo en la configuración de la conexión.
materialize_not_enabled.location: Notebook → Materialize locally: error shown when a connection has not opted in to keeping local copies of its results; {slot} is the notebook's connection name.

cloud_model_disabled.value: Compartir contenido de notebooks con modelos de IA en la nube está desactivado en tu configuración.
cloud_model_disabled.location: Notebook → AI assistant: error shown when sharing notebook content with cloud AI models is turned off in settings.

cloud_model_consent.value: Esto comparte contenido del notebook con un modelo de IA en la nube. Revisa lo que se enviará y confirma.
cloud_model_consent.location: Notebook → AI assistant: confirmation shown before notebook content is sent to a cloud AI model.

schedule_needs_full_trust.value: Solo los notebooks de plena confianza pueden ejecutarse de forma programada.
schedule_needs_full_trust.location: Notebook → Schedule dialog: error shown when a notebook that is not fully trusted is scheduled.

schedule_has_write_cells.value: Los notebooks con celdas que modifican datos no pueden ejecutarse de forma programada ({count} celdas así).
schedule_has_write_cells.location: Notebook → Schedule dialog: error shown when a notebook with data-changing cells is scheduled; {count} is the number of such cells.

schedule_production.value: "{slot}" es una conexión de producción. Permite producción de forma explícita para programar este notebook.
schedule_production.location: Notebook → Schedule dialog: error shown when a scheduled notebook uses a production connection without explicit permission; {slot} is the notebook's connection name.

publish_has_write_cells.value: Los notebooks con celdas que modifican datos no se pueden presentar ni publicar como app ({count} celdas así).
publish_has_write_cells.location: Notebook → Present / Publish as app: error shown when a notebook with data-changing cells is presented or published as an app; {count} is the number of such cells.

benchmark_no_runs.value: No hay nada que medir: añade al menos un valor al barrido.
benchmark_no_runs.location: SQL notebook → plan cell → parameter sweep: refusal when the sweep has no values to time.

benchmark_too_many_runs.value: Una prueba de rendimiento puede ejecutar la consulta como máximo {max} veces. Usa menos valores o repeticiones.
benchmark_too_many_runs.location: SQL notebook → plan cell → parameter sweep: refusal when values times repetitions is over the limit; {max} is the most runs allowed.

benchmark_writes_data.value: Esta celda modifica datos, así que no se puede medir: cada ejecución repetiría el cambio.
benchmark_writes_data.location: SQL notebook → plan cell → parameter sweep: refusal when the swept cell changes data.

benchmark_production.value: "{slot}" es una conexión de producción. Autoriza esta prueba de rendimiento de forma explícita para ejecutar la consulta allí varias veces.
benchmark_production.location: SQL notebook → plan cell → parameter sweep: asks for an explicit yes before timing a query repeatedly on a production connection; {slot} is the connection's name in the notebook.

schedule_has_write_cells_one.value: Los notebooks con celdas que modifican datos no pueden ejecutarse de forma programada ({count} celda así).
schedule_has_write_cells_one.location: Notebook → Schedule dialog: error shown when a notebook with data-changing cells is scheduled; {count} is the number of such cells. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

publish_has_write_cells_one.value: Los notebooks con celdas que modifican datos no se pueden presentar ni publicar como app ({count} celda así).
publish_has_write_cells_one.location: Notebook → Present / Publish as app: error shown when a notebook with data-changing cells is presented or published as an app; {count} is the number of such cells. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

sensitive_parameter_removed.value: Se omitió el valor del parámetro sensible "{name}".
sensitive_parameter_removed.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that a sensitive parameter's value was left out of the export; {name} is the parameter name.

sensitive_column_removed.value: Se quitó la columna sensible "{name}" de la celda {cell}.
sensitive_column_removed.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that a sensitive column was removed from a cell's result; {name} is the column, {cell} the cell.

sensitive_column_masked.value: Se ocultó la columna sensible "{name}" en la celda {cell}.
sensitive_column_masked.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that a sensitive column was masked in a cell's result; {name} is the column, {cell} the cell.

secret_in_source.value: Se ocultó algo que parece una contraseña o clave en la celda {cell}.
secret_in_source.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that something that looks like a password or key was hidden in a cell; {cell} is the cell.

secret_in_notebook.value: Se ocultó algo que parece una contraseña o clave en el título o la configuración del notebook.
secret_in_notebook.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that something that looks like a password or key was hidden in the notebook's title or settings.

secret_in_connection.value: Se ocultó algo que parece una contraseña o clave en la conexión "{name}".
secret_in_connection.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that something that looks like a password or key was hidden in a notebook connection; {name} is the notebook's connection name.

secret_in_output.value: Se ocultaron valores que parecen contraseñas o claves en la columna "{name}" de la celda {cell}.
secret_in_output.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that values that look like passwords or keys were hidden in a result column; {name} is the column, {cell} the cell.

incomplete_output.value: El resultado de la celda {cell} está incompleto (muestreado, truncado o detenido antes de tiempo).
incomplete_output.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that a cell's exported result is sampled, truncated or stopped early; {cell} is the cell.

too_large.value: El archivo tiene {count} bytes, más que el límite de {limit} bytes para notebooks.
too_large.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook file is over the size limit; {count} is the file size and {limit} the limit, in bytes.

too_deep.value: El archivo anida datos a más de {limit} niveles de profundidad, así que no se abrió.
too_deep.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook file nests data too deeply; {limit} is the maximum depth.

string_too_long.value: El archivo contiene un valor de más de {limit} bytes, así que no se abrió.
string_too_long.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook file contains one oversized value; {limit} is the maximum length in bytes.

not_json.value: El archivo no es un notebook legible.
not_json.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when the file is not a readable notebook at all.

too_many_cells.value: El notebook tiene {count} celdas, más que el límite de {limit}.
too_many_cells.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook has more cells than allowed; {count} is the number of cells, {limit} the limit.

too_many_parameters.value: El notebook tiene {count} parámetros, más que el límite de {limit}.
too_many_parameters.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook has more parameters than allowed; {count} is the number of parameters, {limit} the limit.

too_many_connections.value: El notebook tiene {count} conexiones, más que el límite de {limit}.
too_many_connections.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook declares more connections than allowed; {count} is the number of connections, {limit} the limit.

embedded_credential.value: Una conexión de este notebook contiene una contraseña o cadena de conexión. Los notebooks solo deben referirse a las conexiones por nombre, así que no se abrió.
embedded_credential.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a connection inside a notebook file contains a password or connection string.

unsafe_path.value: Un adjunto apunta fuera de la carpeta del notebook, así que no se abrió.
unsafe_path.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when an attachment in a notebook file points outside the notebook's folder.

remote_resource.value: Las celdas de texto enlazan a imágenes o páginas de internet. Las imágenes de la web nunca se cargan y los enlaces solo se abren cuando haces clic en ellos.
remote_resource.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when text cells link to images or pages on the internet; web images are never loaded and links open only on click.

active_content.value: Las celdas de texto contienen scripts o páginas incrustadas. Se muestran como texto sin formato y nunca se ejecutan.
active_content.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when text cells contain scripts or embedded pages, which are never run.

auto_run_requested.value: El notebook pide ejecutar celdas automáticamente. No se ejecuta nada hasta que confíes en él.
auto_run_requested.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when the notebook file asks to run cells automatically, which is ignored until trusted.

embedded_outputs.value: El notebook incluye resultados guardados de otra ejecución. Se muestran como una instantánea, no como datos en vivo.
embedded_outputs.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when the notebook file contains saved results from another run, shown as a snapshot.

secret_in_content.value: El notebook contiene algo que parece una contraseña o clave.
secret_in_content.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when the notebook file contains something that looks like a password or key.

key_unavailable.value: Los resultados guardados de notebooks no se pueden cifrar en este equipo, así que solo se conservan hasta que cierres el notebook.
key_unavailable.location: Notebook → Saved results: notice shown when no system keychain is available to encrypt saved notebook results.

io.value: No se pudieron leer ni guardar los resultados del notebook: {detail}
io.location: Notebook → Saved results: error shown when saved notebook results cannot be read or written; {detail} is the system error.

too_large.value: Este resultado tiene {bytes} bytes, más que el límite de {limit} bytes para resultados guardados, así que no se guarda.
too_large.location: Notebook → Saved results: notice shown when a result is too large to be saved; {bytes} is its size and {limit} the limit, in bytes.

unavailable.value: Los datos locales del cuaderno no están disponibles en el navegador. Abre el cuaderno en la aplicación de escritorio para usarlos.
unavailable.location: Browser → Notebook → Local data cell: notice shown in place of a local data cell because the browser build has no local analysis database.

invalid_notebook_id.value: El identificador del cuaderno "{id}" no se puede usar para datos locales.
invalid_notebook_id.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when the notebook's id cannot name its local data folder; {id} is the id.

invalid_relation_name.value: "{name}" no se puede usar como nombre de tabla local. Usa hasta 63 letras, dígitos y guiones bajos, empieza con una letra o un guion bajo y no empieces con _sqlly.
invalid_relation_name.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Materialize locally: error shown when the chosen local table name is not a plain identifier; {name} is the rejected name.

relation_exists.value: Ya existe una tabla local llamada "{name}".
relation_exists.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Materialize locally: error shown when a local table with the chosen name already exists; {name} is the name.

relation_not_found.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when a local table (or a table inside an imported SQLite file) does not exist; {name} is the name.

path_not_found.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import file: error shown when the chosen file no longer exists.

path_not_a_file.value: La ruta no es un archivo normal. Elige un archivo, no una carpeta ni un dispositivo.
path_not_a_file.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import or export file: error shown when the chosen path is a folder or device rather than a file.

path_symlink.value: La ruta es un enlace simbólico. Elige el archivo al que apunta.
path_symlink.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import or export file: error shown when the chosen path is a symbolic link, which is refused for safety.

path_changed.value: El archivo cambió mientras se leía. Inténtalo de nuevo.
path_changed.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import file: error shown when the file was replaced or changed between checking and reading it.

destination_exists.value: El archivo de destino ya existe.
destination_exists.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Export local data: error shown when the export destination file exists and overwriting was not chosen.

destination_folder_missing.value: La carpeta de destino no existe.
destination_folder_missing.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Export local data: error shown when the folder of the export destination does not exist.

file_too_large.value: El archivo tiene {size} bytes, más que el límite de importación de {limit} bytes.
file_too_large.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import file: error shown when the file exceeds the import size limit; {size} and {limit} are byte counts.

export_too_large.value: La exportación tiene {size} bytes, más que el límite de exportación de {limit} bytes.
export_too_large.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Export local data: error shown when the exported file exceeds the export size limit; {size} and {limit} are byte counts.

disk_quota.value: Los datos locales de este cuaderno ocupan {used} bytes y han alcanzado su límite de {limit} bytes. Elimina o vacía tablas locales para liberar espacio.
disk_quota.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when the notebook's local data has reached its disk limit; {used} and {limit} are byte counts.

not_read_only.value: El SQL local solo puede leer datos. Usa consultas como SELECT, WITH, SUMMARIZE o DESCRIBE.
not_read_only.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local SQL cell: error shown when a local query contains a statement that would change data or settings.

file_exchange_unavailable.value: La importación y exportación de archivos está desactivada para los datos locales en este motor.
file_exchange_unavailable.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import or export file: error shown when this engine forbids local data from touching files.

encryption_key.value: Los datos locales de este cuaderno están cifrados y su clave falta o es incorrecta.
