attribution.location: SQL notebook → cell header: text after the AI badge naming the AI cell that created this cell; {cell_name} is that AI cell's name.

attribution_badge.location: SQL notebook → cell header: badge on a cell the notebook agent created, marking it as generated by AI.

collapsed.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: one-line summary shown when the AI cell is collapsed; {mode} is the agent mode name, {count} the number of findings.

kind.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: short kind label in the cell header and the add-cell row for a cell that asks the notebook agent.

prompt_placeholder.value: Pregunta sobre este cuaderno: explicar, planificar, crear, investigar o revisar…
prompt_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: placeholder of the multi-line box where the user types the request for the agent.

provenance.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: small footer under a finished run naming the model provider, the prompt-template version and the run id.

run.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: button that starts the agent for the first time.

run_again.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: button that starts the agent again after an earlier run, replacing its result.

stop.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: button shown while the agent is working; stops the run.

target.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: label next to the Run button naming the cell the request is about; {cell_name} is that cell's name.

collapsed_one.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: one-line summary shown when the AI cell is collapsed; {mode} is the agent mode name, {count} the number of findings. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

ambiguous_aggregate.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: name of one of SQLLY's deterministic checks, shown inside the SQLLY check badge (ambiguous aggregate).

ambiguous_term.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: name of one of SQLLY's deterministic checks, shown inside the SQLLY check badge (ambiguous term).

change_explained.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: name of one of SQLLY's deterministic checks, shown inside the SQLLY check badge (change explained).

fanout_join.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: name of one of SQLLY's deterministic checks, shown inside the SQLLY check badge (fanout join).

missing_filter.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: name of one of SQLLY's deterministic checks, shown inside the SQLLY check badge (missing filter).

sampled_data.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: name of one of SQLLY's deterministic checks, shown inside the SQLLY check badge (sampled data).

security.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: name of one of SQLLY's deterministic checks, shown inside the SQLLY check badge (security).

stale_result.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: name of one of SQLLY's deterministic checks, shown inside the SQLLY check badge (stale result).

timezone.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: name of one of SQLLY's deterministic checks, shown inside the SQLLY check badge (timezone).

hint.value: Responde en la solicitud y vuelve a ejecutar.
hint.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: note under the agent's questions.

title.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: heading over the questions the agent asked instead of guessing.

body.value: Esta ejecución usa un modelo en la nube. Abajo está exactamente lo que envía la primera solicitud. Después, las herramientas del agente pueden añadir resúmenes depurados y resultados de consultas, como máximo {rows} filas en {queries} consultas.
body.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: explanation under the heading when the agent's tools may read result rows; {rows} and {queries} are the run's caps.

body_no_rows.value: Esta ejecución usa un modelo en la nube. Abajo está exactamente lo que envía la primera solicitud. Después, las herramientas del agente pueden leer el texto de las celdas y nombres de tablas, pero ninguna fila de resultados.
body_no_rows.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: explanation under the heading when the mode's tools never read result rows.

cancel.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: button that closes the preview without sending anything.

excluded_column.value: Los valores de la columna {column} en {cell_name}
excluded_column.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: item in the never-sent list for a sensitive-looking result column; {column} is the column, {cell_name} the cell whose result has it.

excluded_credentials.value: Credenciales de conexión y todo lo que parezca una contraseña, clave o token
excluded_credentials.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: item in the never-sent list about credentials and secrets.

excluded_parameter.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: item in the never-sent list for a sensitive notebook parameter; {name} is the parameter name.

excluded_title.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: heading of the list of things that are never sent to the model.

findings.value: Resultados de las comprobaciones de SQLLY
findings.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: small heading over one section of the text that will be sent (findings).

instructions.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: small heading over one section of the text that will be sent (instructions).

notebook_outline.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: small heading over one section of the text that will be sent (notebook outline).

request.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: small heading over one section of the text that will be sent (request).

target_cell.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: small heading over one section of the text that will be sent (target cell).

share.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: button that records consent for this notebook and starts the run.

title.value: ¿Compartir el contexto de este cuaderno con {provider}?
title.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Cloud sharing preview: heading of the panel shown before a cloud model is used for the first time in this notebook; {provider} is the provider and model id.

button.location: SQL notebook → failed SQL cell: button under the error that adds an AI cell explaining the error and proposing a fix.

columns.value: Las columnas de {cell} cambiaron: añadidas {added}, quitadas {removed}.
columns.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding about added and removed result columns; {cell} is the cell, {added} and {removed} are column lists (or none).

connection.value: {cell} cambió porque se ejecutó en otra conexión o con otro inicio de sesión.
connection.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that attributes a cell's change to one cause (connection); {cell} is the cell's name.

data.value: Los datos de {cell} cambiaron: {before} filas antes, {after} ahora.
data.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that a cell's data changed along with its inputs; {cell} is the cell, {before} and {after} the row counts.

data_same_inputs.value: Los datos de {cell} cambiaron: {before} filas antes, {after} ahora, con el mismo SQL, configuración, conexión y parámetros.
data_same_inputs.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that only the data changed (same SQL, settings, connection and parameters); {cell} is the cell, {before} and {after} the row counts.

error_prompt.value: Explica por qué falló esta celda y propón una corrección.
error_prompt.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: prompt text filled in by Explain with AI on a failed cell (the user can edit it).

kind_or_spec.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that attributes a cell's change to one cause (kind or spec); {cell} is the cell's name.

no_baseline.value: No hay una ejecución de IA anterior para comparar; ejecuta esta celda una vez para registrar una referencia.
no_baseline.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding when this AI cell never ran before, so there is nothing to compare with.

not_run.value: {cell} no tiene resultado ahora, así que no se puede comparar.
not_run.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that a cell has no current result to compare; {cell} is the cell.

parameters.value: {cell} cambió porque cambiaron los parámetros que usa.
parameters.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that attributes a cell's change to one cause (parameters); {cell} is the cell's name.

policy.value: {cell} cambió porque cambió su configuración de seguridad o de caché.
policy.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that attributes a cell's change to one cause (policy); {cell} is the cell's name.

result_prompt.value: Explica el resultado de esta celda y qué revisar después.
result_prompt.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: prompt text filled in by Explain with AI on a cell that did not fail, such as a plan cell.

rows_diff.value: Los datos de {cell} cambiaron: {added} filas añadidas, {removed} quitadas, {changed} modificadas ({before} antes, {after} ahora).
rows_diff.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding with a row-by-row comparison; {cell} is the cell, {added}, {removed}, {changed} are row counts, {before} and {after} the totals.

source.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that attributes a cell's change to one cause (source); {cell} is the cell's name.

unchanged.value: {cell} devolvió las mismas {rows} filas que antes.
unchanged.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that a cell returned the same data; {cell} is the cell, {rows} its row count.

upstream.value: {cell} cambió porque cambió una celda de la que lee.
upstream.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that attributes a cell's change to one cause (upstream); {cell} is the cell's name.

plan_prompt.value: Explica este plan de consulta: qué operadores cuestan más, por qué y qué haría más rápida la consulta.
plan_prompt.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: prompt text filled in by Explain with AI on a query plan cell (the user can edit it).

no_run_outputs.value: La ejecución elegida no guardó resultados con los que comparar.
no_run_outputs.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Explain changes findings: finding that the recorded run chosen to compare kept no results.

check_badge.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: badge on a finding SQLLY's own checks produced; {check} is the check's name.

conflicts.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: warning under a finding that states a different value for the same quantity as other findings; {findings} lists their ids.

evidence_cell.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: evidence link button naming a cell result; {cell_name} is the cell, {run} the short run id.

evidence_group.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: evidence label with the row group or aggregate it rests on; {evidence} is the cell or query label, {group} the group such as region = EU.

evidence_query.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: evidence label naming a query the agent ran; {query} is its id such as q1.

evidence_tooltip.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: tooltip of an evidence link button.

derived_metric.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: badge that labels a finding's evidence class (derived metric); the same four classes appear in exports.

hypothesis.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: badge that labels a finding's evidence class (hypothesis); the same four classes appear in exports.

observed_fact.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: badge that labels a finding's evidence class (observed fact); the same four classes appear in exports.

recommendation.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: badge that labels a finding's evidence class (recommendation); the same four classes appear in exports.

title.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: heading of the list of labelled findings.

unverified.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: red badge on a finding whose evidence SQLLY could not confirm.

incomplete_evidence.value: se basa en datos muestreados o parciales
incomplete_evidence.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: short reason after the Unverified badge (incomplete evidence).

no_evidence.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: short reason after the Unverified badge (no evidence).

not_executed.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: short reason after the Unverified badge (not executed).

unknown_evidence.value: cita un resultado que no leyó
unknown_evidence.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: short reason after the Unverified badge (unknown evidence).

value_not_in_evidence.value: el valor no está en sus pruebas
value_not_in_evidence.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Findings: short reason after the Unverified badge (value not in evidence).

unavailable.value: Las celdas de IA se ejecutan en la aplicación de escritorio.
unavailable.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: message in the browser version, where AI cells cannot run.

no_model.value: No hay ningún modelo de IA configurado. Elige un perfil en la nube en Configuración ▸ IA o inicia un entorno local como Ollama.
no_model.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: error shown instead of a result when no AI model is set up (no cloud profile chosen and no local runtime found).

instructions_echoed.value: El modelo respondió con sus propias instrucciones en lugar de una respuesta, así que no se muestra. Revisa el modelo elegido en Configuración ▸ IA.
instructions_echoed.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: error shown when the model's reply (or the provider's error) repeated the agent's own instructions or tool list, which are never shown.

cloud_profile_unavailable.value: No se puede usar el perfil de IA «{profile}» elegido en Configuración ▸ IA: {reason}. No se envió nada.
cloud_profile_unavailable.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: error shown when the AI profile chosen in Settings can't be used; {profile} is the profile's name and {reason} one of the reasons below.

reason_no_model.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: reason inside the unusable-AI-profile error: the profile has no model selected.

reason_no_key.value: no tiene ninguna clave de API guardada
reason_no_key.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: reason inside the unusable-AI-profile error: no API key is saved for the profile.

reason_key_unreadable.value: no se puede leer su clave de API del llavero del sistema
reason_key_unreadable.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: reason inside the unusable-AI-profile error: the profile's API key can't be read from the system keychain.

reason_invalid.value: su configuración de conexión está incompleta
reason_invalid.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: reason inside the unusable-AI-profile error: the profile's connection settings are incomplete.

assist.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: mode button above the prompt that picks what the agent does (one of six modes). In English this one reads “Assist”.

build.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: mode button above the prompt that picks what the agent does (one of six modes). In English this one reads “Build”.

explain_changes.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: mode button above the prompt that picks what the agent does (one of six modes). In English this one reads “Explain changes”.

investigate.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: mode button above the prompt that picks what the agent does (one of six modes). In English this one reads “Investigate”.

plan.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: mode button above the prompt that picks what the agent does (one of six modes). In English this one reads “Plan”.

review.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: mode button above the prompt that picks what the agent does (one of six modes). In English this one reads “Review”.

assist.value: Explica un error, completa o corrige SQL, sugiere un gráfico o interpreta un plan.
assist.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: tooltip of the assist mode button explaining what that mode does.

build.value: Propone celdas, cambios y ejecuciones; tú aceptas o rechazas cada uno.
build.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: tooltip of the build mode button explaining what that mode does.

explain_changes.value: Explica qué cambió desde la última ejecución de esta celda y por qué: SQL, parámetros, conexiones, entradas o datos.
explain_changes.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: tooltip of the explain changes mode button explaining what that mode does.

investigate.value: Ejecuta pocas consultas de solo lectura dentro del presupuesto e informa hallazgos con pruebas.
investigate.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: tooltip of the investigate mode button explaining what that mode does.

plan.value: Escribe un plan de investigación para revisarlo primero. No se ejecuta nada.
plan.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: tooltip of the plan mode button explaining what that mode does.

review.value: Primero se ejecutan las comprobaciones de SQLLY (joins que duplican filas, totales ambiguos, resultados obsoletos o muestreados, zonas horarias) y luego el modelo.
review.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: tooltip of the review mode button explaining what that mode does.

approve.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: button that approves the plan and switches the cell to Build mode to turn it into proposed cells.

approved.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: badge on a plan the user approved.

assumptions.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: label over the plan's assumptions.

concerns.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: label over the plan's cost and safety concerns.

goal.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: label over the plan's goal.

nothing_runs.value: No se ejecuta nada hasta que apruebes.
nothing_runs.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: note next to the approve button.

permissions.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: label over the connections and data access the plan needs.

sources.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: label over the tables and cells the plan uses.

steps.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: label over the numbered plan steps.

title.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Plan: heading of the investigation plan a Plan run produced.

accept.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: button that accepts one proposal (it is applied with Apply accepted).

accepted.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: highlighted accept button of a proposal the user accepted.

applied.value: Se aplicaron {count} propuestas. Deshacer cambios de IA las revierte todas.
applied.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: status message after accepted proposals were applied; {count} is how many.

apply.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: button that applies every accepted proposal as one undoable change; {count} is how many are accepted.

cell_line.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: one line per proposed cell; {kind} is the cell kind id, {name} its proposed name (may be empty), {first_line} its first line.

edit.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: summary of a proposal that changes a cell; {cell_name} is the cell.

insert.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: summary of a proposal that inserts cells; {count} is how many, {cell_name} the cell they go after.

nothing_accepted.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: status message when Apply is pressed with no accepted proposal.

reject.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: button that rejects one proposal.

rejected.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: reject button of a proposal the user rejected.

run.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: summary of a proposal to run read-only cells; {cells} lists their names.

status_applied.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: badge on a proposal that was applied to the notebook.

status_refused.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: badge on a proposal SQLLY refused (for example because it would change data).

this_cell.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: stands in for the cell name in the insert summary when the cells go right after this AI cell.

title.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: heading of the list of cells, edits and runs the agent proposed.

undo.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: button that removes the cells and reverts the edits of the last applied group in one step.

undone.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: status message after the AI changes were undone.

applied_one.value: Se aplicó {count} propuesta. Deshacer cambios de IA la revierte.
applied_one.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: status message after accepted proposals were applied; {count} is how many. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

insert_one.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: summary of a proposal that inserts cells; {count} is how many, {cell_name} the cell they go after. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

failed_line.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Queries the agent ran: line of a query that failed; {query} is its id, {connection} the connection slot.

hide.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Queries the agent ran: button that collapses the list.

line.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Queries the agent ran: one query's line; {query} is its id, {connection} the connection slot, {rows} rows read, {milliseconds} its duration.

show.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Queries the agent ran: button that expands the list.

title.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Queries the agent ran: heading of the collapsible list of read-only queries the agent ran; {count} is how many.

invalid_kind_spec.value: Rechazado: la configuración no describe una celda {kind} válida.
invalid_kind_spec.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused a proposed cell whose settings do not match what that kind of cell reads; {kind} is the kind id.

invalid_spec.value: Rechazado: la configuración de la celda no es un objeto JSON.
invalid_spec.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused a proposed cell whose settings are not a JSON object.

not_runnable.value: Rechazado: {cell} no es una consulta de solo lectura ni una celda local, así que no se puede ejecutar para el agente.
not_runnable.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused to run a cell that is not a read-only query or local cell; {cell} is the cell.

self_edit.value: Rechazado: el agente no puede cambiar su propia celda de IA.
self_edit.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused a proposal that would change an AI cell.

unknown_cell.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused a proposal naming a cell that does not exist; {cell} is the name it used.

unknown_connection.value: Rechazado: {connection} no es una conexión que este cuaderno pueda usar.
unknown_connection.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused a proposed cell on a connection the notebook does not declare; {connection} is the slot it named.

unsupported_kind.value: Rechazado: el agente no puede crear celdas de tipo {kind}.
unsupported_kind.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused a proposed cell of a kind the agent may not create; {kind} is the kind id.

write_cell.value: Rechazado: {cell} puede modificar datos, así que el agente no puede editarla ni ejecutarla.
write_cell.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused to edit or run a cell that is allowed to change data; {cell} is the cell.

write_statement.value: Rechazado: el SQL de {cell} modifica datos. El agente del cuaderno solo puede leer.
write_statement.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused a proposal whose SQL changes data; {cell} is the cell's name.

write_statement_sql.value: Rechazado: este SQL modifica datos. El agente del cuaderno solo puede leer.
write_statement_sql.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused a proposed SQL statement that changes data.

changes_where_it_runs.value: Rechazado: la nueva configuración cambiaría dónde se ejecuta {cell}. Solo usted puede hacerlo.
changes_where_it_runs.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Proposed changes: why SQLLY refused a proposed settings change that would move a cell to local data or another connection; {cell} is the cell's name.

ambiguous_term.value: “{term}” puede significar cosas distintas y el cuaderno no lo define; la respuesta supuso un significado.
ambiguous_term.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY note that the request used a business term the notebook does not define and the answer assumed a meaning; {term} is the term.

cached_result_pinned.value: Este resultado es una copia fijada, no se obtuvo en su última ejecución.
cached_result_pinned.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a result was not fetched by its last run (pinned).

cached_result_snapshot.value: Este resultado proviene de una instantánea guardada, no de una ejecución en vivo.
cached_result_snapshot.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a result was not fetched by its last run (snapshot).

cached_result_ttl.value: Este resultado se reutilizó de la caché, no se obtuvo en su última ejecución.
cached_result_ttl.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a result was not fetched by its last run (ttl).

cached_result_verified.value: Este resultado se reutilizó porque el origen no informó cambios; no se volvió a obtener.
cached_result_verified.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a result was not fetched by its last run (verified).

count_star_join.value: {aggregate} después de un join cuenta filas unidas, no filas de una tabla; usa COUNT(DISTINCT clave) para contar entidades.
count_star_join.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that COUNT(*) after a join counts joined rows; {aggregate} is the aggregate as written.

distinct_aggregate.value: {aggregate} descarta valores repetidos que pueden ser legítimos, como dos pedidos con el mismo importe.
distinct_aggregate.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that SUM or AVG with DISTINCT drops repeated values; {aggregate} is the aggregate as written.

fanout_fix.value: Agrega {many_table} por {key} en una subconsulta antes de calcular {aggregate} y luego únela a {one_table}, para que cada fila de {one_table} cuente una vez.
fanout_fix.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: recommendation paired with the fanout check; placeholders as in the fanout finding.

fanout_join.value: {aggregate} suma cada fila de {one_table} una vez por cada fila coincidente de {many_table}: el join por {key} la repite, así que el total sale inflado.
fanout_join.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that an aggregate over a joined table double counts; {aggregate} is the aggregate as written, {one_table} the table repeated, {many_table} the table it is joined to, {key} the join column.

fanout_rows.value: {column} se repite en este resultado: {rows} filas pero {distinct} valores distintos, así que los totales de {one_table} cuentan doble.
fanout_rows.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check confirmed by the data: a join key repeats in the result; {column} is the key, {rows} its non-empty values, {distinct} distinct values, {one_table} the table it identifies.

missing_filter.value: Esta celda no usa ninguno de los parámetros del cuaderno ({parameters}), mientras otras celdas filtran por ellos.
missing_filter.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a cell ignores the notebook's parameters while other cells use them; {parameters} lists the parameter names.

sampled_data_partial.value: Este resultado se detuvo tras {shown} de {total} filas; los totales y promedios no describen todos los datos.
sampled_data_partial.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a result holds only part of the data (partial); {shown} is the rows kept, {total} the rows that exist.

sampled_data_sample.value: Este resultado es una muestra de {shown} de {total} filas; los totales y promedios no describen todos los datos.
sampled_data_sample.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a result holds only part of the data (sample); {shown} is the rows kept, {total} the rows that exist.

sampled_data_truncated.value: Este resultado conserva las primeras {shown} de {total} filas; los totales y promedios no describen todos los datos.
sampled_data_truncated.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a result holds only part of the data (truncated); {shown} is the rows kept, {total} the rows that exist.

sensitive_columns.value: El resultado incluye columnas que parecen sensibles ({columns}); el contexto de IA y las exportaciones ocultan sus valores.
sensitive_columns.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a result has sensitive-looking columns; {columns} lists them.

stale_result.value: Este resultado está desactualizado: la celda o una de sus entradas cambió después de ejecutarse.
stale_result.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that a cell's result no longer matches its inputs.

timezone.value: {function} usa el reloj y la zona horaria del servidor, así que las fechas cerca de la medianoche pueden desplazarse. Prefiere una función UTC o un parámetro de fecha.
timezone.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check that SQL uses the server's local clock; {function} is the function as written, such as GETDATE().

write_cell.value: Esta celda puede modificar datos; el agente nunca la edita ni la ejecuta.
write_cell.location: SQL notebook → AI cell → Review findings: SQLLY check noting a cell that is allowed to change data.

awaiting_approval.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status after a Plan run: the plan waits for the user to approve it.

completed.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status after a run finished normally.

failed.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status when the model provider failed; {detail} is the provider's error text, untranslated.

failed_empty.value: El modelo no devolvió nada utilizable.
failed_empty.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status when the model answered with nothing usable (no summary, findings or proposals).

needs_clarification.value: El agente necesita una respuesta para continuar
needs_clarification.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status when the agent asked the user a question instead of guessing.

running.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status while the agent works; {turn} is the current model turn, {max} the turn cap.

running_tool.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status while the agent calls a tool; {turn} and {max} are the turn and cap, {tool} is the tool's technical name.

stopped.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status after the user stopped the run.

stopped_cost.value: Detenido: se alcanzó el límite de coste
stopped_cost.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status after SQLLY stopped the run because one budget cap (cost) was used up.

stopped_queries.value: Detenido: se agotó el presupuesto de consultas
stopped_queries.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status after SQLLY stopped the run because one budget cap (queries) was used up.

stopped_rows.value: Detenido: se agotó el presupuesto de filas
stopped_rows.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status after SQLLY stopped the run because one budget cap (rows) was used up.

stopped_runtime.value: Detenido: se agotó el tiempo de consulta
stopped_runtime.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status after SQLLY stopped the run because one budget cap (runtime) was used up.

stopped_tokens.value: Detenido: se agotó el presupuesto de tokens
stopped_tokens.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status after SQLLY stopped the run because one budget cap (tokens) was used up.

stopped_turns.value: Detenido: se alcanzó el límite de turnos
stopped_turns.location: SQL notebook → AI cell: status after SQLLY stopped the run because one budget cap (turns) was used up.

before.location: SQL notebook → AI cell in Explain changes mode: menu button choosing the baseline to compare; {choice} is the chosen baseline (the last AI run or a recorded run).

after.location: SQL notebook → AI cell in Explain changes mode: menu button choosing what the baseline is compared with; {choice} is now or a recorded run.

last_ai_run.value: la última ejecución de esta celda
last_ai_run.location: SQL notebook → AI cell in Explain changes mode → compare menu: the default baseline, the results the last run of this AI cell read.

now.location: SQL notebook → AI cell in Explain changes mode → 'with' menu: compare against the notebook's current results.

run.location: SQL notebook → AI cell in Explain changes mode → compare menus: a recorded run from the run history, by its start time; {started} is the local date and time.

empty.value: Aún no hay nada que mostrar.
empty.location: SQL notebook → Dashboard viewer: message on a section tab with no visible tiles.

empty_editor.value: Usa Añadir mosaico para colocar resultados, gráficos o notas aquí, o arrastra una celda de la lista al lienzo.
empty_editor.location: SQL notebook → Dashboard editor: hint on an empty section tab.

edit.location: SQL notebook → Dashboard cell body: button that opens the dashboard editor.

kind_label.location: SQL notebook → cell header and Add row: short name of the dashboard (layout) cell kind.

present.location: SQL notebook → Dashboard cell in the cell list: button that presents that dashboard full screen, one section at a time.

set_up.location: SQL notebook → Dashboard cell body: button that fills an empty dashboard with tiles for the notebook's result cells.

summary.value: {sections} secciones · {tiles} mosaicos
summary.location: SQL notebook → Dashboard cell body: summary of how many sections and tiles the dashboard has.

view.location: SQL notebook → Dashboard cell body: button that opens the dashboard in viewer mode (outputs only, no SQL).

close.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog: button that closes the dialog.

confirm_cancel.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → sensitive data confirmation: button that goes back to the options.

confirm_detail.value: Los elementos de la lista se quitan u ocultan en el archivo. Continúa solo si el resto puede salir de este equipo.
confirm_detail.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → sensitive data confirmation: explains what continuing does.

confirm_ok.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → sensitive data confirmation: button that continues and asks where to save.

confirm_title.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → sensitive data confirmation: heading of the confirmation panel.

dark_theme.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog: checkbox that renders PDF, SVG and PNG exports in the dark theme.

export_button.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog: primary button that writes the export (asks where to save).

fidelity_none.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: the format carries everything.

fidelity_title.value: Lo que este formato no puede mostrar
fidelity_title.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: heading of what the chosen format cannot show.

file_line.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: one file the export writes, with its size in bytes.

files_title.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: heading of the list of files the export writes.

format_csv.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Format menu: one CSV file per table.

format_html.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Format menu: self-contained web page.

format_jupyter.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Format menu: a clean Jupyter copy of the notebook.

format_label.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog: label of the format menu.

format_markdown.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Format menu: Markdown with chart images.

format_notebook.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Format menu: a clean .sqllynb copy of the notebook for sharing.

format_pdf.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Format menu: paged PDF document.

format_png.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Format menu: one PNG image per chart.

format_svg.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Format menu: one SVG image per chart.

format_xlsx.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Format menu: Excel workbook.

jupyter_other_cells.value: {count} celdas que no son SQL ni Markdown (gráficos, paneles, comprobaciones…) se conservan para SQLLY, pero Jupyter las muestra como texto sin formato.
jupyter_other_cells.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: cells other than SQL and Markdown keep their settings but Jupyter can't show them.

jupyter_outputs.value: No se incluyen resultados; vuelve a ejecutar el cuaderno después de abrirlo.
jupyter_outputs.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: a Jupyter copy carries no results.

menu_item.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Export menu: first item, opens the Export dialog with every format and option.

notebook_note.value: Se omiten los resultados, los datos de conexión de este equipo y su marca de confianza; las conexiones solo conservan su nombre.
notebook_note.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: what a notebook copy leaves out.

page_per_section.value: Empezar cada sección del panel en una página nueva
page_per_section.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog: checkbox for dashboard PDF exports that starts each section on a new page.

personal_removed.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: personal parameter values left out of a notebook copy.

provenance.value: Incluir el origen de cada resultado
provenance.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog: checkbox that includes where each result came from (connection, database, time, query hash).

removed_none.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: nothing sensitive was found.

removed_title.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: heading of what redaction removes before writing.

rows_removed.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → preview: rows left out for a structure-only export.

run_current.location: SQL notebook → Export dialog → Results menu: the results showing in the notebook now.

error_missing_field.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when a request to the server omits a required field; {field} is the technical field name.

error_key_required.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when a request names no translation key.

error_key_not_found.value: La clave «{key}» no existe en el catálogo «{language}».
error_key_not_found.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when the selected key is missing from the language catalog; {language} is the language code.

error_language_unsupported.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when the requested language code is not supported.

error_catalog_missing.value: No se encontró el catálogo «{language}» en el servidor.
error_catalog_missing.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when the server has no catalog file for the language; {language} is the language code.

error_value_empty.value: El texto no puede estar vacío.
error_value_empty.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when the translator tries to save blank wording.

error_value_too_long.value: El texto está limitado a {max} caracteres.
error_value_too_long.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when saved wording is longer than the allowed maximum; {max} is that maximum.

error_notes_too_long.value: Las notas de revisión están limitadas a {max} caracteres.
error_notes_too_long.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when a revision note is longer than the allowed maximum; {max} is that maximum.

error_vote_invalid.value: El voto debe ser a favor, en contra o retirado.
error_vote_invalid.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when a vote request carries a value that is not up, down or withdraw.

error_nothing_to_undo.value: No hay ningún cambio anterior que deshacer.
error_nothing_to_undo.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when Undo last change finds no earlier saved change that still fits the current original wording.

error_changed_since_loaded.value: Este texto cambió después de que lo cargaras. Vuelve a cargar el texto actual e inténtalo de nuevo.
error_changed_since_loaded.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: conflict error when another translator changed the wording after this page loaded it.

error_invalid_format.value: «{key}» tiene una sintaxis de llaves no válida. Para escribir una llave literal, usa {{{{ o }}}}.
error_invalid_format.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when saved wording has unbalanced or malformed braces; {key} is the translation key. The doubled braces in the value show how to write a literal brace.

error_placeholders_missing.value: «{key}» debe conservar los mismos marcadores que el original ({allowed}). Faltan: {missing}. Para escribir una llave literal, usa {{{{ o }}}}.
error_placeholders_missing.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when saved wording drops placeholders of the original; {key} is the translation key, {allowed} the original's placeholders and {missing} the dropped ones.

error_placeholders_unknown.value: «{key}» debe conservar los mismos marcadores que el original ({allowed}). No permitidos: {unknown}. Para escribir una llave literal, usa {{{{ o }}}}.
error_placeholders_unknown.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when saved wording adds placeholders the original does not have; {key} is the translation key, {allowed} the original's placeholders and {unknown} the added ones.

error_placeholders_both.value: «{key}» debe conservar los mismos marcadores que el original ({allowed}). Faltan: {missing}. No permitidos: {unknown}. Para escribir una llave literal, usa {{{{ o }}}}.
error_placeholders_both.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when saved wording both drops and adds placeholders; {key} is the translation key, {allowed} the original's placeholders, {missing} the dropped ones and {unknown} the added ones.

error_placeholders_none_allowed.value: «{key}» no tiene marcadores, pero el texto usa {unknown}. Quítalos o escribe una llave literal como {{{{ o }}}}.
error_placeholders_none_allowed.location: Website → Translation manager → Save status: error when the original wording has no placeholders but the saved wording adds some; {key} is the translation key and {unknown} the added placeholders.

preview_error_language_invalid.value: La vista previa no admite ese idioma
preview_error_language_invalid.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when the preview is asked for a language it does not support. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_command_unknown.value: La vista previa no reconoció el comando
preview_error_command_unknown.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when the preview receives a command type it does not know. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_command_shape.value: La vista previa rechazó un comando con un formato inesperado
preview_error_command_shape.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when a command has missing or extra fields. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_payload_too_large.value: Los datos de traducción superan el tamaño que admite la vista previa (8 MiB)
preview_error_payload_too_large.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when the catalog sent to the preview exceeds its 8 MiB limit. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_queue_full.value: Se acumularon demasiadas actualizaciones antes de que la vista previa estuviera lista
preview_error_queue_full.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when more updates than the preview can hold arrive before it finishes starting. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_not_ready.value: La vista previa aún no está lista
preview_error_not_ready.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when an update reaches the preview before the application has started. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_catalog_invalid.value: La vista previa recibió datos de traducción que no puede leer
preview_error_catalog_invalid.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when the catalog sent to the preview is not a valid nested catalog. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_catalog_key_invalid.value: La vista previa rechazó la clave «{key}»
preview_error_catalog_key_invalid.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when a catalog key segment is not snake_case; {key} is the offending segment. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_catalog_entry_invalid.value: La vista previa rechazó la entrada «{path}» porque no tiene la estructura de una traducción
preview_error_catalog_entry_invalid.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when a catalog entry is not an object with exactly wording and description; {path} is its dotted key. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_catalog_value_invalid.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when a catalog entry has blank wording; {path} is its dotted key. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

preview_error_catalog_location_invalid.location: Website → Translation manager → Preview status: reason when a catalog entry has a blank description; {path} is its dotted key. It is substituted into the {reason} of the preview failure message.

access_sign_in_title.value: Inicia sesión para usar el traductor
access_sign_in_title.location: Website → Translation manager → Sign-in screen: heading shown instead of the translator to visitors who are not signed in.

access_sign_in_body.value: El traductor permite a los hablantes nativos corregir los textos de SQLly directamente en la aplicación. Necesitas iniciar sesión para usarlo. Inicia sesión o crea una cuenta gratuita y, después, solicita acceso como traductor.
access_sign_in_body.location: Website → Translation manager → Sign-in screen: paragraph under the heading explaining what the translator is, that signing in is required to use it, and that translator access is requested after signing in.

access_sign_in_button.location: Website → Translation manager → Sign-in screen: primary button that opens the sign-in page and returns to the translator afterwards. Short verb.

access_create_account.location: Website → Translation manager → Sign-in screen: secondary button that opens account registration and returns to the translator afterwards.

access_learn_more.location: Website → Translation manager → Sign-in and request-access screens: link to the documentation page that shows how the translator works.

access_request_title.location: Website → Translation manager → Request-access screen: heading shown to signed-in visitors whose account does not have the translator role yet.

access_request_body.value: Tu cuenta todavía no tiene acceso de traductor. Dime qué idiomas hablas como nativo y lo activaré.
access_request_body.location: Website → Translation manager → Request-access screen: paragraph saying the account has no translator access yet and asking which languages the visitor speaks natively; the site owner (“I”) switches access on.

access_languages_label.location: Website → Translation manager → Request-access screen: heading above the checkboxes for the languages the visitor speaks natively.

access_note_label.location: Website → Translation manager → Request-access screen: label of the optional free-text box sent with the request to the site owner (“I”).

access_request_button.location: Website → Translation manager → Request-access screen: primary button that sends the translator access request.

access_request_sent.value: ¡Gracias! Tu solicitud está en camino. Te escribiré a {email} en cuanto active tu acceso.
access_request_sent.location: Website → Translation manager → Request-access screen: confirmation shown after the request is sent; {email} is the visitor's account email address, where the site owner (“I”) will reply.

access_languages_required.location: Website → Translation manager → Request-access screen: error shown when the request is sent without choosing any language.

access_request_failed.value: No se pudo enviar tu solicitud. Inténtalo de nuevo en unos minutos.
access_request_failed.location: Website → Translation manager → Request-access screen: error shown when the request email could not be sent.

acknowledgments_header.location: About SQLLY → Acknowledgments: heading above the open-source community introduction and grouped dependency credits.

acknowledgments_intro.location: About SQLLY → Acknowledgments: introductory paragraph thanking the open-source community and explaining that each credited project has its own license.
acknowledgments_intro.value: SQLLY se basa en el trabajo de la comunidad de código abierto. Agradecemos sinceramente los proyectos siguientes: sin ellos, SQLLY no existiría. Cada uno se utiliza conforme a los términos de su respectiva licencia.

check_updates_button.location: About SQLLY → Update status: button that starts a new check for application updates.

checking_updates.location: About SQLLY → Update status: progress message shown while the application contacts the update service.

checking_updates_button.location: About SQLLY → Update status: disabled button label shown while an update check is already running.

download_update.location: About SQLLY → Update status: link beside an available-version message that opens the appropriate installer download.

async_runtime.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies: group heading for asynchronous runtime and concurrency libraries.
async_runtime.value: Entorno de ejecución asíncrono y concurrencia

database_connectivity.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies: group heading for database drivers and network connectivity libraries.

diagnostics.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies: group heading for logging, tracing, and benchmarking libraries.

icons_assets.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies: group heading for bundled visual assets and icon collections.

platform.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies: group heading for language runtimes and embedded platform components.

serialization_data.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies: group heading for serialization and data-structure libraries.

utilities.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies: group heading for general-purpose utility libraries.

license_breakdown_prefix.location: About SQLLY → Application summary: text immediately before the sqlly.app/licenses link to the complete third-party license listing.
license_breakdown_prefix.value: Consulta el desglose completo de licencias en

async_trait.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → async-trait: explanation of the credited asynchronous trait support.
async_trait.value: Métodos asíncronos ergonómicos en traits de todo el motor.

bitflags.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → bitflags: explanation of the credited typed bit flags used by the parser.
bitflags.value: Conjuntos tipados de indicadores de bits usados en todo el analizador.

bytes.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → bytes: explanation of the credited byte buffers used for network input and output.
bytes.value: Gestión eficiente de búferes de bytes para la E/S de red.

chrono.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → chrono: explanation of the credited date and time handling.
chrono.value: Gestión de fechas y horas para los resultados de consultas y los registros.

clap.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → clap: explanation of the credited command-line argument parser.
clap.value: Análisis de argumentos de línea de comandos para la CLI de SQLLY.

criterion.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → criterion: explanation of the credited statistics-driven benchmarking tools.
criterion.value: Mediciones comparativas basadas en estadísticas para rutas críticas de rendimiento.

dashmap.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → dashmap: explanation of the credited concurrent map used for shared engine state.
dashmap.value: Mapa hash concurrente para el estado compartido del motor.

duckdb_crate.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → duckdb crate: explanation of the credited Rust bindings for embedded DuckDB connections.
duckdb_crate.value: Enlaces de DuckDB incluidos para conexiones DuckDB dentro del proceso.

duckdb_platform.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → DuckDB: explanation of the credited embedded analytical database engine.
duckdb_platform.value: Motor analítico de bases de datos integrado incluido mediante el crate duckdb.

futures.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → futures: explanation of the credited asynchronous composition abstractions.
futures.value: Abstracciones asíncronas básicas para componer trabajo concurrente.

hugeicons.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → Hugeicons: explanation of the credited bundled icon collection.
hugeicons.value: Conjunto de iconos que muestran todas las aplicaciones SQLLY, incorporado desde la colección gratuita.

fira_code.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → Fira Code: explanation of the credited bundled monospaced editor font.
fira_code.value: Fuente monoespaciada del editor incluida, con ligaduras.

gpui.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → GPUI: explanation of the credited UI framework.
gpui.value: Framework de interfaz acelerado por GPU de Zed Industries que dibuja todas las ventanas de SQLLY.

gpui_component.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → gpui-component: explanation of the credited widget library.
gpui_component.value: Biblioteca de widgets de Longbridge para GPUI: campos, menús, diálogos, tablas y la superficie del editor.

jetbrains_mono.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → JetBrains Mono: explanation of the credited bundled monospaced editor font.

lucide.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → Lucide: explanation of the credited icon set used by widgets and the browser edition.
lucide.value: Iconos que dibujan los widgets de gpui-component y la edición para navegador; algunos derivan de Feather (MIT, Cole Bemis).

noto_sans.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → Noto Sans: explanation of the credited interface fonts embedded in the browser edition.
noto_sans.value: Fuentes de interfaz de la edición para navegador (subconjuntos latino, griego, cirílico, chino, japonés y coreano).

indexmap.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → indexmap: explanation of the credited insertion-ordered maps.
indexmap.value: Mapas ordenados por inserción para obtener resultados deterministas.

mysql_async.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → mysql_async: explanation of the credited MySQL and MariaDB wire client.
mysql_async.value: Cliente nativo del protocolo de MySQL para MySQL, MariaDB y sus servicios compatibles.

odpi_c.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → ODPI-C: explanation of the credited Oracle C driver layer and separately installed Instant Client.
odpi_c.value: Capa de controlador C de Oracle integrada en el crate oracle; el Oracle Instant Client que carga se instala por separado.

oracle.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → oracle crate: explanation of the credited Oracle Database bindings and Instant Client loading.
oracle.value: Enlaces de ODPI-C para Oracle Database; carga Oracle Instant Client gratuito al conectarse.

parking_lot.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → parking_lot: explanation of the credited synchronization primitives.
parking_lot.value: Primitivas de sincronización rápidas y compactas.

redis.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → redis crate: explanation of the credited RESP client and supported Redis-compatible services.
redis.value: Cliente RESP para conexiones con Redis, Valkey, KeyDB, DragonflyDB, Amazon ElastiCache y MemoryDB.

reqwest.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → reqwest: explanation of the credited HTTP client used for ClickHouse and libSQL connections.
reqwest.value: Cliente HTTP para la interfaz HTTP de ClickHouse y la canalización Hrana de libSQL / Turso.

rusqlite.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → rusqlite: explanation of the credited SQLite bindings.
rusqlite.value: Enlaces de SQLite incluidos para conexiones SQLite y el motor de modelos local.

rust.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → Rust: explanation of the credited programming language used for the engine and command-line application.
rust.value: Lenguaje de sistemas en el que están escritos el motor y la CLI de SQLLY.

serde.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → serde: explanation of the credited serialization framework.
serde.value: Framework para serializar y deserializar los datos del motor.

serde_json.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → serde_json: explanation of the credited JSON support for client-engine communication.
serde_json.value: Compatibilidad con JSON para el protocolo entre cliente y motor.

smallvec.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → smallvec: explanation of the credited small-vector optimization used in the tokenizer.
smallvec.value: Vectores pequeños asignados en la pila en las rutas críticas del tokenizador.

sqlite.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → SQLite: explanation of the credited embedded database engine.
sqlite.value: Motor de bases de datos integrado incluido mediante rusqlite.

thiserror.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → thiserror: explanation of the credited structured-error derive macros.
thiserror.value: Macros derive para errores estructurados de bibliotecas.

tiberius.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → tiberius: explanation of the credited Microsoft SQL Server wire client.
tiberius.value: Cliente TDS nativo para comunicarse con Microsoft SQL Server.

tokio.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → tokio: explanation of how the credited asynchronous runtime is used.
tokio.value: Entorno de ejecución asíncrono que impulsa el motor de consultas y las comunicaciones TDS.

tokio_postgres.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → tokio-postgres: explanation of the credited PostgreSQL wire client.
tokio_postgres.value: Cliente nativo del protocolo de PostgreSQL para PostgreSQL y sus servicios compatibles.

tokio_util.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → tokio-util: explanation of the credited compatibility and codec utilities.
tokio_util.value: Utilidades de compatibilidad y códecs basadas en Tokio.

tracing.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → tracing: explanation of the credited structured logging framework.
tracing.value: Registro estructurado y contextual para el motor.

tracing_subscriber.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → tracing-subscriber: explanation of the credited trace collection and formatting.
tracing_subscriber.value: Recopila y da formato a la salida de seguimiento del motor.

uuid.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → uuid: explanation of the credited unique identifier generation.
uuid.value: Identificadores únicos para sesiones y solicitudes.

store_update_status.location: About SQLLY → Update status: message replacing update controls in a store edition whose updates are installed by the named app store.
store_update_status.value: Edición de {store_name}: las actualizaciones llegan a través de {store_name}.

up_to_date.location: About SQLLY → Update status: successful result stating that the installed version is current.
up_to_date.value: Ya tienes la versión más reciente (v{version}).

update_available.location: About SQLLY → Update status: notification naming the newer application version available for download.

update_service_unreachable.location: About SQLLY → Update status: failure message shown when the update service cannot be contacted.
update_service_unreachable.value: No se pudo contactar con el servicio de actualizaciones.

version.location: About SQLLY → Application summary: application name and installed version shown at the top of the panel.

duckdb_bundled.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → DuckDB: version and qualifier indicating that DuckDB is bundled with the application.

hugeicons_free_set.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → Hugeicons: version qualifier identifying the bundled free icon collection.

odpi_bundled.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → ODPI-C: version qualifier indicating that ODPI-C is bundled with the application.

sqlite_bundled.location: About SQLLY and Open Source Licenses → Dependencies → SQLite: version qualifier indicating that SQLite is bundled with the application.

window_title.location: SQLLY → About SQLLY window: native title-bar caption for the application information and acknowledgments window.

standalone_build.location: Status bar → account button (and the Account command): warning in the status bar and a toast when the user tries to sign in or open their account. Shown only in standalone builds (compiled with the standalone option), which never contact sqlly.app.
standalone_build.value: Las cuentas están deshabilitadas en esta compilación independiente: nunca se conecta a sqlly.app, así que no hay nada en lo que iniciar sesión.

manage.location: Account dialog → Footer buttons: left-hand button that closes the dialog and opens the SQLLY store sign-in window to manage the account online. Trailing ellipsis means another window opens.

sign_out.location: Account dialog → Footer buttons: button next to “Manage account…” that signs the current user out of their SQLLY account on this device.

unlock.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: highlighted upgrade button shown on free-tier accounts in editions that sell outside the web store (e.g. Mac App Store); opens the purchase screen.

view_plans.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: highlighted upgrade button shown on free-tier accounts in the web-store edition; opens the page listing paid plans.

title.location: Account dialog → Title bar: window title of the dialog opened from the account icon, showing the signed-in identity, subscription status and account actions. Noun.

copied.location: Account dialog → Signed-in identity: small green confirmation shown briefly beside the device ID after the copy icon is clicked, meaning the ID is on the clipboard.

copy_device_tooltip.location: Account dialog → Signed-in identity: tooltip on the small copy icon beside the device ID line; clicking copies this device’s identifier to the clipboard.

device.location: Account dialog → Signed-in identity: dimmed line under the email address identifying this computer; {device_id} is the device identifier registered with the account.

no_email.location: Account dialog → Signed-in identity: placeholder shown in place of the email address when the signed-in account has no email recorded. Shown in parentheses.

signed_in.location: Account dialog → Signed-in identity: bold heading beside the green status dot at the top of the dialog, stating the user is currently signed in.

delete.location: Account dialog → Links row: small link after “Terms of Use” that opens the web page for permanently deleting the SQLLY account. Ellipsis means a web page opens.

privacy.location: Account dialog → Links row: first small link at the bottom of the dialog; opens the SQLLY privacy policy in the web browser. Document title.

terms.location: Account dialog → Links row: small link between “Privacy Policy” and “Delete Account…”; opens the SQLLY terms of use in the web browser. Document title.

feedback_throttled_device.location: SQLLY account and store requests → feedback upload status: reason, filled into the status-bar message, shown when a feedback upload hit a rate limit because this device has sent the most feedback sqlly.app accepts from one device per day; the report is kept and sent automatically later.
feedback_throttled_device.value: este dispositivo ha alcanzado su límite diario de comentarios

feedback_throttled_network.location: SQLLY account and store requests → feedback upload status: reason, filled into the status-bar message, shown when a feedback upload hit a rate limit because the network's public IP address has sent the most feedback sqlly.app accepts from one network per day; the report is kept and sent automatically later.
feedback_throttled_network.value: tu red ha alcanzado su límite diario de comentarios

feedback_throttled_global.location: SQLLY account and store requests → feedback upload status: reason, filled into the status-bar message, shown when a feedback upload hit a rate limit because sqlly.app has received the most feedback it accepts from everyone per day; the report is kept and sent automatically later.
feedback_throttled_global.value: sqlly.app ha alcanzado su límite diario total de comentarios

feedback_throttled_request_rate.location: SQLLY account and store requests → feedback upload status: reason, filled into the status-bar message, shown when a feedback upload hit a rate limit because the app sent too many requests to sqlly.app within a minute; the report is kept and sent automatically later.
feedback_throttled_request_rate.value: demasiadas solicitudes a sqlly.app en poco tiempo

feedback_unsigned.location: SQLLY account and store requests → feedback upload status: error shown when a feedback report cannot be sent because this build was compiled without the feedback signing key.
feedback_unsigned.value: Esta compilación no puede firmar comentarios (se compiló sin la clave de firma de comentarios), así que sqlly.app no los aceptará.

standalone_build.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel, Cloud Relay connection setup and feedback upload status: error shown when any request to sqlly.app is attempted. Shown only in standalone builds (compiled with the standalone option), which never contact sqlly.app.
standalone_build.value: Esta compilación independiente no se conecta a sqlly.app, así que las cuentas, los comentarios, la búsqueda de actualizaciones y Cloud Relay están desactivados.

browser_unsupported.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when a store sign-in or account request is attempted from the browser preview, which cannot reach the store; tells the user to use the desktop app.
browser_unsupported.value: El inicio de sesión en la tienda no está disponible en la vista previa del navegador. Usa la aplicación de escritorio.

http_status.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when the SQLLY store rejects a request without an explanation; {status} is the numeric HTTP status code, e.g. 500.

machine_id_unavailable.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when the app cannot read a stable identifier for this computer, which the store needs to register the device.
machine_id_unavailable.value: No se pudo leer un identificador estable de este equipo.

network.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when a request to the SQLLY store never completes (offline, DNS, TLS or timeout).
network.value: No se pudo conectar con la tienda de SQLLY. Revisa tu conexión a internet.

unexpected_response.location: SQLLY account and store requests → Sign-in window, account panel and feedback upload status: error shown when the SQLLY store answers successfully but the response body cannot be read by this version of the app.
unexpected_response.value: La tienda envió una respuesta que la aplicación no entendió.

access_until.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line under the status for a plan that will not renew; {date} is the date access ends (e.g. “Mar 4, 2027”).

active.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: green status label beside the plan name meaning the subscription currently grants paid access. Adjective describing the subscription.

comped.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line under the status when the account was granted free paid access by SQLLY and no reason was recorded.

comped_with_reason.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line under the status when SQLLY granted free paid access; {reason} is the note explaining why (e.g. a partner or promotion).

free_tier.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: bold heading shown when the signed-in account has no subscription at all, naming the free plan the user is on.

inactive.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: amber status label beside the plan name when the subscription exists but no longer grants access (e.g. cancelled or expired).

load_failed.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: red error shown with a “Try again” button when the store server returned an error loading the subscription; {error} is that server message.
load_failed.value: No se pudo cargar tu suscripción: {error}

loading.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed progress text shown while the subscription details are being fetched from the SQLLY store after the dialog opens.

macos_only.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed note under the renewal line when the plan (such as a Mac App Store purchase) only licenses SQLLY on macOS computers.
macos_only.value: Licencia de SQLLY solo para tus Macs.

no_active.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: explanatory sentence under the “Free tier” heading, above the upgrade button, telling the user they have not subscribed yet.
no_active.value: Aún no tienes una suscripción activa.

past_due.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: red status label beside the plan name when the latest subscription payment failed and is overdue. Short status adjective.

platforms_only.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed note when the plan is limited to certain operating systems; {platforms} is a comma-separated list such as “Windows, Linux”.

renews.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line under the status for an auto-renewing plan when no price is shown (e.g. App Store edition); {date} is the next renewal date.

renews_with_price.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: dimmed line for an auto-renewing web-store plan; {date} is the next renewal date and {amount} the charge in dollars, e.g. “$7.00”.

retry.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: button beside the red load-error message that fetches the subscription details again from the SQLLY store.

task_failed.location: Account dialog → Subscription section: red error shown when the subscription request could not complete at all (internal task failure, not a server reply); {error} is the technical cause.
task_failed.value: No se pudo cargar tu suscripción: {error}

signed_in.location: Query toolbar → Account icon at the far right: tooltip when signed in but the account has no email on file; clicking the icon opens the Account dialog.

signed_in_as.location: Query toolbar → Account icon at the far right: tooltip when signed in; {email} is the account email address, and clicking the icon opens the Account dialog.
signed_in_as.value: Sesión iniciada como {email}: ver tu suscripción

signed_out.location: Query toolbar → Account icon at the far right: tooltip when nobody is signed in; clicking the icon opens the SQLLY store sign-in window.
signed_out.value: Sin sesión iniciada: haz clic para iniciar sesión

age_days.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: relative age after the mode name for conversations updated a day or more ago; {count} is the number of days. Very short abbreviation.

age_hours.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: relative age for conversations updated 1 to 23 hours ago; {count} is the number of hours. Very short abbreviation.

age_just_now.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: relative age shown after the mode name when the conversation was updated less than a minute ago. Lowercase fragment.

age_minutes.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: relative age for conversations updated 1 to 59 minutes ago; {count} is the number of minutes. Very short abbreviation.

export_assistant_heading.location: AI panel → History list → Export to Markdown: section heading written in the exported Markdown file and clipboard copy above each reply from the AI assistant.

export_header.location: AI → Conversation History → Markdown export: heading containing the conversation title, server, database, lane, and update timestamp, including its trailing newline.
export_header.value:
# {title}

Servidor: {server} · Base de datos: {database} · Modo: {lane} · Actualizado: {updated_at}

export_pinned_context.location: AI → Conversation History → Markdown export: optional pinned-context paragraph, including its leading and trailing newlines.

export_tool_heading.location: AI panel → History list → Export to Markdown: section heading written in the exported Markdown above each tool call or tool result the AI made during the conversation.

export_user_heading.location: AI panel → History list → Export to Markdown: section heading written in the exported Markdown above each message the user typed. Noun for the human participant.

history_relative.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: format joining {lane} (the mode, e.g. “Generate”) and {age} (relative time such as “3h ago”) with a middle dot.

history_timestamp.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: fallback format used when the saved time cannot be parsed; {lane} is the mode name and {updated_at} the raw saved timestamp.

lane_ask.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: name of the Ask mode (questions about the schema) in which the saved conversation took place. Short noun-like label.

lane_generate.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: name of the Generate mode (writing SQL from a description) in which the saved conversation took place.

lane_joins.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: name of the Joins mode (finding join paths between tables) in which the saved conversation took place.

lane_search.location: AI panel → History list → Conversation row subtitle: name of the Search mode (finding schema objects) in which the saved conversation took place. Short label.

new_chat_title.location: AI panel → History list: default title given to a saved conversation whose first user message is empty or not yet written; later replaced by that message’s first line.

cancel_button.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block under a SQL reply: small button beside “Running…” that stops the query started with “Run here”.

footer_cancelled.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer status after the user cancelled the inline query; {row_count} is the number of rows received before stopping.

footer_capped.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer when more rows existed than the inline limit; {row_cap} is the row limit shown (e.g. 200), {elapsed} the run time (e.g. “1.2 s”).

footer_done.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer after the inline query finished; {row_count} is the number of rows returned and {elapsed} the run time (e.g. “34 ms”).

footer_error.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer status line beside the “Open in results tab” button when the inline query failed; {message} is the database or timeout error.

footer_production.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: footer suffix added when the connection is marked as production; {footer} is the normal footer status, e.g. “12 rows · 34 ms”.

history_cancelled.location: AI panel → Chat: note added to the conversation below a SQL reply after its inline run was cancelled; {row_count} is the number of rows received before stopping.
history_cancelled.value: Ejecución en línea: cancelada después de {row_count} filas

history_done.location: AI panel → Chat: note added to the conversation below a SQL reply after its inline run finished; {row_count} is the rows returned and {elapsed} the run time.

history_failed.location: AI panel → Chat: note added to the conversation below a SQL reply when its inline run failed; {message} is the error, such as a timeout or database error.

no_rows.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: empty-state text in place of the grid when the inline query returned or has so far received no rows.

not_select.location: AI panel → Chat → SQL reply actions: fallback tooltip on the disabled “Run here” button explaining the SQL is not a read-only SELECT, so it cannot run inline. Lowercase fragment.

open_results_button.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: small button at the right of the footer that opens the full inline query result in a regular Results tab of the workbench.

result_error.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: body text shown in place of the grid when the inline query failed; {message} is the database or timeout error.

running_status.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: progress text shown beside the Cancel button while the inline query runs, and as the footer during the run.

timeout.location: AI panel → Chat → Inline result block: error reason shown when the inline query was cancelled because it ran longer than 30 seconds. Lowercase fragment shown after “Error:”.
timeout.value: se agotó el tiempo de espera después de 30 segundos
