focus_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly focus:” comment does not give a valid result set number, so the result-tab focus is ignored. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.
focus_invalid.value: Esta directiva focus se ignora: se esperaba un número de conjunto de resultados basado en 1 (`-- sqlly focus: 2`).

format_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly format:” column format comment has the right prefix but an unparseable body; points to the Help menu reference. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.
format_invalid.value: Esta directiva format se ignora: se esperaba `-- sqlly format: column=<name>; <format>` (consulta Ayuda ▸ Directivas de formato).

format_spacing.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a format comment is written “--sqlly format” without the space after the two dashes, so it is not applied. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.
format_spacing.value: Esta directiva format se ignora: necesita la escritura exacta `-- sqlly format:` (con un espacio después de `--`).

grid_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly grid:” layout comment (column order, hide, freeze, sort, filter) cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.
grid_invalid.value: Esta directiva grid se ignora: {error} (se esperaba `-- sqlly grid [<n>]: order=<cols>; hide=<cols>; freeze=<n>; sort=<col> [desc]; group=<col>; filter=<col> <op> <value>; label=<col>:<column|off>`).

lines_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly lines:” comment is not a row count in range; {maximum} is the largest allowed number of visible rows. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.
lines_invalid.value: Esta directiva lines se ignora: se esperaba un número de filas entre 1 y {maximum} (`-- sqlly lines: 10` o `-- sqlly lines 2: 10`).

not_first_line.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a view or canvas directive appears below the first non-empty line of the query, where it has no effect.
not_first_line.value: Esta directiva se ignora aquí: solo se reconoce en la primera línea no vacía de la consulta.

not_standalone.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a directive is written after SQL code on the same line instead of on a line of its own, so it has no effect.
not_standalone.value: Esta directiva se ignora aquí: solo se reconoce cuando el comentario ocupa toda la línea.

param_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly param:” query parameter declaration cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.
param_invalid.value: Esta directiva param se ignora: {error} (se esperaba `-- sqlly param: @name <type> [= default]`).

set_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly set” value assignment cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.
set_invalid.value: Esta directiva set se ignora: {error} (se esperaba `-- sqlly set <name> = <value>`).

unknown_layout.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly layout:” comment names a result layout other than stacked, tabbed or canvas. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.
unknown_layout.value: Diseño desconocido: se esperaba `-- sqlly layout: stacked`, `-- sqlly layout: tabbed` o `-- sqlly layout: canvas`.

unknown_view.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly view:” comment names a result view other than grid, pivot or chart. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.
unknown_view.value: Vista desconocida: se esperaba `-- sqlly view: grid`, `-- sqlly view: pivot`, `-- sqlly view: chart` o `-- sqlly view: map`.

unrecognized.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a comment starts with the SQLLY directive prefix but matches no known directive; points to the Help menu reference.
unrecognized.value: No es una directiva SQLLY reconocida: consulta Ayuda ▸ Directivas de formato para ver las formas admitidas.

action_enabled_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: checkbox label below the template body; when ticked, the saved template also appears as an action under Custom Actions in the database explorer’s right-click menu.
action_enabled_label.value: Mostrar en el menú contextual del explorador (Acciones personalizadas)

action_run_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: checkbox label shown once the explorer-action box is ticked; when ticked the action runs the SQL at once instead of opening it in a query tab, and non-read-only SQL still asks for confirmation first.
action_run_label.value: Ejecutar inmediatamente (valor predeterminado: abrir en una pestaña de consulta para revisión; cualquier SQL que no sea de solo lectura solicita confirmación primero)

body_help.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: help paragraph above the template body text area explaining <name,type,default> parameters and the {server}/{database}/{schema}/{object}/{kind} tokens; keep the brace tokens and :literal/:raw suffixes untranslated.
body_help.value: Cuerpo: los marcadores como <name,type,default> se convierten en parámetros al guardar; una acción del explorador solicita primero sus valores y los rellena con los predeterminados. {server}, {database}, {schema} y {object} se completan desde el objeto seleccionado como identificadores entre comillas, y {kind} como su tipo. Añade :literal para una cadena entre comillas ({object:literal}) o :raw para el texto sin procesar ({object:raw}, sin escape).

body_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: example SQL shown greyed in the empty template body text area, illustrating the <name,type,default> parameter syntax; it is SQL code and should normally stay as is.

cancel_edit_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: footer button shown while creating or editing a user template; discards the form and returns to browsing templates without saving.

catalog_read_failed.location: Template Explorer and explorer Custom Actions → Template catalog load error: error shown when the saved user-template file exists but cannot be parsed (for example it is corrupt); {error} is the technical parse error.
catalog_read_failed.value: No se pudo leer el catálogo de plantillas del usuario: {error}

category_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: short field label to the left of the Category input, the second field after Name.

category_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: greyed hint inside the empty Category input explaining that a template with no category is filed under the “My Templates” group in the list.

delete_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: footer button at the far left, shown only when a user-created template is selected; permanently removes that template (built-in templates cannot be deleted).

permission_redis.location: Activity Monitor → Load error: permission guidance for Redis activity views.
permission_redis.value: Las sesiones de Redis proceden de CLIENT LIST y la vista Consultas costosas de SLOWLOG GET; el usuario ACL necesita +client, +slowlog y +info, además de CLIENT KILL para terminar una sesión.

permission_sql_server.location: Activity Monitor → Load error: permission guidance for SQL Server and Azure SQL activity views.
permission_sql_server.value: Las vistas de actividad de SQL Server suelen requerir VIEW SERVER STATE (o VIEW DATABASE STATE en las vistas compatibles de Azure SQL).

permission_unsupported.location: Activity Monitor → Load error: explanation shown when the connected engine has no supported activity monitor.
permission_unsupported.value: Este motor no ofrece un monitor de sesiones en directo compatible.

production_write_block.location: Activity Monitor → Redis configuration: warning shown when the production lock prevents CONFIG writes.
production_write_block.value: El entorno de producción es de solo lectura: desbloquea las escrituras (1/5/15 min) desde el indicador de la barra de estado o la paleta de comandos para cambiar la configuración del servidor aquí.

profiler_apply_cap_button.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Toolbar: button applying the command ring-cap value.

profiler_banner.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler: banner explaining dedicated connections, bounded capture, filtering, time box, and shutdown behavior.
profiler_banner.value: MONITOR transmite cada comando que ejecuta el servidor mediante su propia conexión; el editor sigue rechazando MONITOR. La captura está limitada: se conservan las {cap} entradas más recientes y las más antiguas se descartan al desbordar ({dropped} descartadas hasta ahora), por lo que un servidor de mucho tráfico puede superarla y faltar entradas. La tabla muestra las {display_cap} entradas más recientes que pasan el filtro, primero las más nuevas. La captura se detiene al cumplirse el límite de tiempo (Detener después de, ahora {seconds} s, como máximo una hora); Detener, salir de esta pestaña o desconectar cierra la conexión antes.

pubsub_apply_cap_button.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Toolbar: button applying the message ring-cap value.

pubsub_banner.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub: banner explaining dedicated connections, bounded capture, pattern syntax, key events, pause, and shutdown behavior.
pubsub_banner.value: Las suscripciones se ejecutan mediante su propia conexión; el editor sigue rechazando SUBSCRIBE. La lista está limitada: se conservan los {cap} mensajes más recientes y los más antiguos se descartan al desbordar ({dropped} descartados hasta ahora); la tabla muestra los {display_cap} más recientes primero. Los nombres con caracteres glob (* ? [ ]) se suscriben como patrones mediante PSUBSCRIBE y los demás como canales simples; empieza un nombre con = para suscribirse literalmente (=orders[eu]). Eventos de clave se suscribe a las notificaciones de espacio de claves de esta base de datos; esos mensajes rellenan las columnas de evento y clave. Pausar retiene la lista sin cerrar la suscripción. Detener, salir de esta pestaña o desconectar cierra la conexión.

value_query_hint_search.value: Eso parece una consulta de búsqueda. Filtrar claves compara los NOMBRES de las claves con un patrón glob como user:*; para buscar en los valores, usa FT.SEARCH sobre un índice de búsqueda.

value_search_button.value: Buscar en los valores con FT.SEARCH…

value_search_running.location: Explorer → Redis database → Filter Keys dialog → value-query hint: the search button's label while the dialog lists the database's search indexes.

value_search_no_index.value: Esta base de datos aún no tiene ningún índice de búsqueda, y sin él no se pueden buscar los valores. Créalo con FT.CREATE (por ejemplo FT.CREATE idx ON HASH PREFIX 1 user: SCHEMA name TEXT) y luego búscalo con FT.SEARCH.

value_search_no_module.location: Explorer → Redis database → Filter Keys dialog → value-query hint: note shown when listing search indexes failed (no search module, or not permitted); {error} is the server's reply.
value_search_no_module.value: Este servidor no pudo listar los índices de búsqueda ({error}), así que aquí no se puede buscar en los valores: hace falta el módulo de búsqueda (Redis Stack o Redis 8). Filtrar claves solo compara nombres de claves.

value_search_script_comment.location: Query tab opened from Filter Keys → Search values with FT.SEARCH…: comment lines at the top of the generated script (each line becomes a # comment); {index} is the search index used.
value_search_script_comment.value:
Filtrar claves compara nombres de claves con un glob; esto busca en los VALORES de las claves mediante el índice de búsqueda {index}.
Edita la consulta (sintaxis de búsqueda: @campo:valor, @num:[min max]) y ejecútala.

value_search_other_indexes.location: Query tab opened from Filter Keys → Search values with FT.SEARCH…: comment line naming the database's other search indexes; {indexes} is a comma-separated list.

include_all_accessibility.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: screen-reader label for the “Include all” checkbox beside the search box, describing that it sends the whole connection’s data model.
include_all_accessibility.value: Incluir el modelo de datos completo de la conexión en el informe

include_all_label.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: checkbox label next to the search box; when ticked, every object name in the data model is sent and the tree is greyed out.

include_all_summary.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree shown while “Include all” is ticked, replacing the ticked-item count.
include_all_summary.value: Se incluirá tu modelo de datos completo (solo nombres, nunca datos).

kind_columns.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides columns in the tree (fifth of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_functions.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides functions in the tree (third of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_procedures.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides stored procedures in the tree (first of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_tables.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides tables in the tree (fourth of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_toggle_accessibility.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: screen-reader label for each object-kind visibility checkbox; {kind} is one of the lower-case plural kind words (tables, views, columns…).
kind_toggle_accessibility.value: Mostrar {kind} en la lista de objetos

kind_types.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides user-defined data types in the tree (last of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_views.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides views in the tree (second of six). Plural noun, very short.

mask_literals_button.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: small toggle button beside “Your query”, shown when the query has literals or comments; replaces them with <redacted> in the report.

mask_literals_tooltip.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: tooltip on the “Mask literals” button explaining it hides string literals and comments behind the token <redacted> (keep that token).
mask_literals_tooltip.value: Reemplazar literales de cadena y comentarios con <redacted> antes de enviar

no_data_model.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: empty-state message in the tree when no schema information was cached for the current connection.
no_data_model.value: No se capturó un modelo de datos para esta conexión.

no_search_matches.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: empty-state message in the tree when the search box text matches no object; {query} is the typed search text.
no_search_matches.value: Nada en tu modelo de datos coincide con «{query}».

query_heading.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Right pane: bold heading above the read-only copy of the user’s query; {line} and {column} give the caret position when the autocomplete popup was captured.

required_badge.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: tiny accent-coloured tag at the end of a locked tree row whose object backed one of the suggestions and is always sent. Single short word, not an error.

required_explanation.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: tooltip on locked rows and notice under the tree after clicking one, explaining why that object cannot be unticked.
required_explanation.value: Obligatorio: este objeto formó parte de las sugerencias que recibiste. Las pruebas creadas a partir de este informe lo necesitan para ser válidas.

search_overflow.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: last row of the tree when search results are capped; {count} is how many further matching objects are hidden.

search_placeholder.location: IntelliSense → Feedback Report → Object selection: placeholder in the schema object search input.

selection_both_many.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when several items are ticked and some are required; {picked} is the ticked count (plural), {required} the required count.
selection_both_many.value: {picked} elementos seleccionados más los obligatorios ({required}): las casillas atenuadas solo envían el nombre.

selection_both_one.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when exactly one item is ticked plus some required ones; {picked} is 1, {required} the required count.
selection_both_one.value: {picked} elemento seleccionado más los obligatorios ({required}): las casillas atenuadas solo envían el nombre.

selection_none.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when nothing is ticked and no objects are required, so no schema names will be uploaded.
selection_none.value: Nada seleccionado: no se enviarán nombres del modelo de datos.

selection_picked_many.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when two or more items are ticked and none are required; {picked} is the ticked count.
selection_picked_many.value: {picked} elementos seleccionados: las casillas atenuadas solo envían el nombre.

selection_picked_one.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when exactly one item is ticked and none are required; {picked} is 1.
selection_picked_one.value: {picked} elemento seleccionado: las casillas atenuadas solo envían el nombre.

selection_required_many.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when nothing is ticked but two or more suggestion-backing items will be sent anyway; {required} is that count. Informational, not an error.
selection_required_many.value: Se enviarán {required} elementos obligatorios de las sugerencias.

selection_required_one.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when nothing is ticked but exactly one suggestion-backing item will be sent anyway; {required} is 1. Informational, not an error.
selection_required_one.value: Se enviará {required} elemento obligatorio de las sugerencias.

snippets_group.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: name of the group row in the tree that lists the editor snippets known to IntelliSense.

submit_button.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog: primary footer button that validates the note and queues the IntelliSense report for upload.

suggestions_summary.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog: summary line at the top of the dialog when the captured popup had no top items to name; {count} is the number of suggestions recorded.

suggestions_summary_top.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog: summary line at the top of the dialog; {count} is the number of suggestions recorded and {top} a comma-separated list of the first few suggestion names.

truncation_dropped_chains.location: Improve IntelliSense → Uploaded report: lower-case note recorded in the report when it exceeds the size budget and all foreign-key chains are removed; {count} is how many were dropped.
truncation_dropped_chains.value: se descartaron las {count} cadenas de claves foráneas

truncation_dropped_objects.location: Improve IntelliSense → Uploaded report: lower-case note recorded when the report is over its size budget and schema objects are cut; {dropped} removed out of {total} objects.
truncation_dropped_objects.value: se descartaron {dropped} de {total} objetos del catálogo

truncation_dropped_procedures.location: Improve IntelliSense → Uploaded report: lower-case note recorded when the report is over its size budget and stored-procedure definitions are cut; {dropped} removed out of {total} procedures.

unmask_literals_button.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: label of the literals toggle button while masking is on; clicking it sends string literals and comments as typed again.

unmask_literals_tooltip.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: tooltip on the “Unmask literals” button explaining that literals and comments will be sent exactly as typed.
unmask_literals_tooltip.value: Enviar los literales de cadena y los comentarios exactamente como se escribieron

capture_empty.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the captured window image has zero width or height.
capture_empty.value: la captura de la ventana estaba vacía

capture_failed.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the operating system returns no image for the app window.
capture_failed.value: no se pudo capturar la ventana

capture_truncated.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the captured image data is shorter than its declared size.
capture_truncated.value: la captura de la ventana se truncó

pixel_data_missing.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the captured image carries no readable pixel bytes.
pixel_data_missing.value: la captura de la ventana no tenía datos de píxeles

pixel_format_unsupported.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case technical fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the capture is not 8-bit, 32-bits-per-pixel colour.
pixel_format_unsupported.value: formato de píxeles de captura no compatible

pixel_layout_unsupported.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case technical fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the capture’s colour-channel order is not one the app can convert.
pixel_layout_unsupported.value: disposición de píxeles de captura no compatible

platform_unsupported.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” on Windows and Linux, where window screenshots are not implemented yet.
platform_unsupported.value: las capturas de pantalla aún no son compatibles con esta plataforma

window_unidentified.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the app cannot find the macOS window number to capture.
window_unidentified.value: no se pudo identificar la ventana

retry_interval_many.location: Workbench → Status bar → Feedback upload warning: retry interval inserted as {interval} when a submitted report was saved locally but upload failed; {count} is the minutes between retries.

retry_interval_one.location: Workbench → Status bar → Feedback upload warning: singular retry interval inserted as {interval} when retries happen every single minute (reads like “every minute”); a bare noun.

documentation_footer.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window: closing line at the very bottom of the generated help text, after the shortcut lists, pointing the reader to the online SQLLY documentation; keep the web address unchanged.
documentation_footer.value: Para más ayuda, consulta la documentación en https://sqlly.app/docs

editor_section.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window: section heading placed after the application command lists, introducing the list of SQL editor actions and their current keyboard shortcuts; appears on its own line.

introduction.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window: opening title and paragraph at the top of the generated help text, explaining that every listed shortcut reflects the user’s current keybindings, including changes made in Preferences → Keybindings.
introduction.value:
Ayuda de SQLLY

Los atajos siguientes se resuelven a partir de tus combinaciones de teclas actuales, incluidos los cambios realizados en Preferencias > Atajos de teclado.

key_backspace.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the Backspace key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut (after any modifier symbols); use the conventional key-cap name for this key in the target language.

key_delete.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the forward Delete key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut (after any modifier symbols); use the conventional key-cap name in the target language.

key_enter.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the Enter/Return key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut, e.g. the Run query shortcut; use the conventional key-cap name in the target language.

key_escape.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: abbreviated name of the Escape key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut; keep it as short as a key-cap label.

key_space.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the Space bar as printed inside a keyboard shortcut, e.g. the trigger-completions shortcut; use the conventional key-cap name in the target language.

key_tab.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the Tab key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut (after any modifier symbols); use the conventional key-cap name in the target language.

back_button.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog → Footer: secondary button that steps back to the previous tip in the rotating list (wraps around from the first tip to the last).

counter.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog: small dimmed line above the tip title showing the position in the tip list; {current} is the number of the tip on screen and {total} is how many tips exist.

dialog_title.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog: title of the modal dialog that shows one usage tip, opened automatically once per launch or on demand from Help → Tip of the Day.

next_button.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog → Footer: primary button that advances to the next tip in the rotating list; the next launch then continues from the tip after the last one viewed.

show_on_startup.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog → Footer: checkbox label at the left of the button row; when checked, a tip opens automatically each time SQLLY starts (same preference as in Settings → Appearance).

command_palette_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Press {modifier_key}+Shift+P to open the command palette: every menu command, searchable by name, category, or keyword, with its current keyboard shortcut sho…: body text for this specific tip.
command_palette_body.value: Presiona {modifier_key}+Shift+P para abrir la paleta de comandos: todos los comandos del menú, con búsqueda por nombre, categoría o palabra clave y el atajo de teclado actual junto a cada uno. Si la abres con la búsqueda vacía, los comandos usados más recientemente aparecen primero.

command_palette_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Every command, one shortcut away: title text for this specific tip.
command_palette_title.value: Todos los comandos, a un atajo de distancia

connection_string_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → In the connection editor, paste a postgres://, mysql://, sqlserver://, JDBC, or ADO.NET-style connection string and SQLLY fills in the engine, host, …: body text for this specific tip.
connection_string_body.value: En el editor de conexiones, pega una cadena postgres://, mysql://, sqlserver://, JDBC o ADO.NET y SQLLY completará el motor, host, puerto, base de datos, usuario y opciones de cifrado. Las contraseñas se guardan directamente en el almacén seguro del sistema operativo.

connection_string_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Paste a connection string: title text for this specific tip.

current_statement_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Turn on the "Run current statement only" toggle in the query toolbar and Execute runs only the statement under the caret instead of the whole script.…: body text for this specific tip.
current_statement_body.value: Activa «Ejecutar solo la instrucción actual» en la barra de herramientas de consulta y Ejecutar ejecutará únicamente la instrucción donde está el cursor, en lugar de todo el script. Si hay una selección, esta sigue teniendo prioridad.

current_statement_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Run just the statement you're on: title text for this specific tip.

estimated_plan_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Query ▸ Explain Query (Estimated, No Execution) asks the optimizer how it would run your SQL — even an UPDATE or DELETE — without executing a single …: body text for this specific tip.
estimated_plan_body.value: Consulta ▸ Explicar consulta (estimado, sin ejecución) pregunta al optimizador cómo ejecutaría el SQL, incluso una instrucción UPDATE o DELETE, sin ejecutar ninguna instrucción. El plan se abre en el mismo panel que los planes reales, con la etiqueta Estimado claramente visible.

estimated_plan_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → See the plan without running anything: title text for this specific tip.
estimated_plan_title.value: Consulta el plan sin ejecutar nada

explorer_filter_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → The explorer filter understands abbreviations like SOH for SalesOrderHeader and /regex/ patterns. Pin the objects you use most to the top of their se…: body text for this specific tip.
explorer_filter_body.value: El filtro del explorador reconoce abreviaturas como SOH para SalesOrderHeader y patrones /regex/. Fija los objetos que más usas en la parte superior de su servidor y arrastra una tabla o columna al editor para insertar su nombre con las comillas correctas.

explorer_filter_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Find objects faster in the explorer: title text for this specific tip.
explorer_filter_title.value: Encuentra objetos más rápido en el explorador

foreign_key_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Right-click a cell that references another table and choose Open Referenced Row: SQLLY opens a new query tab selecting the parent row, on the same co…: body text for this specific tip.
foreign_key_body.value: Haz clic derecho en una celda que haga referencia a otra tabla y elige Abrir fila referenciada: SQLLY abrirá una pestaña de consulta nueva que selecciona la fila principal, en la misma conexión que produjo el resultado.

foreign_key_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Follow a foreign key: title text for this specific tip.

format_on_run_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Switch on the Fmt toggle in the query toolbar and each Run formats the whole buffer first. The format is a single undo step, and it stays out of the …: body text for this specific tip.
format_on_run_body.value: Activa Fmt en la barra de herramientas de consulta y cada ejecución formateará primero todo el búfer. El formato se deshace en un solo paso y no se interpone cuando has seleccionado texto para ejecutar.

format_on_run_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Format on every run: title text for this specific tip.

history_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Each query tab keeps a timeline of its own text, saved on every run and whenever you pause after editing. Open the History panel to restore an earlie…: body text for this specific tip.
history_body.value: Cada pestaña de consulta conserva una cronología de su propio texto, guardada en cada ejecución y cuando haces una pausa después de editar. Abre el panel Historial para restaurar una versión anterior: el texto actual se guarda primero y la restauración se deshace en un solo paso.

history_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Every query has a history: title text for this specific tip.

hover_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Rest the pointer on a table, column, procedure, or function name in the editor to see its columns and types, a column's type and nullability, or a ro…: body text for this specific tip.
hover_body.value: Coloca el puntero sobre el nombre de una tabla, columna, procedimiento o función en el editor para ver sus columnas y tipos, el tipo y la nulabilidad de una columna o los parámetros de una rutina, sin salir de la consulta.

hover_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Hover to check the schema: title text for this specific tip.
hover_title.value: Pasa el cursor para consultar el esquema

intellisense_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → As you type, SQLLY suggests the tables, columns, keywords, and even complete JOINs that fit where you are, drawn from your connected database. When a…: body text for this specific tip.
intellisense_body.value: Mientras escribes, SQLLY sugiere las tablas, columnas, palabras clave e incluso cláusulas JOIN completas que corresponden a tu posición, a partir de la base de datos conectada. Si una sugerencia es incorrecta o falta, presiona F2 mientras el menú de autocompletado esté abierto (o haz clic en su indicación de F2) para enviar un informe de Mejorar IntelliSense: tú eliges exactamente qué nombres de esquema compartir, y los informes se convierten en pruebas de regresión permanentes. Para cualquier otro tema (un error, una idea o una pantalla confusa), usa Ayuda ▸ Enviar comentarios… para enviar una captura de pantalla que puedas marcar con flechas y ocultar las áreas privadas antes de que nada salga de tu equipo.

intellisense_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → IntelliSense, and telling us what to fix: title text for this specific tip.
intellisense_title.value: IntelliSense y cómo decirnos qué corregir

joins_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → After a table name, autocomplete offers a complete JOIN … ON clause built from that table's foreign keys. Type i, l, r, or o first to get an INNER, L…: body text for this specific tip.
joins_body.value: Después del nombre de una tabla, el autocompletado ofrece una cláusula JOIN … ON completa basada en las claves foráneas de esa tabla. Escribe primero i, l, r u o para obtener INNER, LEFT, RIGHT o FULL OUTER JOIN.

joins_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → JOINs written for you: title text for this specific tip.

multicursor_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Hold Alt (Option on a Mac) and drag, or press Shift+Alt+Up/Down, to select the same columns across several lines — each line gets its own caret, so t…: body text for this specific tip.
multicursor_body.value: Mantén presionada Alt (Option en Mac) y arrastra, o presiona Shift+Alt+Arriba/Abajo, para seleccionar las mismas columnas en varias líneas: cada línea tiene su propio cursor, de modo que escribir, eliminar y pegar se aplican a todas.

multicursor_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Edit many lines at once: title text for this specific tip.
multicursor_title.value: Edita varias líneas a la vez

object_jump_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Press {modifier_key}+P (Go to Object…) and type a few letters to fuzzy-search every connection, database, table, view, procedure, and function loaded in the e…: body text for this specific tip.
object_jump_body.value: Presiona {modifier_key}+P (Ir a objeto…) y escribe unas letras para buscar de forma aproximada en todas las conexiones, bases de datos, tablas, vistas, procedimientos y funciones cargados en el explorador. Buscar un objeto no cambia el servidor al que está conectada tu pestaña de consulta.

object_jump_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Jump straight to any object: title text for this specific tip.

parameters_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Add a line like `-- sqlly param: @customer_id int = 42` to a query and a parameter strip appears above the results with one typed field per parameter…: body text for this specific tip.
parameters_body.value: Añade una línea como `-- sqlly param: @customer_id int = 42` a una consulta y aparecerá una barra de parámetros sobre los resultados, con un campo tipado para cada parámetro. Al ejecutar, cada @name se reemplaza por un literal con escape seguro para el motor, y los valores recientes se ofrecen como chips que puedes seleccionar con un clic.

parameters_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Typed query parameters: title text for this specific tip.

paste_in_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Copied a column from a spreadsheet or a list of ids from a ticket? Edit ▸ Paste as IN List splits the clipboard on commas, tabs, or newlines, quotes …: body text for this specific tip.
paste_in_body.value: ¿Copiaste una columna de una hoja de cálculo o una lista de identificadores de un ticket? Edición ▸ Pegar como lista IN divide el portapapeles por comas, tabulaciones o saltos de línea, entrecomilla las cadenas para el motor, deja los números sin comillas e inserta una lista IN lista para ejecutar.

paste_in_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Paste a list as IN (…): title text for this specific tip.

production_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Mark a connection or its environment as production and SQLLY shows a warning banner, blocks data-changing statements until you unlock writes for a ti…: body text for this specific tip.
production_body.value: Marca una conexión o su entorno como producción y SQLLY mostrará un banner de advertencia, bloqueará las instrucciones que modifican datos hasta que habilites las escrituras durante un periodo limitado y te pedirá confirmar el SQL exacto antes de cada escritura.

production_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Production connections are guarded: title text for this specific tip.
production_title.value: Las conexiones de producción están protegidas

quick_actions_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Quick actions are named SQL templates that use the selection, the word at the caret, or the current database. Assign one to a slot and give the slot …: body text for this specific tip.
quick_actions_body.value: Las acciones rápidas son plantillas SQL con nombre que usan la selección, la palabra donde está el cursor o la base de datos actual. Asigna una a una posición y da a esa posición un atajo en Atajos de teclado; describir una tabla o contar sus filas se convierte en una sola pulsación.

quick_actions_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → One-keystroke chores: title text for this specific tip.
quick_actions_title.value: Tareas frecuentes con una sola tecla

reopen_tab_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Press {modifier_key}+Shift+T (Window ▸ Reopen Closed Tab) to bring back the most recently closed query tab with its content, name, and connection.: body text for this specific tip.
reopen_tab_body.value: Presiona {modifier_key}+Shift+T (Ventana ▸ Reabrir pestaña cerrada) para recuperar la última pestaña de consulta cerrada, con su contenido, nombre y conexión.

reopen_tab_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Closed a tab by mistake?: title text for this specific tip.

result_diff_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Result diff mode compares any two retained runs of a query tab — or the current run against a saved snapshot. Pick key columns to see inserted, delet…: body text for this specific tip.
result_diff_body.value: El modo de comparación de resultados compara dos ejecuciones retenidas de una pestaña de consulta, o la ejecución actual con una instantánea guardada. Elige las columnas clave para ver las filas insertadas, eliminadas y modificadas, y filtra la lista de cambios para ver solo lo que te interesa.

result_diff_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Compare two runs of a query: title text for this specific tip.
result_diff_title.value: Compara dos ejecuciones de una consulta

shortcut_help_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Help ▸ SQLLY Help… is generated from the live command list and your own keybindings, so it always matches how the app behaves. Change any shortcut in…: body text for this specific tip.
shortcut_help_body.value: Ayuda ▸ Ayuda de SQLLY… se genera a partir de la lista de comandos activa y tus propios atajos, de modo que siempre coincide con el comportamiento de la aplicación. Cambia cualquier atajo en Herramientas ▸ Abrir atajos de teclado….

shortcut_help_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Shortcuts that tell the truth: title text for this specific tip.

snapshot_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Save as Snapshot… captures the current result set with its query text and timestamp. Tools ▸ Result Snapshots… reopens it any time as a read-only tab…: body text for this specific tip.
snapshot_body.value: Guardar como instantánea… captura el conjunto de resultados actual con el texto de la consulta y su marca de tiempo. Herramientas ▸ Instantáneas de resultados… lo vuelve a abrir en cualquier momento como una pestaña de solo lectura, y una instantánea puede servir como referencia en la vista de comparación de resultados.

snapshot_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Keep a result for later: title text for this specific tip.

snippets_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Define snippets in Settings that expand a short prefix into a full SQL shape with numbered placeholders. Tab and Shift+Tab jump between the placehold…: body text for this specific tip.
snippets_body.value: Define fragmentos en Configuración que expandan un prefijo corto a una estructura SQL completa con marcadores numerados. Tab y Shift+Tab saltan entre los marcadores; Escape sale del fragmento.

split_editor_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Two views of one script: title text for this specific tip.

tab_switching_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Recent-first tab switching: title text for this specific tip.
tab_switching_title.value: Cambio de pestañas por uso reciente

variables_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Script variables: title text for this specific tip.

off.location: Results → Map window → Options panel: switch segment turning a setting off

blur.location: Results → Map window → Options panel: label of the heatmap blur stepper

pixels.location: Results → Map window → Options panel: current blur value in pixels between the minus and plus buttons

click.location: Results → Map window → Options panel: label of the switch choosing what clicking a feature does

approval_approved.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Approval column: cell value for an AI-proposed write statement that the user approved in SQLLY but which has not yet finished running.

approval_executed.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Approval column: cell value for an AI-proposed write statement that was approved and then actually run against the database.

approval_expired.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Approval column: cell value for an AI-proposed write statement that nobody approved or rejected before it timed out.

approval_pending.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Approval column: cell value for an AI-proposed write statement still waiting for the user to approve or reject it in SQLLY.

approval_rejected.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Approval column: cell value for an AI-proposed write statement that the user declined, so it was never run.

browser_unavailable.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Error line: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser preview” message shown instead of the activity log when SQLLY runs in a web browser; a short noun phrase.

column_approval.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: column header for the approval state of AI-proposed write statements (pending, approved, rejected, expired, executed); blank for read-only tool calls.

column_connection.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: column header for the name of the saved connection an MCP tool call ran against.

column_database.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: column header for the database name an MCP tool call targeted on that connection.

column_duration.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: column header for how long each MCP tool call took, in milliseconds; keep the unit abbreviation.

column_outcome.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: column header for the result of each MCP tool call (Ok, Refused or Error).

column_reason.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: column header for the explanation recorded when an MCP tool call was refused or failed; empty for successful calls.

column_rows.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: column header for the number of rows returned or affected by an MCP tool call.

column_sql.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: column header for the SQL text the AI client sent, with sensitive literals redacted; keep the acronym SQL.

column_time.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: first column header, holding the date and time each MCP tool call was logged.

column_tool.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Activity grid: column header for the name of the MCP tool an AI client invoked (for example a query or schema tool).

dialog_title.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog: title of the dialog, opened from Settings → MCP, that lists the local audit log of every tool call AI clients made through SQLLY’s MCP server.

export_csv_button.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Toolbar: button that opens a save dialog and writes the currently filtered activity rows to a CSV file; the ellipsis signals that a file chooser follows.

export_json_button.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Toolbar: button that opens a save dialog and writes the currently filtered activity rows to a JSON file; the ellipsis signals that a file chooser follows.

exported_csv.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after the MCP Activity dialog’s Export CSV… button finishes writing the CSV file; {path} is the full path of the saved .csv file.

exported_json.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after the MCP Activity dialog’s Export JSON… button finishes writing the JSON file; {path} is the full path of the saved .json file.

filter_all_connections.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Toolbar: first option of the connection filter dropdown (third dropdown); selecting it shows activity for every connection.

filter_all_outcomes.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Toolbar: first option of the outcome filter dropdown (second dropdown); selecting it shows successful, refused and failed calls together.

filter_all_tools.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Toolbar: first option of the tool filter dropdown (leftmost dropdown); selecting it shows calls to every MCP tool.

footer.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Footer: summary line under the grid; {filtered_count} is how many log records match the current filters, {total_count} is how many were loaded, and {path} is the folder holding the audit log files.

outcome_error.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog: outcome value, used both in the Outcome column and the outcome filter dropdown, for an MCP tool call that failed while running (a noun, not a dialog title).

outcome_ok.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog: outcome value, used both in the Outcome column and the outcome filter dropdown, for an MCP tool call that completed successfully; very short.

outcome_refused.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog: outcome value, used both in the Outcome column and the outcome filter dropdown, for an MCP tool call that SQLLY blocked, for example by a connection safety rule.

refresh_button.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Toolbar: small button right of the three filter dropdowns that reloads the audit log from disk to pick up new MCP calls.

estimate_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: message shown when an AI client proposes a data-changing statement and SQLLY could neither count the affected rows nor summarise a query plan for it.

estimate_unavailable_reason.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: message shown when the impact estimate for an AI-proposed write statement failed; {reason} is the database error or timeout explanation.

estimated_rows.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: impact estimate shown before running an AI-proposed UPDATE or DELETE; {rows} is the number of rows its WHERE clause currently matches.

estimated_rows_with_plan.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: impact estimate with plan for an AI-proposed UPDATE or DELETE; {rows} is the number of matching rows and {plan} is a one-line summary of the top query plan operator.

plan_rows.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: one-line query plan summary inserted into the impact estimate; {node_type} is the top plan operator (e.g. a table scan) and {rows} is the planner’s estimated row count.

query_timeout.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: reason text, inserted after “Estimate unavailable:”, used when the row count or plan query for an AI-proposed write took longer than 5 seconds and was abandoned; starts lowercase.
query_timeout.value: estimación no disponible: se agotó el tiempo de espera después de 5 s

about.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): first item; opens the About window with the version, license and acknowledgments.

check_updates.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): item under About, shown in editions that update themselves, that checks the server for a newer SQLLY version.

preferences.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): item that opens the Settings window; use the standard macOS name for the app preferences command.

quit.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): last item; quits the SQLLY application; use the standard macOS name for the quit command.

services.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): submenu holding the system Services provided by macOS; use the standard macOS name for this submenu.

title.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY application menu: title of the macOS application menu, the first menu next to the Apple menu; it is the product name, normally left untranslated.

unlock.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): item under About, shown only in the Mac App Store edition, that opens the in-app purchase window to unlock the full version.

add_cursor_above.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Multi-cursor group: item that adds an extra text cursor on the line above in the SQL editor.

add_cursor_below.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Multi-cursor group: item that adds an extra text cursor on the line below in the SQL editor.

add_cursor_next_occurrence.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Multi-cursor group: item that adds a cursor at the next occurrence of the selected text or word in the SQL editor.
add_cursor_next_occurrence.value: Añadir cursor en la siguiente aparición

add_line_comment.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Comment group: item that comments out the current or selected lines in the SQL editor with “--”, even if already commented.

convert_delimited_list.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → List tools group: item that opens a dialog converting the selected comma-, tab- or line-separated text into another delimited or quoted list.

copy.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Clipboard group: standard item that copies the current selection to the clipboard.

cut.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Clipboard group: standard item that removes the current selection and places it on the clipboard.

find.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Search group: item that opens the find bar in the SQL editor to search the query text.

find_next.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Search group: item that jumps to the next match of the current search text in the SQL editor.

find_previous.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Search group: item that jumps to the previous match of the current search text in the SQL editor.

format_document.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu: item that reformats the entire SQL editor contents using the formatting settings (indentation, keyword case, line breaks).

insert_distinct_in_list.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → List tools group: item that queries the distinct values of the column under the cursor and inserts them as an IN (…) list.
insert_distinct_in_list.value: Insertar valores distintos como lista IN

move_beginning.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Navigation group: item that moves the editor cursor to the start of the current line (first non-blank character, then column one).
move_beginning.value: Mover al principio de la línea

move_end.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Navigation group: item that moves the editor cursor to the end of the current line.
move_end.value: Mover al final de la línea

page_down.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Navigation group: item that moves the editor cursor down by one visible page of lines.

page_up.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Navigation group: item that moves the editor cursor up by one visible page of lines.

paste.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Clipboard group: standard item that inserts the clipboard contents at the cursor.

paste_in_list.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → List tools group: item that pastes clipboard lines (for example a copied spreadsheet column) into the SQL editor as a quoted IN (…) value list.

redo.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu: second item; standard command that reapplies the edit last undone.

remove_line_comment.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Comment group: item that removes the leading “--” comment marker from the current or selected lines in the SQL editor.

replace.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Search group: item that opens the find bar with the replace field, to substitute text in the SQL editor.

select_all.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Clipboard group: standard item that selects all text in the focused editor or field.

select_all_occurrences.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Multi-cursor group: item that places a cursor on every occurrence of the selected text or word in the SQL editor at once.

select_beginning.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Navigation group: item that extends the selection from the cursor to the start of the current line.
select_beginning.value: Seleccionar hasta el principio de la línea

select_end.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Navigation group: item that extends the selection from the cursor to the end of the current line.
select_end.value: Seleccionar hasta el final de la línea

select_page_down.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Navigation group: item that extends the selection downward by one visible page of lines.

select_page_up.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Navigation group: item that extends the selection upward by one visible page of lines.

title.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu: title of the Edit menu, holding undo/redo, clipboard, find/replace, multi-cursor, list, formatting and comment commands; use the standard name of this menu.

toggle_block_comment.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Comment group: item that wraps the selected text (or the current line) in a “/* */” block comment in the SQL editor, or removes those markers if it already is one.

toggle_line_comment.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Comment group: item that comments the current or selected lines with “--”, or uncomments them if they already are.

trigger_suggest.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Completion group: item that opens the IntelliSense completion list at the cursor in the SQL editor (tables, columns, keywords).

undo.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu: first item; standard command that reverts the last edit.

value_autocomplete.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Completion group: item that opens a completion popup listing actual distinct values from the database for the column at the cursor.
value_autocomplete.value: Autocompletar valores de columna de tabla

close.location: Application menu bar → File menu: last item on macOS (before Exit on Windows); closes the active query tab, asking to save unsaved changes.

exit.location: Application menu bar → File menu (Windows and Linux only): final item that quits the SQLLY application; use the standard Windows name for this command.

export_connections.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: item that opens a picker to choose saved connections and writes them to a connection file without passwords.

export_credentials.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: item that exports chosen saved connections to a file including their passwords in clear text.

import_connections.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: item that imports saved connections from a SQLLY connection file into the connection list.

import_other_tools.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: item that imports connection definitions from another database tool’s configuration file (for example DBeaver or DataGrip); a noun phrase meaning “from other tools”.

export_other_tools.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: submenu title whose items each save the chosen saved connections in another database tool's own connection-file format (pgAdmin, Azure Data Studio, DBeaver, DataGrip, DbGate, PostgreSQL service file).

export_other_tools_pgadmin.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Export for Other Tools submenu: item that saves PostgreSQL connections as a pgAdmin servers.json file; keep the product and file names unchanged.

export_other_tools_azure_data_studio.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Export for Other Tools submenu: item that saves connections as an Azure Data Studio / VS Code settings.json file; keep the product and file names unchanged.

export_other_tools_dbeaver.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Export for Other Tools submenu: item that saves connections as a DBeaver data-sources.json file; keep the product and file names unchanged.

export_other_tools_datagrip.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Export for Other Tools submenu: item that saves connections as a DataGrip / JetBrains dataSources.xml file; keep the product and file names unchanged.

export_other_tools_dbgate.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Export for Other Tools submenu: item that saves connections as a DbGate connection environment (.env) file; keep the product and file names unchanged.

export_other_tools_pg_service.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Export for Other Tools submenu: item that saves PostgreSQL connections as a PostgreSQL connection service file read by psql and other libpq tools; keep the file name unchanged.

manage_workspaces.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Workspace group: item that opens the workspace dialog to rename, delete or switch between saved workspaces.

new_query.location: Application menu bar → File menu: first item; opens a new empty SQL query tab in the editor.

new_window.location: Application menu bar → File menu: item that opens an additional SQLLY workbench window.

open_export.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: item that opens a file chooser to load a saved SQLLY export (.sqllyexport) file.

open_folder.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: item that chooses a folder and lists every .sql file inside it, recursively, in the project file picker.

open_project_file.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: item that opens SQLLY’s own project file picker (folder and project SQL modes with preview) instead of the system open dialog.

open_sql.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: first open item; shows the system file chooser to open a .sql script into a query tab (short form, listed just above Open SQL file).

open_sql_file.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group: second open item, directly below Open SQL; also shows the system file chooser to load a .sql script into a query tab.

open_workspace.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Workspace group: item that opens the workspace dialog to choose a saved workspace (set of tabs and connections) to restore.

run_sql_file.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Open/Import group (desktop only): item that opens the Run SQL File dialog to execute a .sql script from disk against the current connection without loading it into the editor.

save_library.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Save group: item that saves the active query tab into the SQL Library folder as a reusable snippet.

save_results.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Save group: item that exports the current result grid to a file (CSV, Excel or other export formats).

save_sql.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Save group: item that saves the active query tab’s SQL text to its .sql file, prompting for a location the first time.

save_workspace_as.location: Application menu bar → File menu → Workspace group: item that saves the current tabs and connections as a new named workspace.

title.location: Application menu bar → File menu: title of the File menu, holding new, open, import/export, workspace, save and close commands; use the standard name of this menu.

about.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: menu item on every platform that opens SQLLY's version and credits, in a window on desktop or an in-app panel in the browser; last item below a separator on Windows and Linux, noun phrase as in “About SQLLY”.

app_store_edition.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: menu item shown only in the Mac App Store build that opens a dialog explaining the App Store edition and its purchase/limits; “edition” means product variant.

check_updates.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: menu item on Windows and Linux that checks whether a newer SQLLY version is available and reports the result in the status bar; imperative command.

formatting_directives.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: menu item that opens the reference window listing SQLLY formatting directives (special comments that control result-grid formatting) and their syntax.

open_source_licenses.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: menu item that opens a window listing every third-party open-source project SQLLY uses with the full text of its license.

privacy_policy.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: menu item that opens the SQLLY privacy policy web page in the default browser.

send_feedback.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: menu item that screenshots the current window and opens the feedback dialog where the user can annotate it and send a report to the SQLLY team; imperative command.

show_commands.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: menu item that opens the Command Palette listing every available command (same as View menu → Command palette); imperative command.

sqlly_help.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: first menu item, opens a help window generated from the live command list and keyboard shortcuts; “Sqlly” is the product name and stays untranslated.

tip_of_day.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: menu item that opens the Tip of the Day popup showing a short rotating tip about a SQLLY feature on demand.

title.location: Application menu bar → Help menu: title of the top-level Help menu, the last menu on the bar, holding help, feedback, licenses and About items; one short word.

ask_schema.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that opens the AI panel on its Ask tab to ask natural-language questions about the connected database’s schema.

cancel.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: last menu item, stops the query currently running in the active editor tab; imperative verb.

execute.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: first menu item, runs the SQL in the active editor tab (or the selection) and shows the results below, replacing previous results; imperative verb.

execute_new_result_tab.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that runs the active tab’s SQL but keeps earlier results, placing the new results in an additional result tab; command phrase.
execute_new_result_tab.value: Ejecutar en una nueva pestaña de resultados

explain_actual.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that runs the query and opens the actual execution plan viewer with real runtime statistics; contrast with “Explain estimated”.

explain_estimated.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that opens the estimated execution plan for the active query without running it; contrast with “Explain actual”.

format.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that reformats (pretty-prints) the SQL in the active editor tab using the formatting settings; imperative verb.

generate_sql.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that opens the AI panel on its Generate SQL tab, where a plain-language request is turned into a SQL query.

minify.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that compacts the SQL in the active editor tab onto as few lines as possible by removing extra whitespace; opposite of Format.

run_multiple.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that opens a dialog to run the active query against several saved connections at once and compare the results.

title.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: title of the top-level Query menu holding run, cancel, execution plan, AI, validate and format commands for the active editor tab.

toggle_ai.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that shows or hides the AI assistant side panel; “Toggle” means show if hidden, hide if shown.
toggle_ai.value: Mostrar u ocultar el asistente de IA

validate.location: Application menu bar → Query menu: menu item that checks the active tab’s SQL for syntax and reference errors without running it and marks problems in the editor; imperative verb.

add_firewall_ip.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that adds this computer’s public IP address as a firewall rule on the connected Azure SQL server so it can connect; “IP” is an IP address.
add_firewall_ip.value: Añadir mi IP al firewall del servidor…

azure_connection.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the Azure SQL connection flow to sign in to Azure and pick a server and database to connect to.

chart_dashboard.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the Chart Dashboard window showing saved charts together on one board.

connect.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item shown in place of “Disconnect” when no connection is active; opens the connection dialog to connect to a database server; imperative verb.

connection_management.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the Connection Management dialog for adding, editing, organizing and deleting saved connections.

disconnect.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item shown in place of “Connect” while a connection is active; closes the current database connection; imperative verb.

go_to_object.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item (also in the View menu) that opens the quick-open search box to jump to a table, view or other database object by name.

import_clipboard.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the import wizard with copied clipboard data (e.g. cells from a spreadsheet) as the source to load into a table.

keyboard_shortcuts.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: last menu item, opens Settings at the Keyboard Shortcuts page to view and change key bindings.

manage_entities.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the dialog for managing clients, projects and environments (named groups with colors and safety settings that connections belong to).

object_browser.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the Object Browser, a sortable inventory of the database’s tables, views, routines and triggers with details and batch scripts.

object_properties.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the properties editor for the connected server or selected object, the same dialog as the explorer’s context menu.

options.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item on Windows and Linux (labeled “Preferences” on macOS) that opens the Settings window; use the platform’s usual word for app options.

preferences.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item on macOS (labeled “Options” on Windows and Linux) that opens the Settings window; use the macOS-standard word for app preferences.

refresh_explorer.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: first menu item, reloads the object explorer tree in the sidebar so newly created or dropped database objects appear; imperative command.

result_snapshots.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the Result Snapshots browser listing saved captures of result sets that reopen read-only without rerunning the query.

saved_charts.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the list of charts the user has saved from query results, to reopen, rename or delete them.

template_explorer.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: menu item that opens the Template Explorer, a catalog of ready-made SQL script templates with fill-in parameters that insert into a new tab.

title.location: Application menu bar → Tools menu: title of the top-level Tools menu holding connection, Azure, object browser, snapshots, charts and settings commands.

actual_size.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that resets the editor zoom level back to 100%, after Zoom in and Zoom out; standard “Actual Size” wording.

close_split.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that removes the editor split and returns to a single editor pane; the other pane’s tab stays open in the tab bar.

command_palette.location: Application menu bar → View menu: first menu item, opens the Command Palette search box listing every command by name; product-style noun phrase.

go_to_object.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item (also in the Tools menu) that opens the quick-open box to jump to a database object or open tab by typing part of its name.

search_schema.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that opens the AI panel on its Search tab to find tables and columns in the connected database by meaning or name.

show_sql_library.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that shows the sidebar switched to the SQL Library of saved scripts; imperative “show”.

split_horizontal.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that splits the editor into two panes stacked top and bottom, copying the active tab’s SQL into a new tab in the lower pane.

split_same_horizontal.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that splits the editor top and bottom with both panes showing the same document (shared text, separate cursors and scrolling).

split_same_vertical.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that splits the editor side by side with both panes showing the same document (shared text, separate cursors and scrolling).

split_vertical.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that splits the editor into two side-by-side panes, copying the active tab’s SQL into a new tab in the right pane.

theme.location: Application menu bar → View menu: submenu title that opens the color theme choices (System, Light, Dark, High Contrast); the current choice shows a checkmark.

theme_dark.location: Application menu bar → View menu → Theme submenu: item that switches the app to the dark color theme; checked while Dark is the chosen mode. The submenu title already says Theme, so this is just the mode name.

theme_high_contrast.location: Application menu bar → View menu → Theme submenu: item that turns the high-contrast accessibility palette on or off for the current mode; checked while it is on. Just the palette name, no Theme prefix.

theme_light.location: Application menu bar → View menu → Theme submenu: item that switches the app to the light color theme; checked while Light is the chosen mode. Just the mode name, no Theme prefix.

theme_system.location: Application menu bar → View menu → Theme submenu: first item, makes the app follow the operating system’s light or dark appearance; checked while it is the chosen mode. Just the mode name, no Theme prefix.

title.location: Application menu bar → View menu: title of the top-level View menu holding panels, editor splits, zoom and color theme commands.

toggle_explorer.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that shows or hides the left sidebar with the object explorer; “Toggle” means show if hidden, hide if shown.
toggle_explorer.value: Mostrar u ocultar el explorador de objetos

toggle_intellisense_debug.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that shows or hides a diagnostic panel with the SQL completion engine’s (IntelliSense) internal state; for troubleshooting.
toggle_intellisense_debug.value: Mostrar u ocultar el panel de depuración de IntelliSense

toggle_log.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that shows or hides the log console panel with the app’s activity log; “Toggle” means show if hidden, hide if shown.
toggle_log.value: Mostrar u ocultar la consola de registro

toggle_results.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that shows or hides the results pane below the SQL editor; “Toggle” means show if hidden, hide if shown.
toggle_results.value: Mostrar u ocultar el panel de resultados

zoom_in.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that increases the editor text zoom level one step; standard “Zoom In” wording.

zoom_out.location: Application menu bar → View menu: menu item that decreases the editor text zoom level one step; standard “Zoom Out” wording.

bring_all_front.location: Application menu bar → Window menu: macOS-only last menu item that brings all SQLLY windows in front of other apps; standard macOS “Bring All to Front” command.

close_tab.location: Application menu bar → Window menu: menu item that closes the active editor tab in the current window; imperative command.

maximize.location: Application menu bar → Window menu: Windows and Linux menu item (labeled “Zoom” on macOS) that maximizes the window or restores it from maximized size.

minimize.location: Application menu bar → Window menu: first menu item, minimizes the current SQLLY window to the Dock or taskbar; standard window command.

next_tab.location: Application menu bar → Window menu: menu item that switches to the editor tab to the right of the active one; imperative navigation command.

previous_tab.location: Application menu bar → Window menu: menu item that switches to the editor tab to the left of the active one; imperative navigation command.

reopen_closed_tab.location: Application menu bar → Window menu: menu item that reopens the most recently closed editor tab with its SQL; imperative command.

title.location: Application menu bar → Window menu: title of the top-level Window menu holding minimize, zoom/maximize, editor tab navigation and window arrangement commands.

zoom.location: Application menu bar → Window menu: macOS menu item (labeled “Maximize” elsewhere) that toggles the window between its standard and enlarged size; the macOS window “Zoom”, not text zoom.

clear_all.location: Workbench → Status bar → Notifications dialog: footer button that removes every notification from the list; disabled when the list is empty; imperative command.

reveal.location: Workbench → Status bar → Notifications dialog: small button on a notification row for a saved file (e.g. a finished export) that shows the file in Finder or Explorer; imperative verb.

title.location: Workbench → Status bar → Notifications dialog: title of the dialog opened by clicking the bell icon, listing recent query completions, failures, exports and updates.

empty.location: Workbench → Status bar → Notifications dialog: empty-state message in the list when no notifications have arrived yet, explaining what kinds of events will appear there.
empty.value: Aún no hay nada: aquí aparecerán las consultas largas completadas, los errores y las actualizaciones.

item_timestamp.location: Workbench → Status bar → Notifications dialog: small dim header line above each notification message; {label} is the notification type (e.g. “Query completed”) and {time} is when it happened.

export_saved.location: Workbench → Status bar → Notifications dialog: notification type label for a finished file deliverable (result export, table data export or schema documentation); shown before the time.
