open_error.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet: error toast, also added to the Messages tab, when launching the default spreadsheet app fails; {file_path} is the temporary export file, {error} the system error text.

opened_native.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet (desktop app): success toast after the export is written to a temporary file and handed to the OS default spreadsheet app; {file_path} is that temporary file’s path.
opened_native.value: Se abrió {file_path} en la aplicación de hoja de cálculo predeterminada

write_temp_error.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet: error toast, also added to the Messages tab, when writing the exported data into the temporary file fails; {file_path} is the file path, {error} the system error text.

ddl.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the DDL view (CREATE script of an object), present only after an object’s definition has been opened; keep short, usually left as the abbreviation.

diff.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the Diff view comparing the current run’s results with a retained earlier run; appears only when result difference tracking is on.

history.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: always-present tab label that shows the query execution history for this editor tab; noun, keep short.

messages.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: always-present tab label for server messages, errors and run notes; a small superscript count may follow it; noun, keep short.

plan.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the execution plan view, placed next to Results and present only when the run asked for a query plan; noun, keep short.

preview_sql.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the pending-changes script preview, present only while row edits are staged in the grid; “Preview” used as a noun/adjective, keep short.

results.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: first, always-present tab label that shows the query result grids; noun, keep short.

statistics.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the Client Statistics view of the run (timings, rows, bytes), present only after statistics have been opened; noun, keep short.

tooltip_with_index.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tooltip on an output tab when no custom shortcut is bound, showing the built-in numbered shortcut; {tab_name} is the tab label, {shortcut} the digit (1–6) pressed with Cmd.

tooltip_with_shortcut.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tooltip on an output tab when its select-tab command has a key binding; {tab_name} is the tab label, {shortcut} the full key combination text such as “⌘2”.

detach_results_tooltip.location: Results pane → Header layout buttons: tooltip on the frame-icon button that moves the results out of the editor into their own separate window.

maximize_results_tooltip.location: Results pane → Header layout buttons: tooltip on the up-chevron button that enlarges the results to fill the area, hiding the SQL editor above.

restore_editor_tooltip.location: Results pane → Header layout buttons: tooltip on the down-chevron button, shown while results are maximized, that brings the SQL editor back above the results.

clipboard_empty.location: Results → Editable grid → Paste: line added to the Messages tab when the user pastes into the grid but the clipboard contains no text.
clipboard_empty.value: El portapapeles no tiene texto para pegar

extra_columns_dropped.location: Results → Editable grid → Paste: line added to the Messages tab when pasted data is wider than the table and the extra columns are ignored; {column_count} is the number of dropped columns.
extra_columns_dropped.value: Al pegar se descartaron {column_count} columna(s) adicional(es) que no están en la tabla

row_value_error.location: Results → Editable grid → Paste: line added to the Messages tab for each pasted cell that could not be staged; {row_number} is the pasted row, {column_name} the column, {error} the reason, {cell_text} the quoted pasted text.

value_required.location: Results → Editable grid → Paste rows: lowercase reason text inserted into the paste error line when a pasted cell is empty but its column does not allow NULL.
value_required.value: el valor es obligatorio (la columna es NOT NULL)

column_cap_warning.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot warnings: warning that the pivot has more distinct column keys than the limit, so only the first {column_cap} columns are kept; {column_cap} is the limit (250).
column_cap_warning.value: Sugerencia de pivote: se superó el límite de {column_cap} columnas dinámicas; se muestran las primeras {column_cap} columnas.

column_index_not_allowed.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a field gave a column number or empty name; {field_role} is the untranslated field keyword (row, column, value or format).
column_index_not_allowed.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: {field_role} debe nombrar una columna de resultados, no utilizar un índice de columna.

duplicate_axis_columns.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because its row, column and value fields do not name three distinct result columns.
duplicate_axis_columns.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: la fila, la columna y el valor deben hacer referencia a tres columnas diferentes.

format_options_missing.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a format or valueformat field has nothing after the colon; key=value and “default” are literal syntax, keep them untranslated.
format_options_missing.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: faltan las opciones de formato (se esperaban pares key=value o "default").

invalid_alignment.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the align format option is not left, center or right (literal keywords); {value} is what was typed.
invalid_alignment.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: align debe ser left, center o right, no «{value}».

invalid_boolean_option.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a yes/no format option is not true or false (literal keywords); {option_name} is red, parens or thousands, {value} the typed text.
invalid_boolean_option.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: {option_name} debe ser true o false, no «{value}».

invalid_decimals.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the decimals format option is not a whole number of zero or more; {value} is what was typed.
invalid_decimals.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: decimals debe ser un entero no negativo, no «{value}».

invalid_result_number.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the result field is not a result-set number starting at 1; {value} is what was typed.
invalid_result_number.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: result debe ser un número de conjunto de resultados a partir de 1, no «{value}».

malformed_field.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a semicolon-separated segment has no colon; {field} is that segment; key:value is literal syntax.
malformed_field.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: campo con formato incorrecto «{field}» (se esperaba key:value).

malformed_format_field.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a format field lacks its second colon; the syntax format:<column>:<options> is literal, translate only the placeholders’ words if at all.
malformed_format_field.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: el campo de formato debe tener la forma format:<columna>:<opciones>.

malformed_format_option.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because one comma-separated format option has no equals sign; {option} is that option text; key=value is literal syntax.
malformed_format_option.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: opción de formato incorrecta «{option}» (se esperaba key=value).

malformed_value_field.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the value field does not name both a column and an aggregate; value:<column>:<aggregate> is literal syntax.
malformed_value_field.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: el campo de valor debe tener la forma value:<columna>:<agregado>.

missing_column.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a named column is not in the result; {field_role} is the untranslated field keyword (row, column or value), {column_name} the missing name.
missing_column.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: no se encontró la columna {field_role} «{column_name}» en el conjunto de resultados.

multiple_hints.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot warnings: warning that the query has more than one valid pivot directive and only the last one is used; “-- sqlly pivot:” is literal syntax.
multiple_hints.value: Sugerencia de pivote: se encontraron varias sugerencias -- sqlly pivot:; se usa la última válida.

null_key_warning.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot warnings: warning that some row or column key values are NULL and are shown under a placeholder label; {null_placeholder} is that literal label.
null_key_warning.value: Sugerencia de pivote: hay valores nulos en posiciones de clave de fila o columna; se representan como '{null_placeholder}'.

required_field_missing.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a mandatory field is absent; {field_role} is the untranslated field keyword (row, column or value).
required_field_missing.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: falta el campo obligatorio «{field_role}».

unknown_field.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a segment uses a field keyword the parser does not know; {field_name} is that keyword as typed.
unknown_field.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: campo desconocido «{field_name}».

unknown_format_option.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a format option name is not align, decimals, red, parens or thousands; {option_name} is the unrecognized name.
unknown_format_option.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: opción de formato desconocida «{option_name}».

unsupported_aggregate.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the value field’s aggregate is not count, sum, avg, first, max or min; {aggregate} is the typed name.
unsupported_aggregate.value: Sugerencia de pivote ignorada: el agregado de valor «{aggregate}» no es compatible.

view_without_hint.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly view: pivot” directive → Pivot warnings: warning that the query asked to open the Pivot view but contains no “-- sqlly pivot:” directive describing it; directive text is literal.
view_without_hint.value: Se solicitó la vista de pivote, pero no se encontró ninguna sugerencia -- sqlly pivot:.

loading_locked.location: Results → Grid tab bar → Pivot and Chart tabs: short status shown in parentheses after the disabled Pivot and Chart tab labels while the query is still running; keep very short.

result_too_large_locked.location: Results → Grid tab bar → Pivot and Chart tabs: short status shown in parentheses after the disabled Pivot and Chart tab labels when a result too large to keep in memory has staged edits; keep very short.

copy_button.location: Results pane → Preview SQL tab → Toolbar: small button at the top right that copies the generated change script for the staged row edits; “Copy as SQL” is an action label.

copy_tooltip.location: Results pane → Preview SQL tab → Toolbar: tooltip on the Copy as SQL button explaining that it puts the pending change script on the clipboard.
copy_tooltip.value: Copia el script de cambios pendientes al portapapeles

empty_state.location: Results pane → Preview SQL tab: centered empty-state hint shown when no row edits are staged yet, telling the user to stage edits so their batch SQL appears here.
empty_state.value: Prepara ediciones de filas para previsualizar aquí el SQL del lote.

all_columns_complete_caption.location: Results → Profile tab → Header: caption after Profile All Columns finishes on the whole result; {result_label} is the result set name (e.g. “Results 1”), {profiled_rows} the number of rows read.

all_columns_reading.location: Results → Grid caption: progress status while Profile All Columns first reads a large disk-backed result into memory; {row_count} is the number of rows being read; ends with an ellipsis.
all_columns_reading.value: Perfilando todas las columnas: leyendo {row_count} filas del disco…

all_columns_truncated_caption.location: Results → Profile tab → Header: caption after Profile All Columns when the result exceeded the row limit and only the first rows were analyzed; {result_label} is the result set name, {profiled_rows} the rows read.
all_columns_truncated_caption.value: {result_label} — se perfilaron las primeras {profiled_rows} filas (el resultado era mayor)

binary_value.location: Results → Profile tab and profile Markdown: placeholder shown instead of a binary cell value in frequent-value lists; {byte_count} is the size of the value in bytes; angle brackets mark it as not literal data.

detail_distinct_count.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment giving the exact number of distinct non-null values; {distinct_count} is that number; joined to other fragments with “·”.

detail_distinct_truncated.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment used when distinct counting hit its cap, so the true count is at least {distinct_count}; joined to other fragments with “·”.

detail_fixed_text_length.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment for text columns whose values all have the same length; {length} is that character count.

detail_null_count.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment giving how many profiled values are NULL; {null_count} is the count, {null_percent} the share of rows with one decimal.

detail_numeric_maximum.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: short statistic fragment for numeric columns giving the largest value; {value} is the number; abbreviation of maximum.

detail_numeric_mean.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: short statistic fragment for numeric columns giving the arithmetic average; {value} is the number.

detail_numeric_minimum.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: short statistic fragment for numeric columns giving the smallest value; {value} is the number; abbreviation of minimum.

detail_row_count.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: first statistic fragment giving how many rows were profiled for the selected column; {row_count} is that number.

detail_text_length_range.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment for text columns giving shortest to longest value length; {minimum} and {maximum} are character counts joined by an en dash.

filter_all_columns.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: first chip label, followed by “· count”, that shows every profiled column (removes the filter).

filter_constant.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns holding at most one distinct value.

filter_low_cardinality.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps columns with few distinct values (up to 20) that repeat across rows.

filter_mostly_null.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns where at least half the profiled values are NULL.

filter_numeric.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns with numeric values (those with min, max and mean).

filter_unique.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns with no NULLs where every value is different (candidate keys).

filter_with_nulls.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns containing at least one NULL value.

grid_column_name.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: first column header, holding the name of each profiled result column.

grid_distinct.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the number of distinct non-null values in each profiled column.

grid_length.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the text length, or length range, of each column’s values in characters.

grid_maximum.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the largest numeric value in each profiled column; the English “Grid maximum” is awkward, a short “Max”-style header is intended.

grid_mean.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the arithmetic average of each numeric profiled column.

grid_minimum.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the smallest numeric value in each profiled column; the English “Grid minimum” is awkward, a short “Min”-style header is intended.

grid_null_percent.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: narrow column header for the percentage of each column’s values that are NULL; keep the percent sign.

grid_nulls.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the count of NULL values in each profiled column.

grid_rows.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the number of rows profiled for each column.

grid_top_values.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: last column header, listing a short preview of each column’s most frequent values with their counts.

grid_type.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the database data type of each profiled column.

markdown_column_header.location: Results → Grid column header menu → Copy Column Profile as Markdown: Markdown table header row copied to the clipboard (Column, Type, Nulls, Distinct, Min, Max, Mean, Length, Frequent values); translate the words only and keep the pipe and dash table syntax and blank lines exactly.
markdown_column_header.value:
| Columna | Tipo | Nulos | Distintos | Mín. | Máx. | Media | Longitud | Valores frecuentes |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |

markdown_heading.location: Results → Grid column header menu → Copy Column Profile as Markdown: Markdown title and first line of the copied profile; keep the leading “# ” heading marker and the blank line; {row_count} is the number of rows profiled.

markdown_truncation.location: Results → Grid column header menu → Copy Column Profile as Markdown: fragment appended right after the rows-profiled count when the result was larger than the limit; {maximum_rows} is the row limit; starts with a space.

no_repeated_values.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail: dimmed note in place of the frequent-values list when no value in the selected column occurs more than once.
no_repeated_values.value: No hay valores repetidos en las filas perfiladas.

query_section_label.location: Results → Profile tab → Query section: small caption above the syntax-colored SQL that produced the profiled result; noun.

select_column_detail_prompt.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail: dimmed prompt below the profile grid when no row is selected, telling the user to pick a column to see all its frequent values with counts and percentages.
select_column_detail_prompt.value: Selecciona una columna de arriba para ver su perfil completo: cada valor frecuente conservado con sus recuentos y proporciones.

single_column_complete_caption.location: Results → Profile tab → Header: caption after Profile Column finishes on the whole result; {result_label} is the result set name, {column_name} the column, {profiled_rows} the rows read.

single_column_reading.location: Results → Grid caption: progress status while Profile Column first reads a large disk-backed result into memory; {column_name} is the column, {row_count} the rows being read; ends with an ellipsis.

single_column_truncated_caption.location: Results → Profile tab → Header: caption after Profile Column when only the first rows of a larger result were analyzed; {result_label} is the result set name, {column_name} the column, {profiled_rows} the rows read.
single_column_truncated_caption.value: {result_label} · {column_name} — se perfilaron las primeras {profiled_rows} filas (el resultado era mayor)

tab_label.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: label of the Profile tab that appears after Profile Column or Profile All Columns is used; noun meaning “data profile”, keep short.

tab_tooltip.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tooltip on hover over the Profile tab, which switches to the column profile view for the current run.

comment_out.location: Results → Result set name → Right-click menu: menu item that comments out, in the SQL editor, the statement that produced this result set so it no longer runs.

open_settings.location: Results → Result set name → Right-click menu: last menu item, below a separator, that opens the Result Settings dialog for this result set; ellipsis signals a dialog.

set_visible_rows.location: Results → Result set name → Right-click menu: menu item that saves the currently visible row count as this result’s height in the query; {visible_rows} is that row count.
set_visible_rows.value: Establecer número de filas en el conjunto de resultados ({visible_rows})

show_by_default.location: Results → Result set name → Right-click menu: checkable menu item that makes this result set the one shown first when the query runs; checked and disabled when it already is.

duplicate_name_error.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly name” result directives: error when two result sets are given the same name; {result_name} is the repeated name, {first_result_number} and {second_result_number} the 1-based result set numbers.
duplicate_name_error.value: Los nombres de los conjuntos de resultados deben ser únicos: «{result_name}» se usa tanto para el conjunto de resultados {first_result_number} como para el {second_result_number}.

default_label.location: Results → Result set header and profile captions: default name for a result set that has no name directive; {result_number} is its 1-based position in the run (e.g. “Results 2”).

cancel_button.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: footer button that closes the dialog without changing the result’s name, default-tab choice or visible row count.

comment_out_button.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: button on the left of the footer that closes the dialog and comments out, in the query editor, the statement that produced this result so it no longer runs.

comment_out_tooltip.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: tooltip on the “Comment Out Result” footer button explaining that it comments out the producing statement in the editor so that statement is skipped on the next run.
comment_out_tooltip.value: Comenta la instrucción que produjo este resultado para que deje de ejecutarse

dialog_title.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: dialog title, opened from the pencil beside a result’s name or the name’s right-click menu; {result_number} is the 1-based number of the result set being configured (Results 1, Results 2…).

empty_statement_error.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown after “Comment Out Result” in the Result Settings dialog when the statement that produced the result contains no code to comment out; {result_number} is the result set’s 1-based number.
empty_statement_error.value: La instrucción de Resultados {result_number} no tiene código que comentar.

invalid_row_count.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: inline error under the fields shown on Save when the “Visible rows” field is not a whole number in range; {maximum_rows} is the largest allowed row count.
invalid_row_count.value: Las filas deben ser un número entero del 1 al {maximum_rows}.

name_label.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: label above the text field where the user renames the result set; the name becomes the result’s tab or panel caption.

no_result_editing.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: fallback error shown if Save runs after the dialog has already gone away, meaning there is no result set whose settings are being edited.
no_result_editing.value: No se está editando ningún resultado.

save_button.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: primary footer button that writes the edited name, default-tab choice and visible row count into the query as result directives and closes the dialog.

show_by_default.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: checkbox label; when checked, this result set is the one shown first when the query’s results arrive.
show_by_default.value: Mostrar este resultado de forma predeterminada

show_by_default_hint.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: small help text under the “Show this result by default” checkbox explaining its effect in the tabbed results layout (selects the tab) and the stacked layout (scrolls to it).
show_by_default_hint.value: Selecciona su pestaña en el diseño con pestañas y la desplaza para verla en el diseño apilado cuando llegan los resultados.

unknown_statement_error.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown after “Comment Out Result” in the Result Settings dialog when SQLLY cannot map the result back to its statement in the editor; {result_number} is the result’s 1-based number; tells the user to edit the SQL manually.
unknown_statement_error.value: No se pudo determinar qué instrucción produjo Resultados {result_number}; coméntala a mano.

visible_rows_hint.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: help text under the visible-rows number field; {maximum_rows} is the largest allowed value, and leaving the field empty removes the saved row-count setting.
visible_rows_hint.value: Filas que muestra su panel apilado, 1–{maximum_rows}; vacía el campo para quitar el ajuste.

visible_rows_label.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: label above the number field that sets how many grid rows this result’s panel is tall when results are shown in the stacked (one-under-another) layout.

aggregate_rows.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows cannot be edited when the SELECT returns only aggregate values (COUNT, SUM…), so there is no key to locate a source row; the pencil is hidden.
aggregate_rows.value: las filas agregadas no tienen una clave por la que editarlas

historical_results.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows cannot be edited when the grid shows results restored from query history rather than a live run; the pencil is hidden.
historical_results.value: los resultados restaurados del historial no se pueden editar

later_result_set.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows of the second or later result set of a multi-statement batch cannot be edited; only the first result set supports editing.
later_result_set.value: solo se puede editar el primer conjunto de resultados de un lote

missing_query.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows cannot be edited when the results have no SQL text recorded with them to trace them back to a table.
missing_query.value: no hay ninguna consulta asociada con estos resultados

not_single_table_select.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows cannot be edited when the query is not a plain SELECT from one table (joins, subqueries or non-SELECT statements).
not_single_table_select.value: solo se puede editar un SELECT simple de una sola tabla

batch_insert_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) used when the row editor is opened for the Batch Insert action from the results grid’s row context menu.

binary_byte_count.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: read-only placeholder shown in place of a binary column’s value, which cannot be typed; {byte_count} is the size of the value in bytes. Keep the angle brackets.

binary_load_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a binary column’s field telling the user that binary values must be replaced with the “Load from file…” button rather than typed; lowercase fragment.
binary_load_required.value: edita los valores binarios con Cargar desde archivo…

boolean_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a boolean column’s field when the typed value is not one of true, false, 1 or 0; lowercase instruction fragment; keep the literal words true and false.

check_constraint_violation.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a field whose value breaks a table CHECK constraint, detected locally before saving or reported by the server; {constraint_name} is the constraint’s name; lowercase fragment.

confirm_delete.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: confirmation prompt shown after the first click on Delete for a row with no child tables; {table_name} is the table; the user clicks the button now labeled “Confirm Delete” to actually delete.
confirm_delete.value: ¿Eliminar esta fila de {table_name}? Haz clic en Confirmar eliminación para continuar.

confirm_delete_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: the Delete button’s label after its first click, turned red; a second click permanently deletes the row from the database.

confirm_delete_with_children.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: confirmation prompt after the first Delete click when other tables reference this table by foreign key; {table_name} is the table, {referencing_tables} a comma-separated list of referencing tables.
confirm_delete_with_children.value: ¿Eliminar esta fila de {table_name}? Esta fila está referenciada por {referencing_tables}; la eliminación fallará si existen filas secundarias. Haz clic en Confirmar eliminación para continuar.

confirm_insert.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: prompt shown on the first Insert click when the connection’s safety settings require confirming data changes; {table_name} is the target table; a second click on “Confirm Insert” inserts the row.
confirm_insert.value: Esta conexión requiere confirmar los cambios de datos. Se insertará una fila en {table_name}: haz clic en Confirmar inserción para continuar.

confirm_insert_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: label the primary Insert button switches to after a first click on a connection that requires confirming data changes; clicking it again performs the insert.

confirm_update.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: prompt shown on the first Save click when the connection requires confirming data changes; {change_count} is the number of changed columns (plural form), {table_name} is the table.
confirm_update.value: Esta conexión requiere confirmar los cambios de datos. Se actualizarán {change_count} columnas de una fila en {table_name}: haz clic en Confirmar actualización para continuar.

confirm_update_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: label the primary Save button switches to after a first click on a connection that requires confirming data changes; clicking it again writes the update to the row.

confirm_update_one.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: singular variant of the update confirmation prompt used when exactly one column changed; {change_count} is 1 and {table_name} is the table; a second click on “Confirm Update” saves.
confirm_update_one.value: Esta conexión requiere confirmar los cambios de datos. Se actualizará {change_count} columna de una fila en {table_name}: haz clic en Confirmar actualización para continuar.

date_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a date column’s field when the text is not a valid date; the example shows the expected year-month-day format; lowercase instruction fragment, keep the example date unchanged.

datetime_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a date-and-time column’s field when the text is not a valid timestamp; the example shows the expected format; lowercase fragment, keep the example unchanged.

default_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small button beside a field that has a column default; sets the value to the column’s DEFAULT so the database fills it on save.

delete_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: button that starts deleting the edited row from the database; the first click asks for confirmation in the message banner, shown only when editing an existing row.

delete_conflict_refresh.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown when Delete is refused because the row was changed on the server after the editor loaded it; nothing was deleted, and the user should click Refresh Row and retry.
delete_conflict_refresh.value: La fila cambió en el servidor desde que se cargó; no se eliminó nada. Actualiza e inténtalo de nuevo.

delete_without_primary_key.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown when Delete is clicked but the row has no primary-key values to identify it, so it cannot be deleted without risking other rows.
delete_without_primary_key.value: Esta fila no tiene clave primaria y no se puede eliminar de forma segura.

detached_edit_title.location: Row editor pop-out window → Title bar: operating-system window title shown after the row editor dialog is popped out into its own separate, resizable window.

duplicate_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) when the editor opens a new-row form prefilled with a copy of the clicked row, from the results grid’s Duplicate Row action.

duplicate_without_key_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) when duplicating the clicked row with its primary-key columns emptied so the copy can be inserted without a key collision.

edit_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) while editing an existing row opened from the grid’s row-header pencil or Edit Row action; later combined with the table name.

field_change_count.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Row values heading: summary at the right of the heading when two or more fields were changed; {column_count} is the number of columns, {change_count} the number of changed fields (plural).

field_change_count_one.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Row values heading: singular summary at the right of the heading when exactly one field was changed; {column_count} is the number of columns and {change_count} is 1.

field_count.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Row values heading: summary at the right of the heading when no fields have been changed yet; {column_count} is the number of columns in the row.

fix_highlighted_fields.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown when Save is clicked while one or more fields fail validation; those fields show their own red messages below them.
fix_highlighted_fields.value: Corrige los campos resaltados antes de guardar.

fk_matches_truncated.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Foreign-key lookup dropdown: note at the bottom of the suggestion list for a foreign-key field when more rows match than are shown; asks the user to type more to narrow the results.
fk_matches_truncated.value: Mostrando las primeras coincidencias: refina la búsqueda para acotarlas.

fk_no_matches.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Foreign-key lookup dropdown: empty-state message in the suggestion list of a foreign-key field when the search for the typed text finds no row in the referenced table.

fk_searching.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Foreign-key lookup dropdown: progress text in the suggestion list of a foreign-key field while the referenced table is being searched for the typed text.

foreign_key_no_match.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a foreign-key field when the server rejects the save because the entered value has no matching row in the referenced table; {referenced_table} is that table; lowercase fragment.

foreign_key_selected_label.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small chip beside a foreign-key field naming the referenced row the user picked from the lookup; {label} is that row’s display text. Keep the arrow.

guid_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a GUID/UUID column’s field when the text is not a valid GUID; the example shows the expected format; lowercase fragment, keep the example unchanged.

insert_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small dropdown button beside a field offering generated values (New UUID, server SQL functions); opens a menu, it does not insert a row. Verb meaning “insert a value”.

insert_generated_relay_blocked_tooltip.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: tooltip on a field’s value-generator “Insert” dropdown when some SQL functions are disabled on a relay connection; {reason} is an appended sentence explaining why.

insert_generated_tooltip.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: tooltip on a field’s value-generator “Insert” dropdown explaining it fills the field with a generated value such as a new UUID or a SQL function.
insert_generated_tooltip.value: Inserta un valor generado o una función SQL

insert_save_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: primary button on a new-row form (Insert Row, Duplicate Row) that inserts the row into the table immediately; verb, not a menu.

insert_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) when the editor opens a blank form to insert a brand-new row into the result’s table; later combined with the table name.

integer_out_of_range.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under an integer column’s field when the number is outside the column type’s range; {minimum} and {maximum} are the allowed limits; lowercase fragment.

load_file_browser_unavailable.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown in the browser (web) edition when “Load from file…” is clicked on a binary field, because reading local files is not supported there.
load_file_browser_unavailable.value: La carga desde archivo no está disponible en esta compilación.

load_file_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small button beside a binary column’s field that opens a file picker and replaces the value with the chosen file’s bytes.

loading_row.location: Results → Row editor dialog: progress text in the dialog body right after opening, while SQLLY identifies the source table and fetches the row’s current values from the server.
loading_row.value: Resolviendo tabla y cargando la fila actual…

new_uuid_menu_item.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons → Insert dropdown menu: menu item that fills the field with a freshly generated random UUID.

no_changes_to_save.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: info message shown when Save is clicked but no field differs from the loaded row, or the server reports nothing changed.

no_related_rows.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: empty-state text under an expanded referencing table when no child rows point at the edited row.

not_editable_explanation.location: Results → Row editor dialog: sentence lead-in in the dialog body when the row cannot be edited; the specific reason appears on the next line. Ends with a colon.
not_editable_explanation.value: Esta fila no se puede editar:

not_editable_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title shown instead of the action name when the server check finds the clicked row cannot be edited (for example no primary key or row deleted).

not_nullable.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: short word under a column name, after its data type, meaning the column does not accept NULL; lowercase, fills {nullability} in the type summary.

now_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small button beside a time or date-time field that fills it with this computer’s current local time (plus today’s date for date-time columns).

null_not_allowed.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a field the user set to NULL although the column is NOT NULL (shown when editing an existing row); lowercase fragment, keep “NOT NULL”.
null_not_allowed.value: el valor es obligatorio (la columna es NOT NULL)

nullable.location: Results → Row Editor → field metadata: lowercase nullability suffix in the data-type summary for a nullable field.

numeric_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a decimal, numeric or floating-point column’s field when the text is empty or not a number; lowercase instruction fragment.

open_related_query.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: small button in a referencing table’s heading that opens a new query tab with the SELECT listing all of that table’s rows related to this row.

read_only_computed.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only because the database computes its value; one lowercase word.

read_only_identity.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only because it is an auto-incrementing identity column; one lowercase word, the database term.

read_only_primary_key.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only while editing an existing row because it is part of the primary key that locates the row.

read_only_rowversion.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only because it is a SQL Server rowversion (timestamp) column; database type name, usually left untranslated.

read_only_spatial.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a geometry or geography column’s name explaining the spatial value can be viewed but not edited here.

read_only_unsupported_type.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only because the editor does not support its data type; short lowercase fragment.

refresh_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: button that reloads the edited row’s current values from the server, replacing the form; shown only when editing an existing row.

related_loading.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: progress text under an expanded referencing table while its child rows are being fetched.

related_null_key.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: note under a referencing table explaining no children can exist because this row’s referenced key column is NULL.
related_null_key.value: La clave de referencia es NULL en esta fila; no tiene filas secundarias.

related_rows_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: heading of the lower panel listing tables whose foreign keys point at the edited row; shown only when such tables exist.

related_table_heading.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: heading of one referencing table entry, clicked to expand its rows; {table_name} is the child table and {constraint_name} the foreign-key constraint linking it.

related_truncated.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: note under a referencing table’s child rows when only part of them is shown; {row_count} is how many are shown; points to the Open query button for the full list.
related_truncated.value: Mostrando las primeras {row_count} filas: usa Abrir consulta para verlas todas.

relationship_count.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: count beside the Related rows heading when two or more tables reference this row; {relationship_count} is the number of referencing relationships (plural).

relationship_count_one.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: singular count beside the Related rows heading when exactly one table references this row; {relationship_count} is 1.

required_fields_for_insert.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown when Insert is clicked while required fields are blank or invalid; the problem fields are highlighted with their own messages.
required_fields_for_insert.value: Completa los campos obligatorios antes de insertar.

required_for_insert.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a blank field on a new-row form when the column is NOT NULL and has no default; lowercase fragment, keep “NOT NULL”.
required_for_insert.value: el valor es obligatorio (la columna es NOT NULL)

reset_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: button that discards all unsaved edits in the form and restores the values the row had when loaded; enabled only after a change.

row_no_longer_exists.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown after Refresh Row when the row can no longer be found on the server, for example because another session deleted it.
row_no_longer_exists.value: La fila ya no existe en el servidor.

row_refreshed.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: info message shown after Refresh Row successfully reloads the row’s current values from the server.

row_updated.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: success message after Save writes the changes; the dialog stays open, and the results grid behind it is re-run when the dialog is closed.
row_updated.value: Fila actualizada. La cuadrícula de resultados se actualiza al cerrar.

row_values_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Row values heading: heading above the list of the row’s columns and editable fields; the column/change count appears to its right.

save_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: primary button when editing an existing row that writes the changed fields to the database immediately; enabled only after a change.

save_file_browser_unavailable.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown in the browser (web) edition when “Save to file…” is clicked on a binary field, because saving local files is not supported there.
save_file_browser_unavailable.value: Guardar en archivo no está disponible en esta compilación.

save_file_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small button beside a binary column that has a stored value; opens a save dialog to write the value’s bytes to a file.

saving_insert.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: label of the disabled primary button while a new row is being inserted on the server.

saving_update.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: label of the disabled primary button while changes to an existing row are being written to the server.

script_update_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: button that does not save; opens a new query tab containing the UPDATE statement for the pending edits so the user can review or run it; enabled after a change.

server_rejected_change.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error when the server refuses an update because of a constraint SQLLY can tie to specific fields; {error} is the server’s message (a full sentence); those fields are highlighted.
server_rejected_change.value: El servidor rechazó el cambio: {error} Revisa los campos resaltados.

server_rejected_insert.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error when the server refuses an insert because of a constraint SQLLY can tie to specific fields; {error} is the server’s message (a full sentence); those fields are highlighted.
server_rejected_insert.value: El servidor rechazó la inserción: {error} Revisa los campos resaltados.

server_time_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small button beside a date or time field that sets the value to the database server’s current time function, evaluated on save, not this computer’s clock.

sql_function_needs_newer_bridge.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons → Insert dropdown menu: suffix appended to a disabled SQL-function item on a relay connection whose bridge is too old to evaluate it; starts with a dash after the function name.

stage_delete_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: Delete button label when the editor was opened from a grid “stage” action; queues the row deletion in the grid’s pending changes for a later batch save instead of deleting now.

stage_insert_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: primary button label on a new-row form opened from a grid “stage” action; queues the insert in the grid’s pending changes for a later batch save.

stage_update_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: primary button label when editing a row opened from a grid “stage” action; queues the edits in the grid’s pending changes for a later batch save instead of saving now.

table_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title once the source table is resolved; {action_name} is the action title (Edit Row, Insert Row, Duplicate Row…) and {table_name} the quoted table name.

text_too_long.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a text column’s field when the value exceeds the column’s maximum length; {actual_length} is the typed length and {maximum_length} the limit, both in characters.

time_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a time-of-day column’s field when the text is not a valid time; the example shows the expected hours:minutes:seconds format; keep the example unchanged.

today_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small button beside a date-only field that fills it with today’s date from this computer’s clock.

too_many_decimal_places.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a decimal column’s field when the value has more digits after the decimal point than the column’s scale; {decimal_places} is the allowed number.

too_many_integer_digits.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a decimal column’s field when the value has more digits before the decimal point than the column’s precision allows; {integer_digits} is the limit.
too_many_integer_digits.value: se permiten como máximo {integer_digits} dígitos antes del separador decimal

transform_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small dropdown button beside a free-text field listing text macros (case changes, trimming and similar) that rewrite the current value; disabled while the field is empty.

transform_tooltip.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: tooltip on a text field’s “Transform” dropdown button explaining that it applies a text macro to rewrite the field’s current value.
transform_tooltip.value: Aplica una macro de texto a este valor

type_summary.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small grey line under each column name; {data_type} is the column’s SQL type with size, {nullability} is the word for nullable or not null.

unsupported_type.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a field whose data type the editor cannot convert from typed text, so the value cannot be changed; lowercase fragment.
unsupported_type.value: este tipo no se puede editar

update_conflict_current_values.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error when Save is refused because another session changed the row after it was loaded; the form is reloaded with the server’s current values and the user must redo the edit.
update_conflict_current_values.value: La fila cambió en el servidor desde que se cargó; no se guardó nada. El formulario muestra ahora los valores actuales: vuelve a aplicar tu edición.

update_conflict_deleted.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error when Save is refused because the row was deleted on the server after the editor loaded it; nothing was written.
update_conflict_deleted.value: La fila se eliminó en el servidor; no se guardó nada.

whole_number_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under an integer column’s field when the text is not a whole number; lowercase instruction fragment.

copy_value_button.location: Results → View Row window (popped out) → Field list: small button beside each column’s value that copies that single value to the clipboard; verb, keep very short.

detached_row_position.location: Results → View Row window (popped out) → Header: heading above the field list giving the shown row’s position; {row_number} is the 1-based row shown, {total_rows} the result set’s row count.

overlay_copy_value_button.location: Results → Grid → Row form overlay → Field list: small button beside each column’s value in the in-pane record form that copies that single value to the clipboard; verb, keep very short.

overlay_row_position.location: Results → Grid → Row form overlay: dialog title of the in-pane record form opened via a row’s View action; {row_number} is the 1-based row shown, {total_rows} the result set’s row count.

window_title.location: Results → Row form → Pop-out: operating-system title bar of the separate window opened when the user detaches the row form overlay; it shows one row’s columns read-only.

all_pinned_hint.location: Results → Run history strip: dim hint at the end of the run chips, shown when every retained run is pinned and the history limit is reached, so no new run can be kept until one is unpinned.
all_pinned_hint.value: Desfija una ejecución para mantener el historial acotado

banner.location: Results → Run history: read-only banner for a retained run, showing its completion {time}, row or message {content}, and {elapsed} duration.

banner_with_unavailable_reason.location: Results → Run history: read-only banner for a retained run with incomplete rows, showing {time}, {content}, {elapsed}, and why rows are unavailable in {unavailable_reason}.

close_run_tooltip.location: Results → Run history strip → Run chip: tooltip on the small X button beside a retained run that removes that run from the history (returning to the latest results if it was being viewed).

current_button.location: Results → Run history strip: first chip, left of the past-run chips, that switches the grid back to the latest (current) query results; adjective meaning “most recent”, keep short.

dismiss_banner_button.location: Results → Read-only results banner: clickable text at the right of the info banner shown above restored or past-run results; it hides the banner and clears those read-only results.

incomplete_unavailable.location: Results → Read-only results banner: reason appended to the banner when viewing a past run whose rows were not all fetched (stopped or capped), so only its row count was retained.
incomplete_unavailable.value: Esta ejecución no retuvo todas las filas; solo se conserva el recuento.

memory_budget_unavailable.location: Results → Read-only results banner: reason appended to the banner when viewing a past run whose result set was too large for the run-history memory budget, so only its row count was retained.
memory_budget_unavailable.value: Esta ejecución supera el límite de memoria del historial de ejecuciones; solo se conserva el recuento.

message_count_content.location: Results → Run history: plural content summary for a retained run that produced messages but no result sets.

message_count_content_one.location: Results → Run history: singular content summary for a retained run that produced exactly one message and no result sets.

pin_tooltip.location: Results → Run history strip → Run chip: tooltip on the star button of an unpinned run; clicking pins the run so it is never dropped when history fills up. Verb.

row_count_content.location: Results → Read-only results banner: row total inserted as the content part of the banner for a past run that returned result sets; {row_count} is the formatted total row count.

run_chip_label.location: Results → Run history strip → Run chip: label of one retained run; {run_time} is its completion clock time, {row_count} its total rows, {elapsed_time} its duration. Keep compact.

run_label.location: Results → Run history strip → Run chip tooltip: run name at the start of the hover tooltip, followed by the run’s SQL; {run_id} is the run’s sequence number. Noun, as in “query run”.

spill_backed_unavailable.location: Results → Read-only results banner: reason appended to the banner when viewing a past run whose large result was paged to a temporary disk file, so its rows were not kept in history.
spill_backed_unavailable.value: Esta ejecución está respaldada por un archivo de volcado en disco; sus filas no se conservan en el historial de ejecuciones.

strip_tooltip.location: Results → Run history strip: tooltip on the history clock icon at the start of the strip of past-run chips, explaining how to view an earlier run or return via the Current chip.
strip_tooltip.value: Ejecuciones recientes de esta consulta: haz clic en una ejecución para ver sus resultados o en Actual para ver la última

unpin_tooltip.location: Results → Run history strip → Run chip: tooltip on the highlighted star button of a pinned run; clicking unpins it so it can be dropped when history fills up. Verb.

age_days.location: Saved Charts and chart dashboards → Last-run age stamp (days): relative age in days used in “last run …” and “Refreshed …” stamps when over a day old; {days} is the whole number of days. Abbreviated, keep short.

age_hours.location: Saved Charts and chart dashboards → Last-run age stamp (hours): relative age in hours used in “last run …” and “Refreshed …” stamps when 1–23 hours old; {hours} is the whole number of hours. Abbreviated.

age_just_now.location: Saved Charts and chart dashboards → Last-run age stamp (just now): relative age used in “last run …” and “Refreshed …” stamps when the chart ran less than a minute ago; lowercase, follows those words.

age_minutes.location: Saved Charts and chart dashboards → Last-run age stamp (minutes): relative age in minutes used in “last run …” and “Refreshed …” stamps when 1–59 minutes old; {minutes} is the whole number of minutes. Abbreviated.

blank_name_error.location: Save Chart to Library dialog and Tools → Saved Charts rename: inline error shown when the chart name is empty or only spaces on Save or Rename.
blank_name_error.value: Escribe un nombre para el gráfico.

delete_not_found_error.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Delete: error line shown when the selected chart can no longer be found in the library file (e.g. removed elsewhere) as it is being deleted.

duplicate_name_error.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Rename: error line shown when the new name matches another saved chart (case-insensitive); {chart_name} is the requested name.
duplicate_name_error.value: Ya existe un gráfico guardado llamado «{chart_name}».

duplicate_not_found_error.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Duplicate: error line shown when the selected chart can no longer be found in the library file while making a copy of it.

copy_sql_button.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Footer: button that copies the selected chart’s runnable query SQL to the clipboard; disabled until a chart is selected.

dashboard_button.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Footer: button that closes the dialog and opens the Chart Dashboard showing all saved charts as live tiles. Noun.

delete_button.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Footer: button that permanently removes the selected chart from the saved chart library; disabled until a chart is selected.

duplicate_button.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Footer: button that copies the selected chart under a new unique name such as “Name (2)”; disabled until a chart is selected. Verb.

empty_state.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → List: empty-state message shown when no charts have been saved yet, telling the user how to save one from a result’s Chart tab.
empty_state.value: Aún no hay gráficos guardados: abre la pestaña Gráfico de un conjunto de resultados y elige Guardar gráfico en la biblioteca…

last_run.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → List row: part of each chart’s subtitle (between its connection and refresh interval) telling when it last ran; {relative_age} is e.g. “5 min ago”.

never_run.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → List row: subtitle part shown instead of “last run …” for a chart that has never been run yet; lowercase fragment.

open_button.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Footer: primary button that opens the selected chart (runs its query on its connection and shows the chart) and closes the dialog. Verb.

refresh_button.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Footer: interval button shown when no chart is selected; with a selection it shows the chart’s interval and each click cycles its dashboard auto-refresh setting.

rename_button.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Footer: button beside the name field that renames the selected chart to the typed name; disabled until a chart is selected. Verb.

rename_placeholder.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Footer: placeholder in the small name field (filled with the selected chart’s name) used to type a new name before clicking Rename.

sql_copied.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown after Copy SQL in the Saved Charts dialog puts a chart’s query on the clipboard; {chart_name} is the chart’s name.

title.location: Tools → Saved Charts: title of the dialog listing every chart saved to the library, with open, rename, refresh-interval, duplicate, delete and dashboard actions.

library_newer_version_error.location: Saved Charts dialog and Chart Dashboard → Library version error: error shown when the saved-chart library file was written by a newer SQLLY; {file_version} is the file’s format number, {supported_version} the newest this app reads.
library_newer_version_error.value: La biblioteca de gráficos guardados la escribió una versión más reciente de SQLLY (formato {file_version}; esta versión lee hasta {supported_version}).

manual_refresh.location: Saved Charts dialog and chart dashboard tiles → Refresh interval (manual): refresh-interval label for a chart that never auto-refreshes and is only refreshed when the user asks.

refresh_every_minutes.location: Saved Charts dialog and chart dashboard tiles → Refresh interval (minutes): refresh-interval label for a chart that auto-refreshes every {minutes} minutes (1, 5 or 15). Abbreviated, keep short.

refresh_every_seconds.location: Saved Charts dialog and chart dashboard tiles → Refresh interval (seconds): refresh-interval label for a chart that auto-refreshes every {seconds} seconds (currently 30). Abbreviated, keep very short.

refresh_not_found_error.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Refresh interval: error line shown when the selected chart can no longer be found in the library file while changing its auto-refresh interval.

rename_not_found_error.location: Tools → Saved Charts dialog → Rename: error line shown when the selected chart can no longer be found in the library file while saving its new name.

default_database.location: Results → Chart tab → Save Chart to Library dialog: database part of the “Runs on …” line, after the connection name, when the chart has no explicit database and uses the connection’s default.

explanation.location: Results → Chart tab → Save Chart to Library dialog: explanatory text above the name field describing what saving keeps and where the chart can be reopened later.
explanation.value: Mantiene este diseño de gráfico con su consulta para que puedas volver a abrirlo desde Herramientas > Gráficos guardados o verlo en el Panel de gráficos.

name_placeholder.location: Results → Chart tab → Save Chart to Library dialog: placeholder in the name field where the user types the saved chart’s name.

run_location.location: Results → Chart tab → Save Chart to Library dialog: dim line below the name field showing where the chart’s query will run; {connection_location} is “connection name · database”.

save_button.location: Results → Chart tab → Save Chart to Library dialog: primary button that saves the chart layout and its query under the typed name to the library.

title.location: Results → Chart tab → Save Chart to Library: title of the dialog opened from the Chart tab’s save action, asking for a name for the chart.

widget_pins_newer_version_error.location: Explorer → Server Dashboard → Widgets: error shown when the pinned chart-widget list was written by a newer SQLLY; {file_version} is the file’s format number, {supported_version} the newest this app reads.
widget_pins_newer_version_error.value: La lista de widgets del panel fue escrita por una versión más reciente de SQLLY (formato {file_version}; esta versión lee hasta {supported_version}).

encode_failed.location: Results → Messages tab → Saved filter set errors: error shown in the desktop app when the saved filter sets cannot be converted to file format before writing; {error} is the underlying error.
encode_failed.value: No se pudieron codificar los filtros guardados: {error}

load_failed.location: Results → Messages tab → Saved filter set errors: error shown in the desktop app when the saved-filters file exists but cannot be read or parsed (it is left untouched and not saved over); {error} is the underlying file or parse error.
load_failed.value: No se pudieron cargar los filtros guardados: {error}

save_failed.location: Results → Messages tab → Saved filter set errors: error shown in the desktop app when writing the saved-filters file to disk fails; {error} is the underlying file error.
save_failed.value: No se pudieron escribir los filtros guardados: {error}

binary_value.location: Results → Selection statistics footer: stand-in text for a binary cell when the footer compares selected values (it can appear as a Min or Max value); {byte_count} is the value’s size in bytes.

cell_cap_suffix.location: Results → Selection statistics footer: note appended after the statistics when the selection is too large and only the first {cell_cap} cells were counted. Starts with spaces as a separator.

date_count.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (date column): first metric, the number of non-empty date cells in the grid selection; {value} is the formatted count.

date_distinct.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (date column): last metric, how many different date values the selection contains; {value} is the formatted count.

date_maximum.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (date column): metric showing the latest date among the selected cells; {value} is that date as displayed. Abbreviation of “maximum”.

date_minimum.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (date column): metric showing the earliest date among the selected cells; {value} is that date as displayed. Abbreviation of “minimum”.

numeric_average.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (number column): metric showing the arithmetic mean of the selected numeric cells; {value} is the formatted average. Abbreviation, keep short.

numeric_count.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (number column): first metric, the number of non-empty numeric cells in the grid selection; {value} is the formatted count.

numeric_distinct.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (number column): last metric, how many different numeric values the selection contains; {value} is the formatted count.

numeric_maximum.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (number column): metric showing the largest selected numeric value; {value} is the formatted number. Abbreviation of “maximum”.

numeric_minimum.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (number column): metric showing the smallest selected numeric value; {value} is the formatted number. Abbreviation of “minimum”.

numeric_sum.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (number column): metric showing the total of the selected numeric cells, omitted for true/false columns; {value} is the formatted sum.

text_count.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (text column): first metric, the number of non-empty text cells in the grid selection; {value} is the formatted count.

text_distinct.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (text column): last metric, how many different text values the selection contains; {value} is the formatted count.

text_lengths.location: Results → Selection statistics footer (text column): metric showing text length in characters as shortest/average/longest; {minimum}, {average}, {maximum} are those lengths.

delta_summary.location: Results → Messages tab: summary added after a run with Include Statistics on (MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server); {counter_deltas} lists changed session counters as “name +n”, {counter_note} explains them.
delta_summary.value: Incluir estadísticas: variación de los contadores de sesión en esta ejecución: {counter_deltas}. {counter_note}

mysql_note.location: Results → Messages tab → Include Statistics summary: explanatory note for MySQL/MariaDB describing what each Handler counter measures; counter names are literal and must stay untranslated.
mysql_note.value: Handler_read_key/next cuentan lecturas de índice; Handler_read_rnd_next cuenta lecturas por recorrido de tabla; Handler_write/update/delete cuentan cambios de filas (incluidas las tablas temporales).

no_activity.location: Results → Messages tab: message added after a run with Include Statistics on when none of the session counters changed during the run.
no_activity.value: Incluir estadísticas: no se registró actividad de sesión para esta ejecución.

sql_server_note.location: Results → Messages tab → Include Statistics summary: explanatory note for SQL Server describing each session counter’s unit; counter names (cpu_time, logical_reads, etc.) are literal, keep untranslated.
sql_server_note.value: cpu_time son milisegundos de CPU; reads/writes son E/S físicas; logical_reads son lecturas de páginas de la caché de búferes; memory_usage_pages son páginas de 8 KB; row_count son las filas afectadas/devueltas.

age_days.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → List row: age part of a snapshot’s subtitle when it was saved over a day ago; {count} is the whole number of days. Abbreviated.

age_hours.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → List row: age part of a snapshot’s subtitle when it was saved 1–23 hours ago; {count} is the whole number of hours. Abbreviated.

age_just_now.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → List row: age part of a snapshot’s subtitle when it was saved less than a minute ago.

age_minutes.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → List row: age part of a snapshot’s subtitle when it was saved 1–59 minutes ago; {count} is the whole number of minutes. Abbreviated.

browser_dialog_title.location: Tools → Result Snapshots: title of the dialog listing saved result snapshots, with rename, delete and open actions.

browser_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Results → Save as Snapshot dialog: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” error shown when trying to save a snapshot in the web build.

delete_button.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → Footer: button that permanently removes the selected snapshot and its saved rows; disabled until a snapshot is selected.

delete_not_found.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → Delete: error line shown when the selected snapshot is no longer in the snapshot index (e.g. removed elsewhere) as it is being deleted.

dialog_explanation.location: Results → Grid context menu → Save as Snapshot dialog: explanatory text above the name field describing what saving a snapshot does and its 100,000-row limit.
dialog_explanation.value: Guarda este conjunto de resultados (hasta 100.000 filas) para poder volver a abrirlo más tarde sin volver a ejecutar la consulta.

empty_instructions.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → List: empty-state message shown when no snapshots exist yet, telling the user how to save one from a result grid’s context menu.
empty_instructions.value: Aún no hay instantáneas: haz clic con el botón derecho en una cuadrícula de resultados y elige Guardar como instantánea…

index_parse_failed.location: Result Snapshots and Save as Snapshot dialogs → Snapshot index parse error: error shown when the snapshot index file exists but is corrupt and cannot be parsed; {error} is the technical parser message.
index_parse_failed.value: No se pudo analizar el índice de la instantánea: {error}

index_read_failed.location: Result Snapshots and Save as Snapshot dialogs → Snapshot index read error: error shown when the snapshot index file cannot be read from disk; {error} is the operating-system error.
index_read_failed.value: No se pudo leer el índice de la instantánea: {error}

invalid_file_name.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog: error shown on Open or Delete when the snapshot index points at a missing or unsafe data file name, so the snapshot’s rows cannot be located.
invalid_file_name.value: Nombre de archivo de instantánea no válido

name_placeholder.location: Results → Grid context menu → Save as Snapshot dialog: placeholder in the name field where the user types the new snapshot’s name.

open_button.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → Footer: primary button that opens the selected snapshot as a read-only results tab and closes the dialog. Verb.

payload_read_failed.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → Open: error line shown when the selected snapshot’s data file cannot be read from disk; {error} is the operating-system error.
payload_read_failed.value: No se pudo leer la instantánea: {error}

read_not_found.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → Open: error line shown when the selected snapshot is no longer in the snapshot index at the moment it is opened.

rename_button.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → Footer: button beside the name field that renames the selected snapshot to the typed name; disabled until a snapshot is selected. Verb.

rename_name_required.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → Rename: error line shown when Rename is clicked with an empty or blank name field.

rename_not_found.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → Rename: error line shown when the selected snapshot is no longer in the snapshot index while saving its new name.

rename_placeholder.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → Footer: placeholder in the small name field (filled with the selected snapshot’s name) used to type a new name before clicking Rename.

row_subtitle.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → List row: subtitle under a snapshot’s name; {engine_name} is the database engine, {row_count} the saved rows, {truncated_suffix} an optional “(truncated)”, {relative_age} its age.

save_button.location: Results → Grid context menu → Save as Snapshot dialog: primary button that saves the current result set under the typed name.

save_dialog_title.location: Results → Grid context menu → Save as Snapshot: title of the dialog that asks for a name before saving the current result set for later reopening.

save_name_required.location: Results → Grid context menu → Save as Snapshot dialog: inline error shown when Save is clicked with an empty or blank name field.

saving_reading_rows.location: Results → Grid caption strip: progress note above the grid while a large disk-paged result is read back before saving it as a snapshot; {row_count} is how many rows are being read.
saving_reading_rows.value: Guardando instantánea: leyendo {row_count} filas del disco…

store_busy.location: Results → Save as Snapshot dialog: inline error shown when the snapshot store is locked by another save in progress and cannot accept this one right now.
store_busy.value: El almacén de instantáneas está ocupado

truncated_suffix.location: Tools → Result Snapshots dialog → List row: marker inserted right after the row count in a snapshot’s subtitle when the result had more rows than the snapshot limit kept. Starts with a space.

open_failed_rows_on_disk.location: Results → Messages tab: message added when a large result’s temporary disk file cannot be reopened after the query; {result_number} is the result set number, {file_path} where the rows remain.
open_failed_rows_on_disk.value: Resultado {result_number}: no se pudo abrir el archivo de volcado; las filas se conservan en el disco en {file_path}

open_failed_rows_unavailable.location: Results → Error banner: error shown above the results when a large result’s temporary disk file cannot be reopened, so that result set’s rows cannot be displayed; {result_number} is its number.
open_failed_rows_unavailable.value: Resultado {result_number}: no se pudo abrir el archivo de volcado; sus filas no están disponibles

page_read_failed.location: Results → Messages tab: error message added when scrolling a large disk-paged result fails to read the next page of rows from its temporary file.
page_read_failed.value: Error: no se pudo leer esta página del resultado del disco. Es posible que el archivo se haya eliminado o sea ilegible.

failed.location: Results → Messages: notice shown when the rows behind a double-clicked pivot cell or clicked chart mark could not be collected because the large result's file on disk could not be read or written.
failed.value: No se pudieron mostrar las filas coincidentes porque no se pudo leer el archivo del resultado.

progress.location: Results → grid caption strip: progress shown while SQLLY collects the rows behind a double-clicked pivot cell or clicked chart mark from a large result kept on disk; {percent} is a whole percent.

clear_filters_tooltip.location: Results → Stacked layout → Result card header: tooltip on the filter-with-X button that removes all row filters from that result set; enabled only when filters are applied.

clear_grouping_tooltip.location: Results → Stacked layout → Result card header: tooltip on the grouping-with-X button that removes column grouping from that result set; enabled only when grouping is active.
