name_required.value: Introduce un nombre para el espacio de trabajo.

open_button.location: Workspaces → Manage: primary button that restores the selected workspace.

rename_button.location: Workspaces → Manage: button that applies the edited name to the selected workspace.

save_button.location: Workspaces → Save Workspace As: primary button that saves the entered workspace name and current state.

save_description.location: Workspaces → Save Workspace As: explanatory paragraph describing captured state and the disconnected restore policy.
save_description.value: Captura los archivos SQL abiertos, las pestañas sin guardar, los destinos de conexión, la raíz del proyecto y el diseño actual de los paneles. Al abrirlo más tarde, permanece desconectado hasta que elijas Conectar o ejecutes una consulta.

save_title.location: Workspaces → Save Workspace As: dialog title for saving the current tabs and layout under a new name.

saved_count.location: SQLLY → Workspaces dialog: footer showing how many named workspaces are saved and the maximum allowed.

selection_placeholder.location: Workspaces → Manage: placeholder in the name field before a saved workspace is selected.

deleted.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after deleting a saved workspace in the Workspaces dialog (past participle).

duplicated.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after duplicating a saved workspace in the Workspaces dialog (past participle).

renamed.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after renaming a saved workspace in the Workspaces dialog (past participle).

restored.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after a saved workspace's tabs and layout are reopened (past participle).
restored.value: Espacio de trabajo restaurado: desconectado hasta que elijas Conectar

saved.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after saving the current state under a new name in Save Workspace As (past participle).

capacity.location: Workspaces → Save error: message shown when saving another workspace would exceed the named-workspace limit.
capacity.value: Se pueden guardar como máximo {maximum} espacios de trabajo con nombre.

invalid_id.location: Workspaces → Storage error: message shown when a saved workspace identifier is not a valid UUID.
invalid_id.value: El identificador del espacio de trabajo no es válido.

name_empty.location: Workspaces → Name validation: storage error shown when the trimmed workspace name is empty.
name_empty.value: El nombre del espacio de trabajo no puede estar vacío.

name_too_long.location: Workspaces → Name validation: storage error shown when the workspace name exceeds the character limit.
name_too_long.value: Los nombres de los espacios de trabajo tienen un límite de {maximum} caracteres.

not_found.location: Workspaces → Storage error: message shown when the requested saved workspace no longer exists.
not_found.value: No se pudo encontrar el espacio de trabajo guardado.

snapshot_corrupt.location: Workspaces → Storage error: message shown when a saved workspace snapshot cannot be loaded or decoded.
snapshot_corrupt.value: La instantánea de este espacio de trabajo falta o está dañada.

intro.value: Mantén las mismas conexiones guardadas, fragmentos, consultas de la Biblioteca SQL y configuración compartible en cada Mac que haya iniciado sesión con tu Cuenta de Apple. La sincronización usa una carpeta de tu propio iCloud Drive y está desactivada hasta que la actives.
intro.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: introductory paragraph at the top of the pane explaining what iCloud sync does and that it is off until turned on.

enable_label.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: label of the checkbox that turns iCloud sync on or off for this Mac (off by default).

section_syncs.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: section heading above the list of what iCloud sync copies between Macs.

syncs_connections.value: Las conexiones guardadas, con sus notas, clientes, proyectos, entornos, colores, iconos y perfiles de túnel.
syncs_connections.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What syncs: line saying saved connections and their labels, colors, icons and tunnel profiles sync.

syncs_snippets.value: Los fragmentos y las acciones rápidas.
syncs_snippets.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What syncs: line saying snippets and quick actions sync.

syncs_library.value: Las consultas de la Biblioteca SQL, mientras esté en su carpeta predeterminada (archivos de hasta 1 MB).
syncs_library.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What syncs: line saying SQL Library query files sync when the library is in its default folder, up to 1 MB each.

syncs_settings.value: La configuración de apariencia, editor, atajos de teclado, formato SQL, formato de resultados, formato condicional, columnas sensibles, explorador de servidores, pestañas y transacciones.
syncs_settings.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What syncs: line listing which settings sync between Macs.

section_never.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: section heading above the list of what iCloud sync never copies.

never_secrets.value: Las contraseñas, frases de contraseña de claves SSH, tokens y claves de API se quedan en el llavero de este Mac. Una conexión que llega a otro Mac pide su contraseña la primera vez que te conectas.
never_secrets.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What never syncs: line saying passwords, SSH passphrases, tokens and API keys stay in this Mac's keychain, and a synced connection asks for its password on first connect on another Mac.

never_local.value: Los inicios de sesión compartidos, el historial de consultas, las pestañas abiertas, la configuración de IA y MCP, y la que apunta a programas o archivos de este Mac.
never_local.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What never syncs: line listing other things that stay on this Mac (shared logins, history, tabs, AI and tool settings).

section_conflicts.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: section heading above the explanation of how iCloud sync resolves conflicting changes.

conflicts_hint.value: Cada elemento conserva su cambio más reciente, y eliminar un elemento lo elimina en todos los Mac. Si una consulta que editaste aquí pierde frente a una versión más nueva, tu versión se guarda junto a ella como copia en conflicto.
conflicts_hint.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → When two Macs disagree: explanation that the most recent change to an item wins, deletes apply everywhere, and an edited query that loses is kept as a conflicted copy.

section_status.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: section heading above the current sync status and the Sync Now button.

sync_now.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: button that runs a sync right away instead of waiting for the next automatic one.

off_hint.value: Desactivar la sincronización la detiene. No se elimina nada de este Mac ni de iCloud.
off_hint.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: note under the checkbox explaining that turning sync off removes nothing from this Mac or iCloud.

restart_hint.value: Las conexiones, fragmentos y consultas de tus otros Mac aparecen al momento; la configuración se aplica la próxima vez que se inicie SQLLY.
restart_hint.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: note explaining that connections, snippets and queries from another Mac appear right away while settings take effect at the next launch.

app_store_unavailable.value: La sincronización con iCloud no está disponible en la edición Mac App Store. Para copiar conexiones a otro Mac, usa Archivo ▸ Exportar conexiones y luego Archivo ▸ Importar conexiones en el otro Mac.
app_store_unavailable.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: notice shown instead of an active checkbox in the Mac App Store edition, which cannot use iCloud sync.

unsupported.value: La sincronización con iCloud solo está disponible en macOS.
unsupported.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: notice shown in place of the pane's controls on systems other than macOS.

save_failed.value: No se pudo guardar la configuración de sincronización con iCloud: {error}
save_failed.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: error shown under the checkbox when the on/off choice could not be saved; {error} is the system's error text.

off.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: status line while sync is turned off.

waiting.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: status line right after sync is turned on, before the first sync finishes.

not_signed_in.value: Este Mac no tiene la sesión iniciada en iCloud. Inicia sesión en Configuración del Sistema ▸ Cuenta de Apple y activa iCloud Drive.
not_signed_in.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when this Mac is not signed in to iCloud.

drive_off.value: iCloud Drive está desactivado en este Mac. Actívalo en Configuración del Sistema ▸ Cuenta de Apple ▸ iCloud ▸ iCloud Drive.
drive_off.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when the Mac is signed in to iCloud but iCloud Drive is turned off.

unavailable.value: La sincronización con iCloud no está disponible en esta edición de SQLLY.
unavailable.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when this edition or system cannot use iCloud sync.

state_unreadable.value: La sincronización se detuvo porque su registro en este Mac ({path}) no se puede leer: {detail}. No se cambió nada.
state_unreadable.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when this Mac's own sync record file cannot be read; {path} is the file, {detail} the error. Nothing was changed.

folder_unreadable.value: La sincronización se detuvo porque la carpeta de iCloud {path} no se puede leer: {detail}. No se cambió nada.
folder_unreadable.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when the iCloud Drive sync folder cannot be listed; {path} is the folder, {detail} the error. Nothing was changed.

write_failed.value: La sincronización no pudo escribir en {path}: {detail}. Lo intentará de nuevo en la próxima sincronización.
write_failed.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when SQLLY could not write its sync file or record; {path} is where, {detail} the error. It retries on the next sync.

synced.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: status line after a successful sync that brought nothing new; {time} is the local time of day.

synced_with_changes.value: Última sincronización a las {time}. Cambios de tus otros Mac: {count}.
synced_with_changes.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: status line after a successful sync that applied changes from other Macs; {time} is the local time of day, {count} the number of changes.

skipped_damaged.value: Se ignoró {file_name} en iCloud porque está dañado o no es un archivo de sincronización de SQLLY. No cambió nada en este Mac.
skipped_damaged.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note under the status naming a file in the iCloud sync folder that was ignored because it is damaged or not a sync file; {file_name} is its name.

skipped_newer.value: Se ignoró {file_name} en iCloud porque lo escribió una versión más nueva de SQLLY. Actualiza SQLLY en este Mac para sincronizar con ese Mac.
skipped_newer.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note naming a sync file in iCloud written by a newer version of SQLLY, which this Mac skips until updated; {file_name} is its name.

downloading.value: Archivos de sincronización que aún se descargan de iCloud: {count}. Se leerán en la próxima sincronización.
downloading.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note saying how many sync files iCloud is still downloading to this Mac; {count} is that number.

not_applied.value: Elementos de iCloud aún no aplicados en este Mac: {count}. SQLLY volverá a intentarlo en la próxima sincronización.
not_applied.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note saying how many incoming items could not be applied on this Mac yet; {count} is that number. They are retried.

conflicted_copy.value: Se guardó tu consulta editada como {file_name} porque llegó una versión más nueva desde otro Mac.
conflicted_copy.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note naming a SQL Library file where this Mac's edited version was kept as a conflicted copy; {file_name} is the copy's path inside the library.

updated.value: La sincronización con iCloud trajo cambios de tus otros Mac.
updated.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown after iCloud sync brought in changes to connections, snippets or queries from another Mac.
